records.composition: First half: the YouTube player animating from the rotated mini-player to fullscreen. Second half (about 1.2-2.38 s): the opening red-tower worm's-eye frame of #3, under the player controls (pause/skip buttons, progress bar, 'In this video').
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Not a camera move. The measured +14% push and 36%-of-width pan are the app's minimise-to-fullscreen animation. The Arcane image underneath is the near-static start of #3.
records.light_colour: Same as #3 (red smoke backlight, towers in silhouette) plus white UI overlay and a red progress bar.
records.purpose: Recording artifact. Its back half is the head of #3's establishing shot, so the real red-tower shot runs about 3.4 s (from about 1.2 s to 4.67 s), not 2.29 s.
records.recipe_2d: Don't build this. When computing stats, merge its last ~1.2 s into #3 (true length about 3.4 s) and ignore the measured move.

records.composition: Worm's-eye V. Two gothic towers cut by the top lean toward each other with strongly converging verticals and frame a bright V of red sky that points down to the hidden horizon. Left tower: a huge cog/rose-window wheel fills the bottom-left as the foreground anchor. A squat block sits at bottom centre; the right spire disappears into smoke. Sagging power cables cross the V as diagonal leading lines, a dim red sun disc sits in the gap, embers drift across. No horizon.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Near-locked worm's-eye hold that breathes outward: a barely visible -2% pull-out with a small tilt up (2% of width), landing softly (ease-out). It reads as still; the embers and smoke carry the motion. It's one ~3.4 s shot together with #2's tail.
records.light_colour: Backlit by red smoke-glow behind and below the towers, brightest in the V (low centre-left), darker maroon at the top-right and edges. Towers near-silhouette with faint red bounce. Warm monochrome: blood red, maroon, brown-black, ember orange.
records.purpose: Establishing / ominous awe. The city is a colossus under a burning sky before any person appears, setting the threat and the mood (aftermath, smoke, heat).
records.recipe_2d: K7 worm's-eye establishing shot, 2.5-3.5 s (75-105 frames at 30 fps). Layers, back to front: (1) sky, f 0: smoke-red in 3 flat value steps as soft-edged blob shapes (lightest in the V, darker toward the top corners, no gradient), plus a dim sun disc of 120 px, one step lighter, at about (600, 700). (2) Far spire, f 0.15: x 620-1080, leaning 12 deg left, cut by the top, fill-only, one step darker than the sky, its top dissolving into a smoke blob. (3) Mid block, f 0.35: squat building at bottom centre, x 300-760, top at y about 1350. (4) Near tower, f 0.55: x 0-560, leaning 15-20 deg right, cut by the top, with a 700 px cog wheel cut by the left and bottom edges; ink 3-4 px. (5) 3-4 power cables as sagging ink curves from the near tower to the far spire across the V, split between f 0.55 and f 0.15 so they shear slightly. (6) Embers, f 1.2: 20-30 dots of 6-10 px in ember orange, rising 25-40 px/s with +-10 px sway, a few blinking out. Put the verticals' vanishing point above the frame at y about -1500 (9:16 exaggerates the convergence nicely); the V apex sits at about (560, 1450). The V is the only flat field, so captions go there (y 317-556), with that sky step lifted to L* >= 70 or a caption plate. Camera: ShotCam push 1.03 -> 1.00 plus a 40 px tilt up, CAM.slow, landing over the last 35 %, then a 1 px drift. Don't use it as our frame 0 (no scale before 3 s), and cut to a person within ~5 s.

records.composition: Negative space. A deep-blue void (underwater or thick mist, no horizon) with soft light shafts fanning up-right from the bottom-left corner. One tiny dark speck floats on the left third, just above centre. The top-right two-thirds are empty and near-black.
records.subject_scale: ~2% of frame height (a tiny dark speck; maybe a distant figure, maybe debris)
records.move: Near-locked float: a -2% pull-out with a 2 deg roll drifting over 2.4 s (uneven, peaking at 65%), a slight drift left, and a little parallax (the bottom moves 0.17 more than the top), like a camera hanging in water. It's one continuous ~5.8 s hold with #5-9; the cut detector split it on shaft flicker.
records.light_colour: Cold shafts from off-frame bottom-left, falling off to black at the top-right. Single cold hue: teal, steel blue, navy, blue-black.
records.purpose: Breath / transition after the red establishing shot: cold, empty, one tiny thing alone. Isolation and quiet. The temperature contrast drives the sequence (red #3 -> blue #4-9 -> warm sunset #10).
records.recipe_2d: Mood bridge, 1.5-2.5 s for us (Arcane holds ~5.8 s across #4-9, too long for a 30-45 s short). Layers: (1) void, f 0: flat navy-black, one darker step over the top-right third. (2) Light shafts, f 0.2: 4-5 flat wedges in 2 stepped teal-blues fanning from an origin off the bottom-left corner at (-150, 2100) through a 25-45 deg spread, the longest reaching y about 500. Each breathes width +-3 % and value one step on/off on offset 2-4 s loops (nothing faster than 1 Hz, flash-safe). (3) Motes, f 0.6: 20 dots of 3-5 px drifting up 6-10 px/s. (4) The speck, f 1.0: one fill-only silhouette of 50-70 px at (400, 820), sinking 2-3 px/s, the only hard-edged mark. Camera: push 1.02 -> 1.00 over the hold (eased, peaking at ~65 %), truck left 14 px, and optionally a 1-2 deg roll drift (underwater float only; elsewhere our camera never rolls). It's a dark frame: put captions on a plate, or lift the whole value ladder to our page rules with the shafts as the lightest step.

records.light_colour: Cold shafts from the bottom-left falling to black: teal, steel blue, navy, blue-black.
records.purpose: Continuation of the #4 breath hold. Not an editorial cut.
records.recipe_2d: Not a separate shot: build it as part of #4's single hold. If the VO needs a sub-beat here, change only the shafts' value by one step on the beat, never cut. Merge #4-9 into one ~5.8 s shot in the stats.

records.composition: Same as #4: blue void, light shafts fanning from the bottom-left, the tiny speck at about 37% across and 47% down, dark empty top-right.
records.subject_scale: ~2% of frame height (same speck)
records.move: Tail of the same hold: a very slow +2.6% push drifting slightly right and down (ease-in-out, peaking at 62%), leaning toward the speck. The camera is still moving at the cut to the warm #10.
records.light_colour: Cold shafts from the bottom-left falling to black: teal, steel blue, navy, blue-black. The hard colour cut to warm apricot comes next.
records.purpose: Ends the breath. The drift reverses from pull-out (#4) to push-in, so the long hold 'breathes' out and in, then hands energy to the cut. Cold-to-warm colour cut.
records.recipe_2d: Last 1-1.4 s of the #4 hold: reverse the drift into push 1.00 -> 1.026 (ease-in-out, peaking at 62 %), truck right 9 px and down 11 px, anchored on the speck (anchorDepth 1.0) so it grows slightly. Cut while it's still moving, straight to the warm frame (blue -> apricot), with no dissolve.

records.composition: Centred symmetry, frame within frame. A round moon-gate window, about 41% of frame width and nearly the full frame height, is cut into a dark wall that fills ~60% of the frame. It shows a warm sunset sky with soft cloud bands. Leafy vines hang from the top of the circle. Two silhouettes on the bottom sill: a small yordle standing just left of the axis, and a lanky youth hunched on the right holding a long staff, with a gap between them. As it pulls out, the window's inner reveal catches a sliver of light at the top-right.
records.subject_scale: youth ~37% and yordle ~29% of frame height; the window ~97%
records.move: Slow -5% pull-out with a slight drift left (2.5% of width) and up (1.2%), accelerating (ease-in). The retreat starts almost imperceptibly and is still speeding up as the frame dips out (#11). It's the first half of a pull-back that a dip to black completes.
records.light_colour: Warm sunset backlight through the round window; everything in front is silhouette. Strong warm/dark contrast: apricot, peach, dusty rose clouds, olive-black vines, brown-black wall.
records.purpose: Intimacy / refuge. Two small figures sit together inside a warm round opening, held by the wall (one opening, facing out). A quiet bond and a pause. The accelerating pull-out begins the 'our world gets smaller' retreat.
records.recipe_2d: Cozy portal hold with K4 start, 3-3.5 s (90-105 frames). Layers: (1) sky, f 0.1: flat apricot/peach in 2 steps (lighter toward the sill) plus 2-3 flat cloud bands drifting 3-5 px/s. (2) Wall plate, f 1.0: a full-frame fill with a circular evenodd hole (roomBox/Portal, TO BUILD), circle 920 px wide centred at (540, 830), so y 370-1290. In our palette the wall can't be 60 % anchor-dark: use a warm mid-dark fill (L* about 40-50) with ink texture lines, and a 32-40 px reveal ring that lights up one step at the top-right over the last 1 s. A flat sill ledge crosses the circle at y 1250 (feet stay above the UI zone). (3) Figures on the sill, f 1.0, anchor-colour fill-only silhouettes: the small one about 250 px tall at x 450, the hunched one about 330 px at x 640 holding a diagonal staff, with a clear gap between them; 1-2 px breathing loops. (4) Vines, f 1.3: 5-7 hanging strands from the circle's top edge, only at x < 330 and x > 750, swaying +-4 px at 0.3 Hz, so the sky inside the circle stays a flat field for captions at y 387-510 within x 260-820 (or use a caption plate). Camera: ShotCam push 1.06 -> 1.00 over the shot, ease-in (accelerating, peak speed at the end, well under 15 px/frame), truck left 27 px and up 13 px. Hand the moving camera straight into the dip (#11).

records.composition: Frame within frame within frame. From far back inside the dark, a huge near arch overhangs the top ~75%. The moon-gate is now just a warm sliver at the bottom edge with the two tiny silhouettes, and the whole frame fades to near-black within the shot.
records.subject_scale: ~15% of frame height at the start, then lost in black
records.move: No camera move (measured static; the frames are too dark to track). The held extreme wide dims to black. Together with #12 it forms one dip-to-black (about 0.5 s out, 0.4 s in) on a composition about 2x wider than #10.
records.light_colour: The only light is the warm sliver of window at the bottom, dimming to black: brown-black, umber, ember-peach.
records.purpose: Transition. A dip to black closes the intimate beat and hides a big scale jump: the next framing is about 2x wider (figures about half the size), so the pull-back skips its middle in darkness.
records.recipe_2d: Hidden K4 jump, 12-16 frames: keep #10's accelerating pull-out running, then darken the camera layers (never the captions, which stay in screen space and readable) to the anchor colour. On our light page, better to slide a dark near-arch wiper down from the top at f 1.4 to cover the frame than to fade everything. Under the dark, swap to the extreme-wide plate of #12 (the room about 2x smaller). Use one dip only: no flashes, no zoom back in.

records.composition: The same extreme wide fading up from black. A massive dark near arch sweeps in a big curve across the top ~75% and the left side, rim-lit on its right inner edge. The moon-gate reappears as a bright sliver at bottom centre with the two tiny silhouettes on the sill. Extreme negative space; the camera is tilted up into the vault, so the opening sits at the very bottom.
records.subject_scale: ~15% of frame height (two tiny silhouettes in the lit sliver)
records.move: No camera move (measured static; the frames are dark). Fade-up from black on the new, wider framing, which continues into the next shot.
records.light_colour: Warm backlight returns through the distant window and rims the inside edge of the near arch on the right; the rest stays dark. Brown-black, umber, dusk peach.
records.purpose: Reveal / scale shift. The same two figures, now small and far away inside a vast dark structure: the refuge seen from outside, and how small their warm spot is.
records.recipe_2d: Fade-up over 10-12 frames from the anchor colour onto a K6 locked extreme wide (hold 1.5-2.5 s in our cut, handheld 1 px). Layers: (1) sky in the window, f 0.1, flat peach. (2) The moon-gate wall plate, f 0.85, at about 0.5x #10's scale: circle about 460 px wide centred at x 540, sill at y 1230, the two figures fill-only at 120-160 px (observer range) on the sill. (3) Inner right wall, f 1.0: a step lighter than the arch. (4) Near arch, f 1.4: a warm mid-dark mass (L* 40-50 in our palette, not pure black) covering the top 55-60 % and the left edge, cut by the top and left, its lower edge one big curve from (0, 600) to (760, 1000), with a 30-40 px rim in the sky tint along its right inner edge, the only light on it. The read sits in y 850-1250. Captions on a plate over the arch at y 317-556, or lift that part of the arch to L* >= 70. The dimensions differ from #10 so the jump reads as 'further away', not a zoom.

records.composition: Frame within frame: a big round moon-gate opening, centred, fills ~95 % of the height in a black wall. Silhouette against light: a small child (spiky hair) stands and an adult sits hunched with a long staff, on the sill along the bottom of the circle, either side of centre. Sunset sky as negative space above them, hanging vines cut by the circle's top edge. In the first ~0.3 s a dark out-of-focus foreground mass appears to clear the top-left of the circle (a soft foreground wipe out of the cut).
records.subject_scale: adult ~33 %, child ~26 % of frame height (silhouettes)
records.move: Agree: a gentle 2.8 % pull-back with a ~1.4 % drift that settles (ease-out). It reads as the frame breathing out. It does not reveal anything; it just lets the moment sit.
records.light_colour: Single backlight from the sunset sky through the opening. Everything else falls to near-black, with no fill and no cold light. Peach, apricot, dusty-pink cloud, warm black-brown.
records.purpose: Intimacy and wistful calm: two people share a quiet moment at the edge of their world. This is a textbook refuge looking out at one opening (prospect-refuge), an emotional breather between louder beats.
records.recipe_2d: Cozy 'one opening' shot. L0 sky (f 0.1): 3 flat bands, peach to dusty pink, with 2-3 flat cloud strips drifting 3 px/s. L1 wall with a circular hole (evenodd), diameter 1000 px, centre x 540 y 800 (spans y 300-1300). Make the wall a flat MID (Dusk #8A9AA8, #545F6D lip), not black: PALETTE keeps L*<=40 to ~5 % of a held frame. Captions sit on the flat wall and sky top in y 317-556. L2 sill + figures (f 1.0): a ledge at y 1240; an anonymous back-view seated adult ~320 px and a child ~240 px at x 380 / 650, fill-only anchor (the only dark marks). L3 vines: 5-7 ink strands, 80-250 px, hang from the circle top with a 2 px sway loop over 3 s. Optional L4 out-of-focus leaf mass (f 1.5, no ink) leaves the top-left in the first 0.3 s as a wiper from the previous cut. Camera: scale 1.028 -> 1.00 over 1.7-2.5 s, CAM.slow ease-out, drift +15 px x / -6 px y; wall f 1.15 against sky f 0.1, so the opening tightens slightly as it settles. Hold 0.5 s still at the end (ma).

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll +355°
records.composition: An isolated subject in negative space. A small golden clockwork butterfly sits just right of centre in the upper half, in front of soft vertical columns of light (a defocused window or curtain rhythm). Frame 1 is a bright wing glint.
records.subject_scale: butterfly ~25-30 % of frame height (no person)
records.move: Correction: no real move and no real cut. #14-#19 are ONE continuous ~3.0 s shot (16.29-19.29 s). A scene-change scan finds cuts only at 16.33 s and 19.33 s, so the detector split the shot at wing-glint flashes. The 317 % pan, -47 % zoom and 355° roll are optical-flow artefacts: the flutter and glints dominate a textureless, defocused background. Measured on the background stripes, the camera drifts ~5 % of width laterally (the background slides right) over the first ~1 s, eases back ~1 % and settles. There is no zoom and no roll. In this slice the butterfly flutters into position.
records.light_colour: Warm key from front-left makes specular glints on the gold wings. Cool blue background with pale blue light columns gives warm-on-cold complementary contrast. Gold, cobalt, pale sky-blue.
records.purpose: Wonder and delicacy: it introduces a small, precious, fragile marvel in close-up and opens the 'will it land' beat.
records.recipe_2d: Build #14-#19 as ONE 3.0 s (90 f) shot. L0 background (f 0.15): 5 flat vertical bands 120-260 px wide, alternating cobalt and pale blue, with no ink and only two close values. This is our stand-in for defocus: drop line and detail. L1 hero object (f 1.0): our small precious thing (chip, coin, idea-spark) ~320 px wide, hovering at x 540 y 820 in the hero colour, with 3-4 ink-drawn flap poses on 2s. L2 hand (f 1.1), cut by the bottom edge, comes in later. Camera: near-locked, handheld 1-1.5 px float, plus one lateral follow drift of 45 px (4 % W) over 0-1.0 s with CAM.ease, settling back ~10 px by 1.6 s. Glints: <= 2 small specular pops per second (safety: <= 3 flashes/s). This slice (0-0.5 s): the object flutters in from x 380 to x 560, with one glint on its first frame.
records.measured: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll +355°

records.composition: Same framing: the butterfly sits just right of centre in the upper half of the frame, against soft vertical light columns. Its wings go from raised and back-lit to flat as it glides slightly lower and right.
records.subject_scale: butterfly ~25-30 % of frame height
records.move: Correction: part of the continuous #14-#19 shot, with no cut. The +39.5 % zoom, 22 % pan and -5° roll are flow artefacts from the wing flutter. The real camera is in its slow ~5 % lateral follow drift, with no zoom.
records.light_colour: Warm gold back/side-light through the raised wings, which glow translucent. Cool cobalt and pale blue columns behind. Gold, cobalt, pale blue.
records.purpose: Sustains the wonder: the creature is alive and weightless. The flutter rhythm is the shot's motion, not the camera.
records.recipe_2d: Slice 0.5-0.88 s of the single 3 s shot (see #14). Hero object at x 540 -> 600, y 820 -> 860; wing poses: raised (lit rim, one step lighter fill for translucency) -> flat glide. Camera continues the 45 px CAM.ease follow drift, handheld 1 px, no zoom or roll. Background bands at f 0.15 move only ~7 px in this slice: just enough to sell telephoto depth.

records.measured_move: push-in + pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -35°
records.composition: The butterfly stays just right of centre with its wings raised, then glides right. In the last frame a fingertip edges into the bottom-centre of the frame: the first hint of the hand.
records.subject_scale: butterfly ~25-30 % of frame height; hand just entering at the bottom edge
records.move: Correction: part of the continuous #14-#19 shot. The 37 % tilt and -35° roll are flutter artefacts. The real camera is finishing its ~5 % lateral drift and starting to settle. The new event is the hand breaking the bottom edge.
records.light_colour: Same: warm gold glints on the wings against the cool blue column background. Warm skin tone appears at the bottom edge.
records.purpose: Sets up the beat: a person's hand arrives, turning a creature study into an encounter.
records.recipe_2d: Slice 0.88-1.26 s of the single shot (see #14). The hero glides to x 620 and wings flatten. At ~1.1 s the hand layer (L2, f 1.1, skin flat fill, 3 px ink) breaks the bottom edge at x 420; only fingertips show, below y 1700 (a mass may run under the UI zone). Camera: drift ends at 1.0 s and eases back ~10 px by 1.6 s, handheld 1 px.
records.measured: push-in + pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -35°

records.composition: The butterfly hovers centre-right while a hand rises from the bottom-left as a diagonal leading line toward it. Background columns are unchanged.
records.subject_scale: butterfly ~30 %; hand ~20 % of frame height, cut by the bottom
records.move: Mostly agree in magnitude: the camera is essentially locked with a slight float. The 3° roll and 1.3 % pull are flutter noise within the continuous #14-#19 shot, not real moves.
records.light_colour: Warm gold wings and warm skin share the warm side against the cool blue background, so warm-cool contrast separates the subject and hand from the world.
records.purpose: Anticipation: the reach creates a small tension (will it land, will it fly off?).
records.recipe_2d: Slice 1.26-1.6 s of the single shot (see #14). The hand rises from y 1750 to y 1450 along a diagonal from the bottom-left (x 300) toward the object, ease-out; the object hovers at x 600 y 840 with one wing beat. Camera: settled, handheld 1-1.5 px only.

records.composition: An index finger extends up and right toward the butterfly, which flutters just above and right of the fingertip. The hand-to-butterfly diagonal leads the eye.
records.subject_scale: butterfly ~30 %; hand ~30 % of frame height, cut by the bottom
records.move: Correction in part: the camera stays near-locked. The 4.7 % push and -3° roll mostly reflect the butterfly's flutter and the hand's rise filling more of the frame. If there is a real move, it is <= 1-2 %.
records.light_colour: Warm gold and skin against cobalt and pale blue columns. The glints peak as the wings open.
records.purpose: Peak anticipation just before contact: the reach is held for a beat.
records.recipe_2d: Slice 1.6-2.0 s of the single shot (see #14). The finger extends: hand top from y 1450 to y 1180, fingertip ending at x 560 y 1150 (inside the stage, never in the bottom 35 %). The object dips from y 840 to y 1000 to meet it, wings open, with one glint. Camera: handheld 1 px; optionally start a 1-2 % CAM.slow push anchored on the fingertip, carried through #19.

records.composition: The butterfly lands on the extended fingertip, centre-left. Its wings close, then open wide and rim-lit in the last frame. The hand enters from the bottom-left as a strong diagonal base, with soft columns behind.
records.subject_scale: butterfly ~30 %; hand ~35 % of frame height, cut by the bottom and left
records.move: Partly agree: a slight 2-4 % push-in feel late in the shot. Some of the measured push is the hand rising and the wings spreading. Treat it as a near-locked frame with a gentle push that lands on the landing.
records.light_colour: The warm gold wings open into a bright rim against cool blue, the warmest and brightest frame of the sequence. Gold, skin peach, cobalt.
records.purpose: Payoff: a tender connection. The marvel trusts the person and the beat resolves in intimacy.
records.recipe_2d: Slice 2.0-3.0 s of the single shot (see #14). Land at 2.0-2.6 s: the object settles on the fingertip (x 560 y 1120) with a 6-10 px dip-and-recover over 8 f; wings fold, then open wide once, with a lit rim (one step lighter fill). Camera: CAM.slow push 1.00 -> 1.03 anchored on the fingertip, peaking late (~75 %), then a 0.4 s still hold. Cut out on the hold. In our videos this is the 'it works / it's yours' payoff insert.

records.composition: God's-eye plan view with strict centred symmetry. Six identical dark caskets with cog emblems lie in a row across the middle. Three uniformed honour guards stand down each side. A speaker at a lectern is top centre, flanked by two lit braziers, with one figure in red off to the upper left. Floor tile lines converge on the lectern and act as leading lines.
records.subject_scale: figures ~7-8 % of frame height; caskets ~35 %
records.move: Agree: a measured 6.5 % pull-back with a slight drift, peaking past mid-shot. It slowly widens the pattern of the ceremony. The shot is essentially one plane, so there is no parallax.
records.light_colour: Cold, dim, even top-down ambient on slate stone. The only warm accents are two amber brazier flames, plus one red costume. Slate blue-grey, navy, amber, a touch of red.
records.purpose: Solemn establishing of a ceremony: loss and institutional order become a pattern seen from above. Detached, formal, heavy.
records.recipe_2d: K10-style high view, once per video, on rows or a crowd, never on one person. A single plan-view plane with no perspective. 9:16 can't hold six objects across, so restack them as a 2 x 3 grid of identical objects (each ~300 x 170 px, at x 330 / 750, y 800-1300) or one vertical column of 4-5 receding up the frame. L0 floor: flat Dusk #8A9AA8 with 2 px #545F6D tile lines converging on a focal object at x 540 y 650. Keep the floor flat (no ink) across the caption band y 317-556. Figures: 3 per side at x 130 and x 950, 70-90 px, heads and shoulders from above, fill-only. Two warm pools (amber pop, 90 px, one ring) at x 380 / 700, y 650. L1 objects and figures at f 1.03 against the floor's 1.0 for a hint of height. Camera: scale 1.065 -> 1.00 over 2.8 s, centred, CAM.slow peaking ~60 %, drift 35 px right. Hold the last 0.5 s.

records.composition: Centred symmetry with one-point perspective in a grand hall. A huge circular stained-glass window with a cog and four-point-star emblem dominates the centre like a halo or target. Ceiling beams converge on it from the top corners and dark columns frame both sides. A long table with small silhouetted figures sits low at the bottom. Frame within frame.
records.subject_scale: figures ~6 % of frame height; window ~65 %
records.move: Agree: locked off with no meaningful drift. All the life is in the light; the stillness is the statement.
records.light_colour: Strong crimson backlight through the round window is the only key. Everything else is silhouette, with a red sheen on the table and floor. Monochrome crimson, coral glass, maroon-black.
records.purpose: Power and menace: it establishes the seat of authority. The locked camera reads as control, building tension before someone speaks.
records.recipe_2d: K6-style locked wide in an interior. L0 back wall with a round window, diameter 860 px, centre x 540 y 760. Glass is a flat light coral (L* >= 70) in its upper part so captions in y 317-556 sit on it; keep the emblem (ink 3 px, hero or threat colour) below y 600. L1 ceiling: 4-6 converging beams from the top corners to the window rim, y 0-320, ink 2-3 px. L2 columns: dark masses x 0-150 and x 930-1080, cut by top and bottom. L3 table at y 1180-1240 with 3-5 silhouettes, 70-120 px, fill-only. Camera: locked, handheld <= 1 px, 3.0 s. Life from 1-2 small things: dust motes drifting 4-6 px/s through the window's light, or one figure shifting. Colour: for a threat, use our cold ladder instead of Arcane's warm red (the threat is never warm). Keep red or warm only if the hall belongs to the people affected.

records.composition: An over-the-shoulder reveal in a dark cavern. A glowing violet geometric sigil (a ring with radiating light-bar spokes) floats beside a rock face on the right third. A rocky ridge crosses mid-frame as a diagonal leading line toward it. As the camera pulls back and pans, a dark out-of-focus silhouette (a raised arm and shoulder, a figure watching) slides in to fill the left half.
records.subject_scale: foreground silhouette cut by the frame (out of focus); sigil ~45 % of frame height
records.move: Agree: a 12.6 % pull-back combined with an ~11 % lateral move. The sigil slides right in frame while the foreground silhouette enters from the left. The move accelerates (ease-in) and is still moving at the cut, carrying momentum out.
records.light_colour: The only source is the cold violet emissive sigil, which lights cave haze and rock faces. The foreground silhouette carries a faint violet rim; everything else is near-black. Violet, ultramarine, lavender haze, black.
records.purpose: Mystery and discovery: the pull-back reveals that someone is watching or reaching for a powerful, dangerous thing. Unease, plus momentum into the next cut.
records.recipe_2d: L0 far cave wall (f 0.2): flat dark violet-navy, with one haze band a value step lighter behind the sigil. L1 rock ridge (f 0.5): a diagonal from the lower left (x 0, y 1150) up to the sigil. L2 sigil (f 0.6) at x 720 y 820, 380 px: flat lavender line spokes plus one halo ring a step darker, no blur, steady (no flicker); in our videos this is the hero object being discovered. L3 foreground silhouette (f 1.4): anonymous back/3-4 back shoulder and arm, x 0-420, cut by the left and bottom edges, no ink, slightly lighter than black with a 2 px violet rim. Camera: scale 1.13 -> 1.00 over 2.7 s with an accelerating ease-in, plus a truck that shifts the frame ~108 px (10 % W). The silhouette, at f 1.4, travels ~150 px into frame (~2 px/f, under the 15 px/f cap). Cut while still moving and start the next shot already in motion. The silhouette can double as a dark wiper.

records.composition: Silhouette against light. In the left foreground a lone figure is seen from behind or 3/4 behind, head and shoulders down to the waist, cut by the left and bottom edges, looking up. The rest of the frame is a dark hall of towering art-deco stained-glass windows lit white (vertical bars, chevrons, arrow shapes), symmetric about the centre, with diagonal light shafts through haze. Vertical lines dominate.
records.subject_scale: silhouette figure ~70 % of frame height, cut by the left and bottom edges
records.move: Agree: a barely perceptible 1.7 % push with most of its speed in the first few frames, then a drift (it reads as ease-out). It is close to a held frame.
records.light_colour: Hard cold white backlight through the windows, with diagonal god-rays from the upper right through haze. Near-monochrome: white, pale cyan-cream, grey haze, black.
records.purpose: Awe and reverence with isolation: a single person stands before monumental light (an ideal, an institution) in contemplation, at a moment of decision.
records.recipe_2d: K8/K5 hybrid. L0 window wall (f 0.85): a tall symmetric geometric window, x 240-1000, y 150-1450, built from flat cream-white shapes (bars, chevrons) on near-black. Keep one broad flat white panel behind the caption band (y 317-556, no mullions inside it). L1 light shafts (f 0.6): 2-3 flat parallelograms, one value step lighter than the dark air, angled ~25° from the upper right, widening downward; 10-20 dust motes drift through them at 3-5 px/s. L2 figure (f 1.0): an anonymous back-view silhouette, head at y ~720, shoulders spanning x 0-380, cut by the left and bottom edges, fill-only anchor, the only large dark mass. Camera: push 1.00 -> 1.02-1.03 over 3 s, anchored on the window (anchorDepth 0.85), CAM.slow with a fast first 0.3 s that then drifts. The figure grows slightly faster than the wall: subtle parallax. Low-angle feel: the window's top cut by the frame and lines converging upward ~3-5°.

records.composition: A sky-dominant vista following the rule of thirds. A tall slender tower on the left third fires a blue energy beam horizontally right into the clouds, a leading line across the frame. Towering golden cumulus fills the upper ~70 %, with small airships dotted in the sky. A dense skyline of spires and domes runs along the bottom ~25 %.
records.subject_scale: no figure (airships ~2-3 % of frame height)
records.move: Agree: a tiny 1.6 % pull-back that starts early and fades out; effectively a held vista with a breath.
records.light_colour: A low warm sun from the upper right, behind the clouds, gilds the cloud tops; shadows fall in cool teal-blue. The blue beam is a cyan accent. Warm-cool complementary: gold, ochre, sky blue, teal, cyan.
records.purpose: Establishing awe and optimism: a prosperous, sunlit city of progress. It gives breathing room and a sense of place, the bright counterweight to the dark interiors.
records.recipe_2d: A layered vista stacked vertically. L0 sky (f 0): flat blue. L1 far cloud mass (f 0.1): golden flat fill, cut by the top, cool shadow side one step darker; keep the caption band y 317-556 either clear sky or flat cloud at L* >= 70. L2 near cloud (f 0.2). L3 airships: 3-4 at 20-60 px, drifting 5-10 px/s. L4 tower (f 0.4) at x 300, y 650-1500, with a flat cyan beam (14 px core plus one halo a step darker) from its top at y ~700 out to the right edge; the beam pulses slowly over 2 s, no flicker. L5 skyline (f 0.6), y 1400-1920, cut by the bottom (it may run under the UI). L6 foreground roof corners (f 0.9). Camera: scale 1.016 -> 1.00 over 3.2 s, CAM.slow peaking early (~20 %), then drift; clouds drift 3-6 px/s. Hold >= 1.5 s still-ish. Use it as an opener or breather, never directly after another scale wide.

records.composition: Frame within frame, centred: a big round lattice window (a lit room hanging in a cavern) sits at centre-top, ringed by dark rock masses cut by every frame edge; glowing crystals and bulb-plants scattered in the bottom third lead the eye up to the window.
records.subject_scale: tiny figures inside the window, about 4% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: a slow push of about 5% drifting a little up-left. The speed is back-loaded (peak at 81%), so the camera is still moving into the window at the cut, as if being drawn in.
records.light_colour: Cold bioluminescent emerald from the crystals below, a dim violet glow inside the window; teal-black overall, the window is the only warm-ish focal light. Palette: emerald, teal-black, violet.
records.purpose: Establishing plus scale: a small lit refuge with people in it, swallowed by a vast hostile dark. Shows where we are and how small the group is in one image.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps. Layers: (1) cave back, flat near-black navy, f 0.1; (2) rock pillars left and right, cut by top and side edges, f 0.55; (3) round lattice window, diameter 640 px, centre (540, 900), line-art mullions over a violet-amber glow (glow disc 1.5x at 30%), with 4-5 tiny fill-only figures at 0.035 H on its sill, f 1.0 (subject); (4) hanging rock or roots from the top edge in y 0-290; (5) foreground crystals and bulb-plants in the bottom 20%, soft cyan-green bloom, f 1.4. Camera: ShotCam push 0 -> 5% over 2.7 s (81 frames), anchored on the window, drift x -23 px, y -18 px, ease-in (slow first half, peak speed in the last 20%), cut while still moving. Life: 10-15 spores rising 6-10 px/s, crystal glow pulsing +/-8% over 2 s. Keep y 290-600 a flat haze plane for captions.

records.composition: Frame within frame plus a silhouette against light: a tall, blown-out doorway right of centre, heavy dark curtains and walls filling about 70% of the frame; a small figure stands at the foot of the doorway, off-centre on the right third, with bright negative space above it.
records.subject_scale: about 25% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: locked off, no camera move. The stillness and the light do the work.
records.light_colour: Hot warm-white daylight pouring through the doorway from behind (pure backlight), spilling a light path across the floor towards camera; the interior is deep green-black. Strong warm-outside/cold-inside contrast. Palette: cream-white, bottle green, black.
records.purpose: A threshold moment: a small person at the edge of the dark, facing a bright world. Anticipation, longing, a decision about to be made.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920 suits the tall doorway. Door slot x 330-820, y 240-1500, flat near-white #F2EBDD (the brightest value, the pop), so captions sit in ink on its flat field at y 317-556. Curtain plane at left x 0-330, cut by top and bottom, dark green-grey, inked folds, f 1.3; pillar at right x 820-1080, f 1.2; back wall and floor, f 1.0. Light spill: a trapezoid from the door base widening to the bottom edge, 35% alpha warm. Figure: fill-only #1F2433 silhouette at 0.22-0.25 H, feet at y 1480, x 600, 2 px warm rim. Camera locked, handheld 1 px. Life: 20-30 dust motes in the beam drifting 4-8 px/s, curtain edge swaying 3-5 px on a 3 s loop. Hold 3 s (90 frames). Natural start for a K9 frame push-through into the light on the next beat.

records.composition: Centred symmetry: a back-view silhouette of a man, head and shoulders down to below the waist, covering the lower centre of a huge glowing round window (a vault-door-like porthole with radial spokes), so the frame within a frame holds him. Dark wall and clutter around it.
records.subject_scale: about 65% of frame height, cut by the bottom (back view)
records.move: Agrees: a pull-out of about 4.4% with a slight drift right. It accelerates (ease-in) and is still moving at the cut, so the room opens up around him.
records.light_colour: A magenta-violet glow through the round window behind him gives a hard rim on his shoulders and head; everything else is near-black. Cold and unnatural. Palette: magenta, violet, charcoal.
records.purpose: Power and brooding: a figure alone with his plans, facing a glowing portal. The pull-back that keeps speeding up widens his isolation and makes the room feel bigger than him.
records.recipe_2d: Round window, diameter 760 px, centre (540, 1000), top at y 620, so captions sit on the flat dark wall above at y 317-556 (lift the wall to a mid value there). Radial mullions and rim in line art, violet-magenta fill, glow 1.4x at 35%; stone wall around it, f 0.8. Back-view figure fill-only #1F2433, shoulders 0.5 W wide, head top at y 900, cut by the bottom (about 0.53 H), 2-3 px magenta rim, f 1.0. Foreground desk edge or pipe in the bottom corners, f 1.3. Camera: push 1.045 -> 1.0 over 2.9 s (86 frames), anchored on the head, x drift +24 px, ease-in (CAM.reveal start, no landing), cut while moving. The 0.8/1.0/1.3 parallax separates figure from wall. Life: window glow breathing +/-8% over 2 s.

records.composition: Foreground object plus rack focus: a child's crayon drawing lies on a diagonal across the lower right, out of focus at first; two adults embrace in the mid-ground upper left (rule of thirds) against a dark patterned wall. Focus shifts from the couple to the drawing, which is sharp by the end.
records.subject_scale: couple about 75% of frame height; drawing fills about 40% of the lower right
records.move: Agrees on the camera: a pull-out of about 4.5% drifting right, front-loaded (fast at the start, then settling). Not measured but visible: a rack focus from background to foreground during the move.
records.light_colour: Dim, cold blue night interior, low key; the drawing catches the most light (soft warm yellows with blue crayon lines), so focus and value move together. Palette: midnight blue, slate, crayon yellow and blue.
records.purpose: Intimacy tied to the stakes: a private embrace, then the attention moves to the child's drawing, the thing being protected or remembered. A symbolic object carries the emotion.
records.recipe_2d: Stack it vertically: couple in the upper half (x 150-650, y 600-1150, 0.3 H) against a wallpaper wall, f 0.7, wall kept flat in y 290-600 for captions; the drawing as a tilted paper plane, f 1.4, lower 40% (x 250-1080, y 1150-1920, cut by the right and bottom edges). Rack focus in our ink style, without a camera blur: the out-of-focus plane loses its outlines, is lifted one value step towards the haze and gets a 10-14 px blur; start with the couple sharp and the drawing soft, crossfade the two states over 1.5 s (frames 15-60) so the drawing ends inked and sharp and the couple soft. Camera: push 1.045 -> 1.0 over 3 s (90 frames), x +24 px, y +10 px, front-loaded ease-out (peak in the first 0.5 s, then settle and drift). The drawing gets a warm radial pool at 40%.

records.composition: Rule of thirds: an ornate glass pavilion with warm lit windows fills the right two-thirds on a rise; bare trees frame the left and top right, broken columns and a path lead in from the left; misty negative space on the left. The warm windows are the focal point.
records.subject_scale: tiny figure near the entrance, about 5% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: a slow push of about 3% drifting slightly left and up, easing in and out (peak mid-shot). A calm approach.
records.light_colour: Overcast, cool grey diffused daylight with mist; warm amber light glows from the pavilion's windows, a warm pop in a cold world (Hopper-style). Palette: fog grey, sage, amber.
records.purpose: Establishing a refuge: a warm, lit house in a cold, misty world. Invites the viewer in and sets up comfort before a scene inside.
records.recipe_2d: Sky and mist field across the top 30% (y 0-560, flat #D9DEE5, the caption field), bare branches cut by the top-left edge in y 0-290, f 1.3; pavilion (x 180-1000, y 600-1250), f 1.0, with 6-8 window panes #F2C86B and glow 1.5x at 30%; tiny figure at 0.04 H at the door (x 620, feet at y 1230), steady and not flickering; far misty hill, f 0.1; trees, f 0.3; foreground grass and a broken column bottom left, f 1.4. Camera: K5 slow push, ShotCam push 0 -> 3.3% over 2.8 s (85 frames), anchored on the door, x drift -17 px, y -8 px, CAM.slow ease-in-out. Life: a mist band drifting 6 px/s, 2-3 falling leaves. Use it as the cozy outside look at a refuge before cutting inside.

records.composition: Centred symmetry: a red-hot forge or anvil block on the central axis in the lower middle, a pipe dropping to it from the top centre, a hexagonal back wall whose lines converge on the axis; two dim figures flank it left and right in shadow.
records.subject_scale: two figures, each about 20% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: almost static, a slight pull-out of about 1.3%, like the room breathing, peaked mid-shot.
records.light_colour: One practical light: the red-orange forge glow from the centre, low, underlighting the floor and the figures' inner sides; everything else is charcoal. Hot against black. Palette: ember orange, rust, charcoal.
records.purpose: Tension and focus on the work: two people facing each other across a hot core (where things get made). Could be a standoff or a collaboration; symmetry makes it a ritual.
records.recipe_2d: Forge block at x 420-660, y 1150-1330, core #E8552B with a floor glow ellipse 2x wide (radial 50% -> 0); pipe or chain from the top edge at x 540 down to the forge (the top-edge object); hexagonal back-wall frame lines converging on the axis, f 0.7; two fill-only figures at 0.2 H, at x 280 and x 760 (keep out of the right rail: x <= 780 below y 840), orange 2-3 px rim on the sides facing the forge, f 1.0; floor lip foreground, f 1.3. Camera: push 1.013 -> 1.0 over 2.8 s (85 frames), centred anchor, no drift, CAM.slow. Life: irregular glow flicker +/-6%, 3-6 sparks rising 30-60 px/s. Captions on a lifted smoke-haze panel in y 290-600 (flat mid value) above the pipe.

records.composition: Leading lines and symmetry: shafts of cyan light studded with glowing rune nodes fan up and converge towards a vanishing point at the top centre, behind a dark machine silhouette cut by the top edge.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Agrees: locked off. All motion is in the light (nodes glowing along the beams).
records.light_colour: Self-lit electric cyan-blue beams and rune nodes against deep navy; almost monochrome, high saturation, bloom on every node. Palette: cyan, electric blue, navy.
records.purpose: Awe and power: a symbolic insert of the technology or energy itself. Scale without a person: it makes the force feel bigger than anyone.
records.recipe_2d: Vertical suits converging lines. 7-9 beams (strips 12-40 px wide, core #6FD3FF, halo 3x at 25%) radiating from a vanishing point at (540, -200) above the frame, fanning to the bottom edge; diamond rune nodes of 30-50 px along each beam; a dark machine silhouette at top centre (y 0-420, cut by the top), K7 worm's-eye logic. Two beam planes (near f 1.0, far f 0.6) used only for a 1 px handheld drift. Camera locked. Life: brightness waves travelling up the beams at about 400 px/s, nodes pulsing out of phase, faint shimmer. Hold 3 s (90 frames). Captions in the dark gap between the central beams at y 317-556 (keep beams out of that band), or play it wordless as a beat between lines.

records.composition: Centred and radial: a circular platform with broken curved railings at the centre, a tiny figure in the middle, and a spiral of broken planks and debris swirling around it; the planks act as leading lines pointing inward.
records.subject_scale: about 3% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: a rising pull-out of about 8% with a 1.5-degree roll and a drift right of about 5% of the width, a slow corkscrew up and away from the figure. Speed peaks early to mid-shot, then eases.
records.light_colour: A dim violet ambient wash with a vignette darkening to black at the edges and a slight glow at the centre. Palette: dusk violet, plum, black.
records.purpose: Aftermath and isolation: one small person at the centre of a wreck, seen from above (fate looking down). Builds dread just before the blast in shot 33.
records.recipe_2d: Overhead plan: platform disc 0.35 W at (540, 900), broken railings as curved line-art arcs, figure as a top-down head-and-shoulders blob at 0.025 H at the centre. Debris in 3 planes, laid out radially towards the centre: floor debris f 1.0, a mid-air ring f 1.25, near-camera planks f 1.6 (outlines dropped, value lifted, cut by the frame edges). Camera: push 1.09 -> 1.0 (pull-out 8.3%) over 2.8 s (85 frames), anchored on the figure, rotating the whole stage 0 -> 1.5 degrees around the figure (a gentle crane twist; keep it under 2 degrees, since the look doc rules out spins), x drift +53 px, ease-out (peak at about 35%, then settle). Near planes scale 1.6x the floor's change, which gives the depth. Life: 3-4 planks still tumbling at 10-20 degrees/s, dust. Cut straight into the shot 33 flash.

records.composition: Centred and radial, the same overhead debris vortex as shot 32: the centre erupts in violet light that blooms outward through the ring of planks.
records.subject_scale: no readable figure (lost in the flash)
records.move: Agrees: locked off for 12 frames. All the movement is the light blooming from the centre.
records.light_colour: A violet-magenta explosion flash from the centre, white-hot core, lighting the undersides of the debris; bloom over everything. Palette: electric violet, magenta, white.
records.purpose: Shock: a half-second flash cut, the instant of the blast. Punctuation and a transition device.
records.recipe_2d: Reuse shot 32's overhead layers at its final framing so the flash reads as continuous. 15 frames at 30 fps: frames 0-3 dark; frames 3-8 an additive radial bloom from (540, 900), radius 0 -> 1.2 W, white core into #B07CFF at 70%; rims facing the centre switch on, 2-3 px, on every debris plane; frames 8-15 the bloom holds and spreads past the edges; optional 4-6 px shake on frames 3-8. Hard cut at the peak to the next shot (or a single violet-white frame). A cut-on-flash transition between two beats or worlds.

records.composition: Frame within frame, centred: dark pillars at the left and right edges, a row of silhouetted audience heads along the bottom, a tiny lit speaker on a stage on the central axis, and a colossal carved relief or statue behind filling the upper 70%, cut by the top. The planes are stacked and flattened.
records.subject_scale: speaker about 7% of frame height; monument over 70%, cut by the top
records.move: Agrees: a pull-out of about 5% drifting right, peaked mid-shot. Pulling back adds the crowd and the pillars around the speaker.
records.light_colour: A cold, pale blue wash on the monument and the stage edge (moon or stage light from the front and above); audience and pillars near-black silhouettes. Palette: ice blue, steel, indigo-black.
records.purpose: Public stakes plus scale: one small person addressing a crowd in front of a monument of power. Places the individual inside the institution.
records.recipe_2d: K6/K7 hybrid. Monument relief fill-only #BAC3CE with 1.5 px ink, f 0.9, filling y 0-1150 cut by the top; relief detail kept light in y 317-556 so captions sit on a flat pale field. Stage platform at y 1150-1300 with a lit edge line; speaker at 0.06 H on the axis (feet at y 1240), cold rim, a slow gesture loop, f 1.0; audience silhouette band at y 1350-1920, irregular heads 60-90 px wide, #1F2433, f 1.15 (fine in the bottom UI zone); pillar slabs at x 0-90 and x 990-1080 cut by top and bottom, f 1.25. The small parallax spread gives the telephoto squash. Haze steps per plane as in COZY_AND_SCALE section 4. Camera: push 1.05 -> 1.0 over 2.4 s (73 frames), anchored on the speaker, x +29 px, y +12 px, CAM.ease. Life: heads swaying 1-2 px.

records.composition: Deep layers from bottom to top: big flowers in the extreme foreground along the bottom, a tiny robed figure on the meadow left of centre (rule of thirds), pines at mid-left, a cloud bank sweeping across, a snowy mountain on the right, open blue sky in the upper 40% as negative space.
records.subject_scale: about 7% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: almost still, a slow push of about 1% drifting slightly left. Just breathing.
records.light_colour: Bright, high-key daylight from the upper left: saturated blue sky, white clouds, fresh green meadow, pastel pink and orange flowers, soft shadows. Warm and calm. Palette: sky blue, white, meadow green, blossom pink.
records.purpose: Idyll, memory or dream: a peaceful breath right after the violet violence of shots 32-34. A person small in a beautiful, safe world; the hard value and colour contrast across the cut resets the viewer.
records.recipe_2d: Sky across the top 40% (y 0-770, flat #8FC3EA lightening to the horizon; captions at y 317-556 on the pale sky); cloud bank in 2 layers, f 0.2 and 0.3, drifting right 8-12 px/s; snowy mountain at x 480-1080, peak at y 650, cut by the right edge, f 0.15; pines at mid-left, f 0.6; meadow plane at y 1150-1500 with the figure at 0.06 H (x 400, feet at y 1350), f 1.0; foreground flower row, blooms 120-260 px, cut by the bottom and left edges, y 1500-1920, f 1.5. Camera: push 1.0 -> 1.013 over 3 s (89 frames), anchored on the figure, x -9 px, CAM.slow. Life: flowers swaying +/-3 degrees on a 2.5 s loop, a grass ripple, clouds drifting. Cut into it from a dark shot for the contrast jolt.

records.composition: Frame within frame plus a silhouette against light: a balcony canopy edge across the top with hanging lanterns, terrace floor at the bottom, a far figure silhouetted against the setting sun on the central axis. A second character enters in back view from the left foreground (over-the-shoulder) and walks towards the centre and into depth, so the blocking creates the depth.
records.subject_scale: far figure about 25% of frame height; foreground figure about 70% on entry (cut by the bottom), smaller as she walks in
records.move: Effectively locked off. The measured 1-degree roll and roughly 1% pan most likely come from the large walking figure polluting the optical flow, not from the camera. All the motion is blocking, and the shot is held for a long 5.75 s.
records.light_colour: A low sun on the horizon directly behind the far figure (backlight, rims on both figures), red-orange hazy sky, warm almost monochrome; the city skyline in two haze planes of rust and brown; the lanterns are dark shapes. Palette: blood orange, amber, rust-brown.
records.purpose: Reunion or farewell: the locked frame lets the walk carry the emotion; back views hide the faces so the viewer projects onto them; the sun marks the far person as the goal. Patience as a dramatic tool.
records.recipe_2d: Canopy as an angled beam edge in y 0-180 (not a flat full-width band) with 3-4 lanterns on 60-200 px cords as top-edge objects, f 1.2; sky gradient #E8735A -> #F2B26B (flat enough in y 317-556 for captions); sun disc 180 px #FFE3A0 at (540, 1050) with glow 3x at 40%; far towers, f 0.15, around L* 55; near rooftops darker, f 0.4, in y 800-1250; terrace edge at y 1250. Far figure fill-only at 0.2 H on the axis in front of the sun, 3 px rim. Foreground character in back view enters from the bottom left (starting x -200, 0.65 H, cut by the bottom), walks to x 560 over 3-4 s while scaling 1.0 -> 0.6 and her feet rise towards y 1300 (a perspective walk), 2 px rim. Camera locked, handheld 1 px; keep figures at x <= 780 below y 840 (right rail). Hold 5-6 s (about 170 frames). Life: lanterns swaying 2 degrees, heat shimmer around the sun.

records.composition: Frame within frame and rule of thirds. A lit island fortress fills the left-centre. A lone back-view figure stands on a boat deck at the right third. A dark mast and rigging wall off the right edge, and the boat rail cuts the bottom. A long sight line across the water ends on the fortress.
records.subject_scale: figure ~38% of frame height, cut at the knees by the rail; the fortress ~55% H
records.move: Agrees: a slow dolly pull-out (~7%) that speeds up, with a slight rise and -1 deg roll. It feels like the boat drifting back from the figure. It cuts while still moving.
records.light_colour: Cold night with a crimson horizon band behind the fortress as backlight. A cold white lighthouse beam sweeps from the fortress top, and two green lanterns are the only warm-ish points. Palette: near-black teal, crimson, cold white, toxic green.
records.purpose: Establishes a destination with dread: a lone person on our side looks across dark water at the place they are heading. The pull-out sets them adrift: prospect with no refuge.
records.recipe_2d: Layers back to front (f = parallax factor): (1) sky f 0, a Dusk-ladder night field with one ragged crimson cloud band at y 760-860 as a one-off accent. (2) Fortress f 0.1, a flat dark slab at x 140-620, y 470-1120 (0.34 H) with 5-7 thin cold-white window slits. A lamp disc sits on top, and a fill-only beam wedge (50-60% opacity) sweeps 25 deg over the shot. (3) Haze band f 0.2 at y 1050-1200, one value step lighter. (4) Water f 0.4 with 3 broken reflection dashes under the slits and a green buoy lantern at x 260, y 1180. (5) Boat deck and rail f 1.0 across the bottom 28% (y 1380-1920), with a second lantern at x 760, y 1330 (Glow; the two lanterns are the pop, <= 3%). (6) Figure f 1.0, back view, 0.30 H, head at y 840, cut by the rail at the knees, x 600-720; the coat hem lifts 6 px on a 2 s loop. (7) Mast and rigging f 1.35: a trunk at x 860-1000 cut by the top and bottom, plus 3 ropes entering from the top right, covering the UI rail. Camera: ShotCam push 0.07 -> 0 (pull-out 7%) over 2.9 s, ease-in, cut while moving. Drift +11 px x, +20 px y, roll -1 deg. Captions go in the plain cloud field at y 317-556 above the fortress.

records.composition: Centred radial symmetry, a god's-eye view. A cog-shaped round table with a sunken centre well sits on the axis, ringed by ~7 seated figures. Diagonal light shafts cross the frame from the upper left and lower right, and geometric floor lines radiate outward.
records.subject_scale: each seated figure ~10% of frame height; the table ring ~85% H
records.move: Agrees: a near-static pull-out / crane-up from straight overhead (~2%), almost invisible. The life comes from the light shafts and dust, not the camera.
records.light_colour: Cold white shafts slant down through haze from high windows. Each seat sits in its own small pool on grey-brown stone, with dark gaps between. Palette: slate grey, umber, cold white.
records.purpose: Power and institution: a council seen from above, formal and ordered. The god's-eye view makes the people pieces on a board. A tableau, not a character beat.
records.recipe_2d: A true plan view with no perspective, so the zoom is a uniform scale (top-down has almost no parallax). Layers: (1) floor f 0: flagstones in 2 values with radial lines converging on x 540, y 960; the walls show only as dark trapezoids in the four corners. (2) Cog table: diameter 820 px (0.76 W) centred at x 540, y 980, with an inner well disc of 420 px and 3 concentric rings. (3) 7 seat tokens on the ring at ~51 deg steps: top-down head and shoulders 70-90 px, papers as small white rectangles, each in a lighter elliptical pool of 150x110 px. (4) Light shafts in screen space: 2-3 flat translucent wedges (one value lighter, 35-45% opacity) entering from the top-left and bottom-right corners and landing on seats (LightShaft), with 2-3 px dust motes drifting 6 px/s inside them. Camera: scale 1.02 -> 1.00 over 2.7 s with peak speed at ~35%, drift +10 px x, +5 px y, no roll. In 9:16 the ring fills the width, and the plain floor above it (y 317-556, no lines) is the caption field. Use it once per video as K10, on a committee or crowd, never on the lone subject.

records.composition: Silhouette against light, on the rule of thirds. A seated figure in a high-backed chair sits left of centre, hand to chin, in 3/4 back profile. A glowing warm glass case is cut by the right edge, cool hazy instrument lights fill the background, and desk clutter darkens the bottom.
records.subject_scale: seated figure ~65% of frame height (head to the desk line)
records.move: Agrees: a very slow push-in (~1%) toward the figure, almost a held frame.
records.light_colour: Cold blue-cyan ambient haze with scattered point lights behind. A single warm amber practical (the glass case) at the right edge is the only warm source. The figure stays a pure silhouette. Palette: steel blue, black, amber.
records.purpose: A mind at work: a brooding, scheming figure in their own lair. Hiding the face makes us lean in, and the warm light at the edge hints at what they are thinking about.
records.recipe_2d: Layers: (1) back wall f 0.1: cool flat fill (Dusk #545F6D-#8A9AA8) with 8-12 lighter discs (instrument lights, 10-30 px, fill-only, no blur). (2) Apparatus and shelves f 0.3: line-art pipes and jars in mid values, cut by the top-left. (3) Chair and figure f 1.0: anchor-dark silhouette with no interior ink, 3/4 back, facing right, hand at chin. Head 140 px at x 420, y 760; body and chair back run down to y 1500, with the chair back cut by the left edge. A 2 px rim one value lighter only on the cheek facing the lamp. (4) Warm practical f 1.0: a glowing glass case cut by the right edge at x 860-1080, y 520-1100, with an amber core and one lighter ring (the pop) and a small pool on the desk below. (5) Desk edge and clutter f 1.3 across the bottom 22% (y 1500-1920). Camera: push 1-3% over 2 s, CAM.slow, anchored on the head, handheld <= 1 px. One micro loop: bubbles rise in the case at 20 px/s, or one finger tap. Captions on the plain upper wall at y 317-556.

records.composition: Silhouette against light. A hulking upper-body silhouette sits right of centre in a field of dense red smoke. The brightest smoke is top right, the darkest bottom left, with negative space on the left.
records.subject_scale: silhouette ~75% of frame height (head near the top third, body cut by the bottom)
records.move: Agrees: locked off, with all motion from the figure stalking through drifting smoke. Shots 40-42 read as one continuous take that the cut detector split at a light flare.
records.light_colour: A fire glow from the upper right backlights thick red smoke, and the figure is pure black. Monochrome palette: crimson, blood red, black, with an orange hot spot.
records.purpose: Menace: the threat as a shape. An anonymous figure moves through a hellish haze, building tension before we see a face.
records.recipe_2d: Build 40-42 as ONE 3.2 s locked shot. Layers: (1) smoke field f 0: 3-4 flat crimson value bands, darkest bottom left, lightest top right. Soft cloud shapes drift left 8-12 px/s on two sub-layers (f 0 and 0.1); the smoke is the only motion. (2) Hot spot: a flat orange-red disc in the top-right corner (x 820-1080, y 0-500) breathing +-8% opacity. (3) Figure f 1.0: a solid anchor-dark silhouette with broad shoulders, head at x 600, y 620 (~0.10 H), upper body running off the bottom edge, walking left and down at ~25 px/s. A thin smoke veil in front (f 1.2, 20% opacity) softens the edges. (4) Debris silhouettes in the bottom left, f 1.2. Camera: locked, handheld <= 1 px. Hold 1.2 s, then the single flare (shot 41). In our palette, the red stands in for our one threat colour; it never touches the people we side with.

records.composition: Same frame as 40: silhouette right of centre in red smoke. The top-right hot spot flares bright orange.
records.subject_scale: silhouette ~75% of frame height
records.move: Corrected: not a new shot. It is a 0.33 s fire flare inside the same locked take; the cut detector split it on brightness. The camera is static.
records.light_colour: For a moment the backlight flares from crimson to hot orange in the upper right. The figure stays black. Palette: orange, crimson, black.
records.purpose: A pulse of danger, like a fire roaring or an explosion off-screen. It punctuates the stalk and raises the heartbeat.
records.recipe_2d: Inside the 40-42 shot at ~1.2 s: the top-right hot spot jumps two value steps (to a coral/orange like #FF7A4D) in 2 frames, the smoke bands brighten one step, then everything decays over 8 frames. The figure stays anchor-dark, and the camera stays locked. Sync it to a sound hit (a whoomp). Safety: one pulse only, never more than 3 flashes in any 1 s.

records.composition: Same frame as 40. The silhouette hunches and reaches an arm out to the right edge, smoke still brightest top right, negative space left.
records.subject_scale: silhouette ~75% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: locked-off continuation of 40. The figure turns and reaches right; the motion is the subject and the smoke.
records.light_colour: The same red smoke backlit from the upper right, settling back after the flare. Palette: crimson, black, orange.
records.purpose: Holds the threat a beat longer, as the figure acts (reaching or grabbing). It sets up the hard cut to a face.
records.recipe_2d: The last 1.7 s of the 40-42 shot. The figure's arm extends toward x 1000 at 25-40 px/s and the shoulders dip 20 px, while the smoke keeps drifting. Camera locked. End as the head crosses the hot spot or the dark shoulder fills the frame, and use that dark mass as the cut point (a WipeCut on the shoulder) into the ECU of shot 43: shape to face, a K1-style jolt.

records.composition: Centred symmetry split by the blade. The eye band fills the width, from the furrowed brows to just under the eyes. A knife blade stands vertically on the centre axis between the eyes, and a fire rim burns down the left edge.
records.subject_scale: face larger than the frame: the eye band spans the full width, about 35% of frame height
records.move: Corrected: the window opens with ~0.3 s of the red silhouette (a cut the detector missed), then hard-cuts to an ECU of eyes. On the ECU: a slow push-in (~6%) that speeds up, with a slight -2 deg roll and lateral drift. Part of the roll and pan may come from the cut.
records.light_colour: A warm orange fire key from the left and behind rims the face. A cool white specular stripe runs down the steel blade, and the skin is in muted brown. Palette: burnt orange, umber, steel white.
records.purpose: The stare-down before the fight: resolve and confrontation. The blade splitting the face is a symbol of the violence to come. The accelerating push tightens the tension.
records.recipe_2d: In 9:16 the face plate (f 1.0) is scaled so the eye band spans 1.1 W, with the eye line at y 820 and the cheeks cut by both edges. The forehead above is a plain skin field (no ink) for captions at y 317-556, and the nose bridge runs down to y 1250. Brows are furrowed, with a nick in the right brow. Blade f 1.25: a 40-60 px steel sliver on x 540 from y 350 to 1600, tapering to a tip at the top, with one white specular stripe. Fire rim: a flat orange wedge on the left edge (x 0-160) with ember dots (f 1.5) rising 30 px/s. The warm dark background (f 0) shows only at the corners. Camera: push 0 -> 6% over 3.2 s, ease-in; drift ~40 px sideways, so the blade slides ~10 px against the face (that is what sells the depth); roll 0 -> -2 deg. Cut while still accelerating.

records.composition: Frame within frame on a diagonal. A dark teal hair curtain fills the top ~55%, and a red-brown scarf collar wraps the bottom. Between them, a shadowed diagonal slit where the face hides.
records.subject_scale: face larger than the frame (~150% H), with no features visible yet
records.move: Agrees: a tiny push-in (~1%) on a hidden face. It is likely the start of one continuous take with 45-46, split by head motion.
records.light_colour: Low-key. A warm red-orange glow from below and the side catches the folds of the collar. The cool teal hair has dark strand lines, and the face gap is near-black. Palette: deep teal, oxblood, ember orange.
records.purpose: Mystery and anticipation: someone hiding, face withheld. It is the held breath before the reveal.
records.recipe_2d: Build 44-46 as ONE ~3.6 s eye-reveal shot. Layers: (1) shadow face plate f 0.95: near-black warm brown, with a diagonal slit band from x 0, y 1150 to x 1080, y 850 where the eye will appear. (2) Hair mass f 1.0: deep teal anchor fill over the top 55% on a diagonal, with 6-8 tapered strand inks, cut by the top, left and right edges; keep y 317-556 free of strands for captions. (3) Collar/scarf f 1.1: oxblood folds filling the bottom 40%, with a warm orange rim on the top fold (key from below right). Eye hidden. Camera: push 1% over 0.67 s, ease-in. Life: a breath lifts the collar 6 px.

records.composition: Same diagonal hair/collar frame as 44. The head begins to lift, and a shadowed lid edge appears in the slit right of centre.
records.subject_scale: face larger than the frame (~150% H)
records.move: Corrected: the camera is essentially locked. The measured pan and -1.5 deg roll come from the head lifting and tilting, not from the camera.
records.light_colour: The same low warm key from below. As the head rises, the warm light starts to reach the skin under the eye. Palette: deep teal, oxblood, ember.
records.purpose: The reveal begins: the hidden figure stirs. A short, tense beat.
records.recipe_2d: Middle 0.46 s of the 44-46 shot. The hair mass slides up 30-40 px and rotates -1.5 deg (head lift, not camera). The collar drops 10 px, and a shadowed lid edge with lashes appears in the slit at x 600, y 980; warm light rises one step on the cheek under it. Camera locked. Animate the lift on 2s (12 fps holds) for a hand-drawn feel.

records.composition: A glowing eye revealed in the diagonal slit between the hair curtain (top) and the collar (bottom), drifting toward the centre. A frame within a frame made of hair and cloth.
records.subject_scale: face ~150% H; the eye ~20% of frame height
records.move: Mostly agrees: a slow push-in (~1%) plus a reframe up and left (~4% of width each way) that settles onto the revealed eye. Part of the pan may still be the head rising.
records.light_colour: The eye glows pink-violet with a bright specular point, and the lower lid is lit warm from below. Hair and collar stay dark. Palette: deep teal, oxblood, rose-pink highlight.
records.purpose: The reveal pays off: the eye opens and looks out, and the watcher is watching back. An intimate, unsettling turn.
records.recipe_2d: Last 2.5 s of the 44-46 shot. The eye opens over 0.3 s (lid shape tween). The iris is the pink-violet pop (~1.5% of the frame) with a white specular dot and one lighter ring (Glow, no blur), and the lower lid is lit warm. Camera: drift ~45 px left and ~40 px up plus push 1%, ease-out (CAM.ease), landing with the eye at x 560, y 900 in the stage zone. Hold the last 0.8 s with a 1 px drift, then cut while it drifts. Captions stay on the plain hair field at y 317-556.

records.composition: Rule of thirds. A hooded young woman's face on the left third looks up and off-frame left. Big soft white blossoms and leaves fill the right two-thirds as a near foreground. A bright, washed-out sky gives negative space top left, and a red scarf wraps the bottom-left corner.
records.subject_scale: head ~75% of frame height (hood to chin)
records.move: Agrees: a long slow pull-out (~14% over 8.7 s) with a diagonal drift. Focus racks from soft to sharp on the face, then the near flowers take focus as the face softens.
records.light_colour: High-key soft daylight backlit from above, with blooming whites and a cyan sky corner. Warm skin, crimson scarf, and tiny cyan sparkle flecks. Palette: cream white, sky blue, leaf green, crimson.
records.purpose: A release after the dark run: a quiet, hopeful, wistful breath, like a memory or a longing. The brightness contrast resets the viewer.
records.recipe_2d: Layers: (1) sky f 0: a flat cream-white page (L* >= 90) with a cyan corner at top left (x 0-300, y 0-500). (2) Figure f 1.0: hooded young woman in 3/4 view looking up and left past camera. Head 0.40 H at x 80-620, y 520-1290; brown hood, red scarf; cut by the left edge and the bottom. (3) Flowers f 1.45: white 5-petal blossoms (220-360 px) with leaves at x 560-1080, y 300-1600, cut by the right edge. (4) Sparkles f 1.6: 3-6 px cyan dots drifting up 10 px/s. Rack focus in our flat style: the sharp plane gets full ink and full colour; the soft plane is fill-only, one value lighter, with a simplified outline (or a 6-10 px blur if the look allows). The face goes soft to sharp over the first 1.5 s; near the end the flowers take focus while the face softens. Camera: ShotCam pull-out, compressed for short-form to 8% over 3.5-4 s, ease-in, drift +40 px x and +40 px y. Never hold 8.7 s; cap at 4 s. Captions on the plain sky at y 317-556.

records.composition: Centred symmetry. A gaunt face fills the centre and stares at the camera, with near-black negative space on both sides. At the end, a green haze washes over the whole frame.
records.subject_scale: head ~65% of frame height
records.move: Agrees: a steady pull-out (~9%) from a centred face with a diagonal drift, peaking past the midpoint. It ends in a green haze wash that works as a transition.
records.light_colour: Hard, dim top light carves the cheekbones and sinks the eye sockets into shadow. One eye glows orange-red, the single warm point. Sickly green ambience grows into a full-frame wash. Palette: bile green, charcoal, rust orange.
records.purpose: The villain's presence: cold, calculating menace confronting the viewer. The green wash is a chemical, poisoned mood and a dissolve into the next scene.
records.recipe_2d: Layers: (1) background f 0: a green-black field with a faint haze plane one step lighter in the upper third. (2) Head and shoulders f 1.0: gaunt face centred on x 540, head 0.38 H with the crown at y 600 (below the captions) and the chin at y 1330. Grey-green highlights on the brow and cheekbones, anchor-dark eye sockets, and one eye an orange glowing disc (the pop, ~1%) with one lighter ring. The dark rust collar is cut by the bottom. (3) Haze wash f 0.6: a flat bile-green plane whose opacity ramps 0 -> 70% over the last 0.8 s, turning the frame into a green field for a match-dissolve into the next shot. Camera: pull-out (push 0.09 -> 0) over 3 s with an ease-in-out skewed late (peak speed at ~60%), drift +45 px x and +20 px y. Captions on the plain field above the head at y 317-556; in our palette that field becomes a light Dusk step at L* >= 70, and the dark lives only around the face.

records.composition: Strong diagonals. The figure is seen from directly above, head off-centre right, arms spread in an X toward a gilded ornamental rail that runs on a diagonal from top-left to bottom-centre. Both hands are cut by the frame edges, the near hand foreshortened and larger. Pale haze fills the empty right side as negative space.
records.subject_scale: figure (head, back, both arms) fills ~100% of frame height; head ~35%
records.move: Agree. A slow ~10% push-in with a 3° clockwise roll and a slight drift up-left. It reads as a floating, drifting camera (the feel of being underwater), not a deliberate move.
records.light_colour: Soft, diffuse top light through milky water or haze, no hard shadows. Warm skin and gold against cold teal glow lines. Palette: milky sage, cream, gold, teal, blue-black hair.
records.purpose: Intimacy and vulnerability. The god's-eye view pins the character flat and alone, struggling or submerged. A quiet, airless beat before a bigger move.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 2.8 s (84 f at 30 fps). Layers, back to front: L0 bed/floor: flat pale sage-cream wash with thin cyan geometric glow lines, 4 px blur. L1 gilded rail: a thick ochre band in ink with 2-3 highlight strokes, on a diagonal from (-60, 1180) to (620, 1980). L2 figure from directly above: dark hair mass ~320 px wide at (640, 1000), back and shoulders toward the top-right, both arms reaching down-left to grip the rail; near hand ~280 px, cut by the left/bottom edge. L3 haze: 2 soft white gradients at 20% opacity plus ~30 specks drifting up 8 px/s. Keep y 317-556 a flat pale field for captions. Camera: scale 1.00->1.10, roll 0->+3° pivoting on the head, drift -35 px x / -55 px y, ease-in-out (cubic-bezier 0.45,0,0.55,1). Parallax: L0 0.85x, L3 1.3x. Optional 1-2 px sine wobble on hair and hands to sell water. Cut or dissolve out through the white haze.

records.composition: Frame within frame. Dark vertical window mullions, cut by the top and bottom, frame a gothic spired building outside. The tilt brings the tall window's lower panes and a cluttered sill of silhouetted bottles, jars and crystals into the bottom third. Inside is dark; outside is the light side.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Agree. A pure tilt down: parallax 0.98, so a pan-head rotation, not a crane. It travels ~0.42 of the source frame height from the spires outside to the clutter on the sill, fast at first, then settling to a stop.
records.light_colour: Overcast grey daylight backlights everything through the window. The interior is in silhouette with small warm amber glints and a few cyan/violet glows in the glassware. Palette: storm grey, charcoal, amber, cyan.
records.purpose: Establishing plus a move from outside to inside: from the imposing city out there to the private room we are in. Prospect-refuge: we are held inside, looking out at the power.
records.recipe_2d: Tall plate 1080x2700, 6 s (180 f), or 3.5-4 s for our pacing. Layers: L0 overcast grey sky gradient. L1 gothic spired skyline as a flat mid-grey silhouette, spires in plate y 600-1100 so the caption band y 317-556 starts on flat sky. L2 window: 3 near-black mullions 90-140 px wide at x 40, 520 and 980, cut by the top and bottom, and a heavy sill at plate y 1900. L3 sill clutter: bottle/jar/crystal silhouettes 120-320 px tall, cut by the left and right edges, with 6-10 small glints (amber, cyan, violet). L4 dark interior wash over the bottom 25%. Camera: the frame window travels down 700 px (~0.36 H), ease-out cubic-bezier(0.15,0.7,0.3,1), with ~70% of the travel in the first 40% of the time, then settle. Parallax: none measured; at most L0-L1 at 0.92x for a touch of depth, everything else 1.0. End frame: sill objects fill the bottom 40%, the window glass above them.

records.composition: A silhouette against light, near-centred (slightly right). A masked, goggled figure stands looming, cut by the bottom edge at the shins, with a long club hanging from one hand. A hard white backlight blooms behind the torso. Dark wall and negative space on the left. Dust specks in the foreground.
records.subject_scale: figure ~90% of frame height (head near the top, cut at the shins)
records.move: Effectively locked (a 1% creep). Shots 51-54 are ONE held ~2.9 s low-angle silhouette. The detector's 'cuts' are light flickers: mean luma ~82, a 2-frame drop to 29 at 107.8 s, a 4-frame dip to ~65 at 108.4 s, then a jump to 112 at the real cut into #55.
records.light_colour: A hard white-blue backlight from behind and below the figure, through fog, gives a rim light. The figure is near-black, with no fill. Cold monochrome: slate blue, white, near-black, grey haze.
records.purpose: Tension and menace: a threatening figure is revealed as a shape before a face. The low angle makes them big, and the stuttering light adds dread.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920. Build #51-54 as one 2.9 s shot (87 f) with light stutters, not cuts. Layers: L0 slate-grey wall/fog with a radial white-blue glow ~1100 px wide centred at (600, 1050). L1 two soft grey fog bands drifting +10 px/s. L2 figure silhouette (mask, goggles, coat, club in the right hand, charm at the hip): flat near-black with a 6-10 px pale rim on the light-facing edges, head top at y 620, ~1300 px tall, cut by the bottom edge at the shins, centred at x 600. Draw it from below: legs wider than the head, horizon at y 1600. L3 ~40 dark dust specks plus 3 out-of-focus blobs (12 px blur) drifting down. Captions sit on the dark wall at y 317-556, above the head. Camera for this segment: scale 1.000->1.012 over 1.1 s (34 f), ease-in-out.

records.composition: The same framing as #51: a near-centred backlit silhouette, cut at the shins, dark negative space on the left.
records.subject_scale: figure ~90% of frame height
records.move: Continuation of #51, not a new shot. Opens on a 2-frame near-black flicker (luma 82->29->77) and keeps the slow creep, ~2% here. The parallax value (0.29) is noise from the flash.
records.light_colour: The same cold backlight, which stutters to almost black for 2 frames and then recovers. Palette: slate blue, white, near-black.
records.purpose: Suspense beat: the light failing (a lamp sputtering, lightning, a power surge) makes the figure flicker in and out of existence.
records.recipe_2d: Same plate as #51. Flicker 1: at 1.1 s into the combined shot, drop the L0 glow and the figure's rim to 30% for 2 frames (or flash the whole frame to near-black), then restore over 2 frames. Keep the camera creeping: scale 1.012->1.035 over 0.6 s (17 f), ease-in-out. Optional: 1 frame where the dust specks jump position, to sell an electrical stutter.

records.composition: The same framing as #51-52: a centred backlit silhouette against glowing fog.
records.subject_scale: figure ~90% of frame height
records.move: Agree it is locked. It is still the same held shot; this boundary is a second, softer flicker (luma ~81 -> 65-69 for 4 frames -> 80).
records.light_colour: Cold backlight dimming to ~80% for a beat and coming back. Slate blue, white, near-black.
records.purpose: A second, weaker stutter: rhythm and unease. Two irregular flickers feel organic; one would read as an edit.
records.recipe_2d: Same plate, camera held at scale 1.035. Flicker 2, ~0.35 s after flicker 1: glow and rim to 80% for 4 frames, then back to 100%. Space the flickers irregularly (e.g. frames 34 and 45 of the combined shot) so they read as faulty light, not a beat grid.

records.composition: The same framing: a backlit silhouette, centred slightly right, dark on the left.
records.subject_scale: figure ~90% of frame height
records.move: Agree it is locked: the tail of the held shot. The glow decays slowly (luma 79->76); then a real hard cut on a big brightness jump (76->112) into the sunlit rooftop of #55.
records.light_colour: A cold backlight slowly fading, then a hard cut to warm sunlight. Slate blue to midday blue/terracotta.
records.purpose: Hold, then a contrast cut: dark, menacing Zaun to bright, open Piltover. The light jump does the storytelling.
records.recipe_2d: Same plate, camera locked, 0.7 s (21 f). The glow decays 100->94%. Hard cut on frame 87 of the combined shot straight into the brightest next shot (no dissolve). The luminance jump is the transition, so make the next shot at least 30 L* lighter.

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -15°
records.composition: Starts as a medium close-up: two sisters in profile, screen left, looking right into lead room toward the city. The camera pulls back, arcs right and rises until they are tiny figures on a rooftop deck, backs to us, centre-low.
