Rooftops lead the eye to a sunlit upper city of spires and towers that ends the sight line top-right. Sky ~40%. Foreground chimneys are cut by the frame edges.
records.subject_scale: start: heads ~30% of frame height (cut at chest); end: figures ~9% of frame height
records.move: Agree on the big pull-back plus rising crane arcing right (strong real parallax: 0.67, off-plane 11%). Correct the roll: the sampled end frame's horizon reads close to level, so much of the -15° is probably perspective drift from the crane. In 2D, keep real roll at 3° or less.
records.light_colour: Bright midday sun, key from upper left, crisp shadows. Warm terracotta roofs and brass against a saturated blue sky with white cumulus. Palette: sky blue, terracotta, cream, brass, magenta hair.
records.purpose: Awe and a scale reveal: from two faces to the whole world they want. The dream city opens up and the sisters become small against it, hopeful but tiny. The textbook 'one big move'.
records.recipe_2d: Our ONE big move: the source's 11.5 s compresses to 3.5 s plus a 1.2 s hold (141 f). Layers with crane parallax: L0 sky gradient and 3 cumulus, 0.08x. L1 far upper city: spires, towers, mountains, ending the sight line top-right, 0.2x. L2 mid rooftops, chimneys, one smoke puff, 0.45x. L3 near rooftop deck with the two characters, 1.0x. L4 foreground chimney/ledge cut by the bottom-left corner, 1.35x. Start: camera scale 2.3 on the two profile heads (x 260-520, y 900-1250, heads ~30% H, eyes looking right). Move: scale 2.3->1.0 (-57%). Camera x +520 px: pan right, content slides left at parallax rates. Camera rises 380 px: L3 and L4 slide down 380 / 510 px, L1 only 76 px, so the city rises out from behind the roofs. Roll 0->-3°. Easing cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.45,1), peak speed at ~42%. End: sisters ~170 px tall (9%) at (420, 1450), backs to us. City fills y 600-1300. Sky at least 36% ('exposed' dose), with captions on the flat sky at y 317-556. Hold 1.2 s, then cut to an agency beat (a face) within ~5 s.
records.measured: pull-out + pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -15°

records.composition: A near-black foreground overhang covers the top ~45% of the frame. Below it, a dim undercity street canyon with a sickly green glow at lower centre, a few amber windows, and one cyan pinpoint on the right. Most of the frame is shadow.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Locked over its 0.8 s, but almost certainly the first 0.8 s of #57's tilt, not a separate shot. The real hard cut is at 120.92 s (luma 108 -> 21, out of the sunlit #55). The 121.75 s boundary sits on a one-frame dip (20.6->19.7) with the same 20-27 luma and the same plate, and pan_y is already drifting down.
records.light_colour: Almost no key light. A faint toxic-green glow rises from the depth of the canyon, with tiny warm window pinpoints and cold blue-black shadow. Palette: black-green, acid green, amber dots, cyan.
records.purpose: A hard contrast cut from bright, open Piltover to the dark, oppressive undercity: the world's inequality told by light alone.
records.recipe_2d: Treat #56 + #57 as one shot. These are its first 0.8 s (25 f), on the #57 plate: the frame window starts high, so the near-black foreground overhang (ink edge, cut by both sides) covers the top ~45% and only the green-lit lower canyon shows. Hard cut in from a bright shot (luma ratio ~5:1). Start the tilt immediately but slowly (the first 25 f cover only ~3% of the travel).

records.composition: The 'canyon' dose of enclosure. Towering facades on both sides, cut by the top, with only a thin sky slit at top centre. Converging lines run to a vanishing point near centre, where the green glow is brightest. An ornate bridge railing crosses the lower third with tiny passer-by silhouettes. A dark vertical pole/chain in the foreground splits the frame just right of centre. The tilt ends looking down into the street.
records.subject_scale: tiny passer-by silhouettes ~8-9% of frame height; the place is the subject
records.move: Agree. A long, slow tilt down (~0.8 of the source frame height) with a slight 4.5% push. Near-flat parallax (0.94) means a pan-head tilt, not a crane. The +10° roll builds over 11 s; part is real Dutch drift, part converging verticals. Cap it at ~4° in 2D.
records.light_colour: The key is a sickly green glow from deep in the canyon, back-lighting layered haze. Shadows are cold blue-black, with small warm amber windows and one cyan sign. Palette: black-green, acid green, teal haze, amber pinpoints.
records.purpose: Establishing a place as oppressive: vertical confinement and a toxic atmosphere. The long, slow drift lets the viewer feel how deep and closed-in the city is.
records.recipe_2d: Tall plate 1080x3200, sky slit at most 10%. Layers: L0 sky slit (dusk blue-grey, ~120 px wide) at top centre, 0.6x. L1 deep canyon: an acid-green glow gradient plus tiny layered facades in 3 haze steps, each lighter and greener with distance, converging to a VP at (560, plate y 1700), 0.75x. L2 left and right tall facades cut by the top, 6-8 warm window dots and one cyan sign, 0.9x. L3 ornate iron bridge railing across plate y 2300-2500 with 2-3 tiny silhouettes (~160 px), 1.0x. L4 a near-black vertical pole/chain at x 640, cut top and bottom, and the dark overhang at the plate top, 1.2x. Camera: the frame window travels down ~1150 px (0.6 H) over 5-6 s (the source's 11 s is too slow for 30-45 s videos), scale 1.00->1.045, roll 0->+4°. Easing: slow start, steady middle, ease-out over the last 25%. The green glow pulses ±5% at 0.3 Hz; haze specks drift up 6 px/s. As a confinement beat, keep the captions on the dark flat facade (no windows) in y 317-556.

records.measured_move: push-in + tilt up / crane up + roll +8°
records.composition: Centred vertical. A giant tree trunk rises through the middle, with a spiral staircase and small hut platforms wrapped around it and the canopy spreading over the top. Graffiti-painted walls close the space on both sides as a frame within a frame. A painted round tank with pipes curving up toward the trunk sits at bottom centre as a leading line. Warm light shafts cut in on a diagonal from top-left.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Agree. A slow tilt up the trunk with a 7.6% push, front-loaded. Parallax ~1.04 means it is effectively a tilt, despite the 'crane' label. Half of the +8° roll is converging verticals as the camera looks up; real roll is ~4°.
records.light_colour: Warm golden shafts from upper left through dusty haze. Multicolour murals (red, teal, ochre, yellow) and a green canopy; warm light against teal shadow. Palette: gold, rust red, teal, leaf green.
records.purpose: Awe and the reveal of a hidden wonder. A secret, colourful refuge growing inside the grim city. Vertical scale, but welcoming rather than threatening: wonder, not fear.
records.recipe_2d: Tall plate 1080x2900, a perfect fit for 9:16. Layers: L0 tall walls with murals/graffiti and bunting strings, cut by both sides, 0.85x. L1 tree: trunk centred at x 560, roots at plate y 2300, spiral stair and 2 hut platforms, canopy across plate y 0-900, 1.0x. L2 light: 3 diagonal warm shafts from the top-left (screen blend, 30%) plus floating dust, 0.7x. L3 foreground: a painted round tank with pipes curving up to the trunk, bottom centre, cut by the bottom edge, 1.25x. Draw at a low angle: verticals converge upward ~4°. Camera: start on the tank and lower trunk, tilt up 900 px over 5 s (150 f; the source takes 8.8 s), scale 1.00->1.08, roll 0->+4°, front-loaded easing cubic-bezier(0.3,0.5,0.4,1). End: canopy fills the top 50%, the shafts cross the trunk. Captions sit on a flat, low-detail wall patch in y 317-556.
records.measured: push-in + tilt up / crane up + roll +8°

records.composition: Centred symmetry and a frame within a frame. A vast round window with radial iron tracery glows behind a lone figure in a high-backed chair, back to us, dead centre, silhouetted against the light. Dark shelves of glowing bottles flank both sides, cut by the edges. A cluster of magenta glowing vials sits on the desk just right of centre.
records.subject_scale: seated figure with chair ~20-25% of frame height
records.move: Agree. A gentle 4% pull-back that is almost a hold, front-loaded (most of it in the first third).
records.light_colour: A cold cyan-blue backlight through the round window silhouettes the figure. Green glows on the side shelves, with a hot magenta accent on the desk. Palette: deep teal, cyan, black, acid green, magenta.
records.purpose: Mystery and power: the schemer alone in his lair, seen from behind. Establishing an enclosed space that belongs to the antagonist. The window acts like a halo or a throne.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 3 s (90 f). Layers: L0 round window, a ~900 px circle (or a tall round-topped arch) centred at (540, 1050), so its top clears the caption band at y 317-556: cyan-blue gradient, brightest at centre, faint shapes beyond. L1 tracery: radial iron mullions plus 2 concentric rings in near-black ink, 18-24 px. L2 room: dark shelves cut by the left and right edges with 10-14 small green glowing bottles each, and a desk across y 1550-1700 with 5-7 magenta glowing vials right of centre. L3 the lone seated figure in a high-backed chair, back to us, flat black, ~420 px tall at (540, 1500), centred in the window. L4 dark floor and top wall, where the captions sit. Camera: scale 1.04->1.00, drift +20 px x, ease-out (peak speed at ~30%). Parallax: L2 1.04x, L3 1.0x, L0-L1 0.96x, so the window breathes behind the figure. Under PALETTE, the window is the cool inset and the room the dark surround.

records.composition: Silhouettes against light, rule of thirds. A huge setting sun sits right of centre, crossed by dark cloud bands. An airship silhouette hangs just above and left of the sun. A dark rooftop/dome mass fills the left third and low silhouetted structures run along the bottom. Flat, compressed planes.
records.subject_scale: no figure (airship ~6% of frame width)
records.move: Agree it is locked off. Brightness is constant (luma ~121) and the airship barely moves between samples; the 'uneven' easing is just tiny internal motion (clouds).
records.light_colour: Backlit by a low setting sun straight ahead. Everything else is warm silhouette. Palette: amber, burnt orange, cream-yellow sun, dark umber.
records.purpose: A breather and a transition: time passes, a mood or chapter ends. A romantic, wistful image of the city's ambition (the airship) against the sun. Good under a closing line.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 3 s, camera locked (or a 1% push if it feels dead). Layers: L0 sky: a vertical gradient from rust/umber at the top to pale gold near the horizon. L1 sun: a ~640 px cream-yellow disk at (660, 980) with a soft 200 px bloom. L2 3-4 dark brown horizontal cloud streaks crossing the sun, drifting -6 px/s. L3 airship silhouette, ~260 px long, at (480, 760), drifting +5 px/s. L4 a dark umber dome/rooftop silhouette cut by the left edge, rising to y ~900, and a low skyline/ship silhouette across the bottom 20%. All motion is inside the frame. Captions on the darker upper sky at y 317-556. Good for a fade out or a match cut on the circle (sun -> round window, coin, clock).

records.composition: Negative space with a low horizon: the sea line sits at about 85% of frame height, and sky and clouds fill the top 85%. A cumulus bank is anchored at the left with open sky to the right. Two tiny figures (one in a red coat) are tucked into the bottom-left corner at a pier balustrade, close to the left edge.
records.subject_scale: two figures ~12-15% of frame height, bottom-left corner
records.move: Near-static breath: a very slow pull-back of about 2% with a small drift (about 2% of width) that accelerates gently. It reads as a held frame.
records.light_colour: Soft overcast daylight from the upper left. Warm cream cloud tops against cold slate-teal sea and sky, with one red accent (a coat). Palette: slate teal, cream, grey-blue, red accent.
records.purpose: Breath / reflective pause: two small people facing a huge calm sea. Quiet intimacy inside vastness, a rest beat between intense shots.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 3 layers. SKY fills the frame with clouds on 2 sub-layers: a big cumulus bank cut by the left edge at y 300-900 and thin streaks at y 150-300. SEA is a band at y 1500-1640: flat slate teal with a few horizontal highlight strokes. BALUSTRADE + 2 FIGURES sit at y 1640-1920; the figures are 220-260 px tall at x 90-220, back to camera, one in red. Captions go in the empty sky at y 317-556, right of the cloud bank. Camera: scale 1.021 -> 1.000 over 87 frames, ease-in, drifting x by 24 px. Clouds move at 0.5x parallax and the balustrade at 1.15x. Optional 3-4 px gull sprites. Use it as the cool-down after a scale or action beat.

records.composition: Worm's-eye view up a tall library well. Bookshelf walls cut by the left and right edges converge on an octagonal glass skylight with constellation lines (a frame within the frame). A glowing orb sits at the skylight's centre. Figures and books float upside down near the ceiling, and a small observer stands bottom-left. The converging verticals are leading lines to the orb.
records.subject_scale: floating figure ~25-30% of frame height near the top; observer ~12% bottom-left
records.move: A slow pull-back of about 2% with a slight drift down and about 2 degrees of roll. The motion is uneven, so it feels like floating rather than a dolly.
records.light_colour: One cold source: the white-cyan orb above, with light falling down the shelves. Everything is monochrome blue with white sparkles. Palette: cyan, ultramarine, navy, white.
records.purpose: Awe / wonder reveal: physics breaks (people and books float), and the vertical well makes the room feel endless.
records.recipe_2d: The tall 9:16 frame suits a straight-up look; put the vanishing point at the frame centre. SKYLIGHT: octagon at y 520-1000 with constellation line art, and an orb glow (radial, 260 px) at x 540, y 760. SHELF WALLS: line-art trapezoids converging from all four edges toward the skylight, with the left wall taller than the right (asymmetric). The top wall stays a flat dark field for captions at y 317-556. FLOATING layer: 2 upside-down figures (one 420 px tall near the skylight's upper rim) plus books and pages. PARTICLES: 150 white-cyan dots rising 30-60 px over the shot. Observer in the foreground at bottom-left, 230 px tall, cut by the bottom edge. Camera: scale 1.02 -> 1.00 over 3.0 s, roll 0 -> +1.9 degrees around the orb, y -20 px, uneven easing with the peak at 30% (cubic-bezier(0.3,0.6,0.5,1)). Blue monochrome grade: shelves L* 15-35, orb L* 98.

records.composition: Silhouette against light. A man in a long coat, seen from behind at centre-left, walks toward a fan-shaped neon sign on a street cart (centre, slightly right). The sign sits just right of him, so his dark shape reads against the glow. Foreground silhouettes of loiterers are cut by the left edge, with pink lanterns at left and smoggy towers cut by the top.
records.subject_scale: walker ~70% of frame height, cut at the shins by the bottom; foreground figures at left ~90%
records.move: The measured 69.6% push and 20% pan are inflated by the walker crossing the frame and the drifting smog. On the frames the framing stays nearly constant (sign and foreground silhouettes hold position). Read it as a slow, accelerating follow-dolly behind the walker: the background grows about 5-8% while he stays the same size.
records.light_colour: Practical key: acid-green neon tubes on the cart backlight the walker and the smog. Magenta-pink lanterns are the secondary light; everything else is near-black teal. Palette: acid green, magenta, black-teal, sodium-yellow specks.
records.purpose: Entering a dangerous world: tension and lure. We follow a character into the underworld, toward the light where he is headed.
records.recipe_2d: BG: dark teal towers and smog, cut by the top, with 6-8 small window glows. SIGN: neon fan of 14 tube strokes, 420 px wide, centred at x 600, y 820, with 40 px bloom, on a cart. SMOG: low-opacity gradient band at y 1300-1700, drifting 15 px/s. WALKER: back view, 1300 px tall at x 380-640, shins cut by the bottom edge, green rim light on his right edge. FG: silhouettes at x 0-260, cut by the left and bottom edges, with a pink lantern at x 220, y 600. Camera: follow push on BG, sign and smog, scale 1.00 -> 1.08 over 2.6 s, ease-in. The walker keeps a constant size with a 6 px walk bob at 2 Hz. The FG layer slides 60 px out to the left (1.5x parallax). Neon flicker: 2 dips of 15% brightness. Captions sit on the dark tower area at y 317-556, above the sign.

records.measured_move: slow push-in + tilt up / crane up
records.composition: Centred symmetry: a giant gothic iron arch and lattice fills the frame. A lone figure at bottom centre, seen from behind, raises a fist between two blinding floor lights placed symmetrically left and right. A red streak rises left of centre and a blue one right of centre.
records.subject_scale: head and raised fist only, ~25% of frame height, cut by the bottom edge
records.move: A very short (0.42 s) start of a tilt up (about 6% of width) with a slight push. Its last frame matches #65's first, so it is probably the start of one continuous up-look running through #65-#67; the cut detector likely split it on the firework flashes.
records.light_colour: Two cold white floor lights backlight the figure and the iron arches from below. Red and electric-blue rocket streaks are the accents in a deep navy ambient. Palette: navy, steel blue, white, red, cyan.
records.purpose: Launch / agency beat: a person sets something huge in motion. Anticipation before the burst.
records.recipe_2d: ARCH lattice in line art: thick black ribs on 2 depths (near 1.0x, far 0.85x) over a dark navy haze. Two WHITE BLOOMS (radial, 300 px) at x 230 and x 850, y 1700. FIGURE: silhouette at bottom centre, 480 px tall from y 1440, fist up, rim-lit by the blooms. ROCKETS: red from (420,1650) and blue from (660,1650), each rising 700 px with a 120 px glow trail. Camera: rises 70 px (layers translate down) and scales to 1.013 over 13 frames, ease-in-out. Best built as the first 0.4 s of a single 3 s tilt-up that runs through #65-#67 without a cut.
records.measured: slow push-in + tilt up / crane up

records.composition: Looking straight up into the iron lattice, with no figure. The rib diagonals form chevrons. A red streak at the left third and a blue one at the right third climb as a mirrored pair, and an airship-like hull cuts in from the right edge.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Continues the tilt up (about 5% of width) with a 1% push, ease-in-out. Almost certainly continuous with #64 and #66.
records.light_colour: The rocket streaks are the only light: red against cyan, a complementary pair. The ironwork is a deep navy silhouette. Palette: navy, black, red, cyan.
records.purpose: Rising suspense: carries the eye up from the launcher to where the burst will happen.
records.recipe_2d: Same layers as #64, with the figure now out of frame below. Two streak sprites (8 px core, 40 px glow) climb 500 px in 18 frames and slow as they rise (ease-out on speed). Lattice: near layer 1.0x, far layer 0.85x. Camera: rises 55 px and scales to 1.011 over 0.58 s, ease-in-out. End on the streaks' apex at about y 750, just below the caption block, to set up the burst.

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll -43°
records.composition: The same up-look, with lattice cells as frames within the frame. The red burst blooms in the left-centre cell and a cyan ring opens in the right-centre cell, with small gold bursts in both top corners. The hull is still at the right edge.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: The measured -27.5% pull-out, 43-degree roll and large pans are artifacts of the bursts' radial sparks and the flash. The frames keep the same lattice and hull position as #65 and #67, so the camera is near-static while the bursts open. The cut itself is probably a flash, not an edit.
records.light_colour: Burst flash: red and cyan sparks plus gold corner bursts begin to light the ribs, and the whole frame tints red at the peak. Palette: red, cyan, gold, navy.
records.purpose: Release / payoff beat: the fireworks open.
records.recipe_2d: Burst sprite: 40-60 radial strokes from a centre, growing from 0 to 260 px over 8 frames (ease-out), then fading over 6 frames. Red burst at (330,820); cyan ring of 12 dashed arcs at (700,860); gold mini-bursts (80 px) at (90,620) and (990,600), kept below the caption block. Flash: a global red overlay goes 0 -> 25% on the peak frame and back to 10% in 6 frames, plus a 2-frame near-white flash at 30% opacity. Camera: hold, or at most a 1% push. Do not copy the measured roll.
records.measured: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll -43°

records.composition: Two big bursts side by side, red at left and cyan at right, fill two lattice cells in near-symmetry. The iron ribs now catch warm gold light from the top-left corner, and the hull stays at the right. The lattice works as a frame within the frame.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: A slow push-in of about 1%, front-loaded (fast at the start). The near girders at the bottom move faster than the far ones (measured parallax 2.55).
records.light_colour: The colour flips from cold to warm: the bursts and a gold flood from the upper left light the ironwork amber, with red and cyan as a complementary pair. Palette: red, cyan, amber gold, black.
records.purpose: Celebration climax with a symbolic pair: two colours (two sides, two people) explode side by side as the world lights up.
records.recipe_2d: Bursts at full size (520 px diameter), centred at (320,900) and (760,900), with sparks falling 80 px. The lattice layer gets a gold rim/flood (screen overlay #E8A040, 0 -> 70% over 10 frames, spreading from the top-left). Near ribs at the bottom sit on their own layer and move 2.5x the far ribs. Camera: scale 1.000 -> 1.011 over 1.46 s, front-loaded (ease-out, peak at about 20%). For an 'A vs B' story in 9:16, stack the pair vertically instead: red in the upper cell at y 600-1050 and cyan in the lower cell at y 1050-1500, with captions above at y 317-556.

records.composition: A small pale figure stands on a balcony behind a railing at the left third, dwarfed by a huge ornate red machine (throne- or organ-like) at centre-right that is cut by the top. A dark shadowed mass fills the right edge and orange lamps line the left edge. The railing makes a horizontal band in the bottom quarter.
records.subject_scale: figure ~30% of frame height
records.move: A slow pull-back of about 5% with a slight drift, uneven (fastest mid-shot).
records.light_colour: A monochrome red ambient flood, with warm orange practicals at left and a cool blue strip light along the railing edge for separation. The pale figure is the brightest value. Palette: crimson, rust, orange, black, one cold blue line.
records.purpose: Isolation in a lair: one character alone with a monstrous machine. Menace and loneliness.
records.recipe_2d: BG: red wall with the ornate machine (800 px wide at x 380-1080, cut by the top and right edges). FIGURE: pale, 560 px tall at x 260-400, standing at y 900-1460. RAILING: band at y 1460-1600 with a 6 px cold-blue edge highlight. FG: near-black shadow mass at x 900-1080. Orange lamp sprites at x 40-120, y 600-1100, with 60 px bloom. Grade: red multiply. Camera: scale 1.052 -> 1.000 over 2.6 s, drifting x by 30 px, ease-in-out with the peak at 43%; the FG shadow moves at 1.2x. Captions on the dark upper-left wall at y 317-556.

records.composition: Centred under a huge painted mural of giant faces that fills the upper two-thirds. Two small figures, seen from behind at bottom centre, look up at it. A gnarled tree trunk and a wooden staircase frame the left edge; wooden scaffolds and tall windows frame the right (a frame within the frame). Leaves soften the edges.
records.subject_scale: two figures ~15% of frame height, bottom centre
records.move: A slow, constant crane/tilt up (about 7% of width over 6.25 s) with no zoom: a patient reveal of the mural above.
records.light_colour: Warm golden light from high windows at the right, with amber shafts and dust. Teal-green leaves are the cool accent, and the mural carries rose, blue and ochre. Palette: amber, ochre, rose, teal, warm brown.
records.purpose: Wonder plus refuge: discovering a hidden sanctuary. The scale comforts: people are dwarfed by a community's art, not by a threat.
records.recipe_2d: An ideal 9:16 move. MURAL: a tall 1080x2400 layer of giant painted faces, its top cut by the frame, with a flat painted sky patch at y 317-556 for captions. SCAFFOLD: platform line art at x 760-1080. TREE: trunk, roots and stair at x 0-300, cut by the left and top edges. FIGURES: 2 back views, 280 px tall, at x 470 and x 580, y 1560-1840. LIGHT SHAFTS: 3 diagonal soft bands from the upper right (screen, 20%), plus dust motes. Camera: rises 76 px (7% of 1080; layers translate down) at a constant linear speed over 6.25 s, no scale; up to 240 px also works if the mural needs more reveal. Parallax: trunk 1.3x, figures 1.1x, mural 1.0x, shafts 0.9x.

records.composition: Silhouette against light: a figure reclines on a lounger in the lower right half, head raised. Behind, red triangular ship sails fill the centre-left and pale towers rise in heavy haze. Strong atmospheric perspective gives a flat, painterly background.
records.subject_scale: reclining figure ~45% of frame height, ~45% of width
records.move: Locked off; the measured drift is under 1%, just a breath.
records.light_colour: Bright hazy backlight from a sun high behind the port puts the figure in dark-brown contre-jour against a warm cream sky. The red sails are the only saturated colour. Palette: cream, sand, pale gold, red, dark brown.
records.purpose: Calm leisure / character intro in a sunlit elsewhere, contrasting with the dark city. An image of power at rest.
records.recipe_2d: Locked off. SKY: cream gradient (L* 90+) with painterly texture in the top 40%. MID port: pale low-contrast towers (L* 75-85) and 3 red triangular sails at x 80-700, y 600-1150, fluttering (skew 1-2 degrees at 0.5 Hz). Haze overlay at 30% between MID and FG. FG: terrace and lounger at y 1200-1920 with the reclining figure as a dark warm silhouette with a thin cream rim, about 900 px long on a diagonal (head at x 760, y 1150; feet at x 200, y 1650). Camera: scale 1.000 -> 1.009 over 2.7 s, a barely visible breath. Captions in the sky at y 317-556.

records.composition: Negative space and rule of thirds: a glowing red disc at the left third with a thin blue beam shooting right from it. The rim of a giant cogwheel arcs through the centre, and a dark curved metal housing with blue engraved lines fills the right. The frame is mostly black.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Locked off; the measured drift is under 2%.
records.light_colour: A self-lit red disc (like a red sun or lens) and a cold blue beam. The machinery is dark brown-black with a faint red rim. Palette: crimson, electric blue, black, rust.
records.purpose: Symbolic insert of a mechanism: something aligns or fires. Tension and foreshadowing.
records.recipe_2d: Re-stack vertically for 9:16. RED DISC: 380 px at (300,700), below the caption block. BEAM: 6 px core with 30 px glow, running diagonally from the disc to (1080,1150), pulsing twice (opacity 70-100%). GEAR: rim as a big partial circle (radius 900) centred off-frame bottom-right, teeth in line art, rotating 2 degrees over 3 s. HOUSING: dark dome cut by the bottom-right edge, with 2 blue engraved lines. Camera: locked off with a 0.6% breath. Works as a match-cut hinge: the red disc can become a moon, a dot or a warning light in the next shot.

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up
records.composition: Rueckenfigur: a figure seen from behind on a rooftop edge, centre-left in the foreground, looks out over a vast night city of warm lights. The horizon is high (about 25% from the top) with a skyline of towers, and a full moon sits top-right. A second small figure stands at the right edge, and rooftop clutter is cut by the bottom edge.
records.subject_scale: figure ~35% of frame height
records.move: A slow pull-back (about 25%) while rising and drifting left, settling at the end (ease-out). The city opens out around the figure.
records.light_colour: Cool moonlight from the top right and a teal-green night sky with clouds above warm amber city windows. The figure reads dark against the lights. Palette: teal, deep green-blue, amber, pale moon white.
records.purpose: Reflective ending / stakes: one person facing the whole city. A closing image of quiet scale.
records.recipe_2d: SKY: teal, with a 180 px moon at x 800, y 420 (300 px halo) and clouds at 0.3x. SKYLINE: towers at y 650-900, 0.6x. CITY: carpet of warm window dots at y 900-1450, 1.0x, a few flickering. ROOFTOP FG: y 1450-1920 with railings and pipes cut by the edges, 1.4x. FIGURE: back view, 650 px tall at x 380-520, standing at y 1180-1830. Camera: scale 1.25 -> 1.00 over 5.8 s, ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1)); the camera rises 96 px (8.9% of 1080) and moves 165 px left (layers translate right), nearly still for the last 1 s. Captions over the sky at y 317-556, left of the moon. Use it as the ending or as the video's ONE big move.
records.measured: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up

records.composition: Centred-right silhouette against a bright backdrop: a seated figure, back to camera, holding a tall hooked staff. An organic ribbed lattice fans out behind his head like a halo. A railing runs diagonally across the lower left as a leading line.
records.subject_scale: ~65 % of frame height (seated figure, head down to the bottom edge; the staff reaches ~85 %)
records.move: Agrees: a barely visible push-in (~2 % over 3 s) with a 1 % drift left. Most of it happens in the first moments (peak at 7 %), then it settles: a breathing camera on a still silhouette.
records.light_colour: Strong cold violet backlight through the lattice from behind the figure. The figure is pure black, with no warm counterpoint. Palette: violet, lavender, periwinkle, ink black.
records.purpose: Power and menace through stillness. We see the figure only as a haloed silhouette in his own domain, and the slow push makes us lean toward someone we can't read.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 91 frames at 30 fps. L1: flat violet glow gradient, brightest (L* ~85) at (560, 760) behind the head, parallax 0.2. L2: 10-14 ink ribs radiating from that point past all four edges, lit gaps between them, parallax 0.4; the ribs fade out across y 317-556 so the captions sit on flat glow. L3: seated figure as a flat ink silhouette, back to camera, head top at y 760, shoulders ~800 px wide, cut by the bottom edge at the waist; a hooked staff rises to y 300 at x 380; parallax 1.0. L4: railing as a diagonal from (0, 1500) to (1080, 1760), parallax 1.15. Camera: push-in 2 % with x drift -1 %, ease-out (80 % of the move in the first 15 frames), then hold. Only motion: a slow breath on the figure (scale 1.000 to 1.005).

records.composition: Frame within frame: a dark archway, with an out-of-focus foreground mass covering the left ~35 %. A huge statue on a stepped plinth stands right of centre. A tiny figure sits hunched on the plinth's base in the lower third, small against the monument.
records.subject_scale: person ~12 % of frame height against a statue of ~75 % (about 1:6)
records.move: Agrees: locked off. Only the haze moves.
records.light_colour: Crimson haze backlight from deep down the street, near-black foreground, one small red point in the statue's hand. Palette: crimson, maroon, charcoal, smoke.
records.purpose: Grief and smallness. A tiny person hunches at the foot of a monument (the past, a legacy), so scale serves emotion, not spectacle. The blurred foreground makes us feel we are watching from hiding.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 90 frames. L1: red haze back plane (crimson to maroon gradient) with faint far facades at 15 % contrast, kept flat across y 317-556 for the captions, parallax 0.2. L2: arch and doorway silhouettes on both sides, cut by the top edge, parallax 0.5. L3: statue on a stepped plinth, x 380-1000, head cut by the top edge (colossus cut by the frame), one small red-lit object as the only accent, parallax 0.6. L4: the hunched person on the lowest step, ~220 px tall (11 % H) at (430, 1420), parallax 0.6. L5: blurred foreground mass (24 px blur) down the left edge, x 0-340, parallax 1.4. Camera locked. Animate only a haze drift (x +30 px over the shot) and one small shoulder rise on the person.

records.composition: Skyline at rooftop height. An airship with a giant painted face on its envelope fills the upper-left third. A blazing light burst sits on the horizon at centre. A layered silhouette of roofs and spires runs across the bottom third, with a spire cut by the right edge.
records.subject_scale: no figure (the airship's painted face is the subject, ~30 % of frame width)
records.move: Agrees: a very slow pull-out (~1.5 %) with a 1 % drift. It reads as the city settling, while the airship drifts on its own.
records.light_colour: Low burning light (sun or blast) dead centre behind the city, everything backlit into silhouette. Hot sky over dark rust rooftops. Palette: blood orange, rust, crimson, black.
records.purpose: Establishing shot with ominous scale. A huge painted face hangs over a burning-sunset city: power watching the city, setting the mood before a turn.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 81 frames. L1: sky gradient from deep red at the top to blazing orange at the horizon, parallax 0. L2: glow disc at (540, 1180), r 90 px with a 400 px bloom, parallax 0.1. L3: far spires and towers as a flat dark-rust silhouette, horizon at y 1200, parallax 0.3. L4: airship with a large painted face, ~700 px wide at y 620-900, drifting x +25 px on its own, parallax 0.5. L5: near roofline silhouettes across y 1350-1920 with chimneys and a spire cut by the right edge, parallax 0.8. Camera: pull-out 1.5 %, x drift -1 %, ease-out. Captions in the red sky above the airship (y 317-556).

records.composition: Frontal, near-symmetrical tableau. A huge golden mural wall fills the centre, framed by teal glass windows and columns on the left and a column on the right. A few small figures stand apart on a landing and stairs in the lower third, with a potted plant at the left.
records.subject_scale: ~15 % of frame height per figure
records.move: Agrees: a locked-off tableau.
records.light_colour: Soft daylight from the tall windows on the left washes across a warm gold wall, with cool teal glass and columns as the contrast. Palette: gold, teal, cream, bronze.
records.purpose: Establishes the wealthy world: a gilded hall that dwarfs its people. It works as a contrast cut against the dark lower city (wealth against poverty).
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 80 frames. L1: golden mural wall filling the frame, flat gold (L* ~82) with sparse brown ink relief lines, nearly empty across y 317-556 for the captions, parallax 0.3. L2: tall teal glass windows down the left edge (x 0-220) and a teal column on the right (x 900-1080), both cut by the top, parallax 0.6. L3: landing and staircase across y 1250-1600 with 3-4 small figures 230-280 px tall standing apart (~13 % H), parallax 0.8. L4: potted plant cut by the bottom-left corner, parallax 1.1. Light: a diagonal daylight shape from the left windows across the mural (+8 L*). Camera locked; an optional 1 % push keeps it alive.

records.composition: A figure cut by the left edge, head bowed, hair or hood in profile. Large dark negative space on the right holds two glowing lamps like a pair of eyes at ~60 % of the width and ~40 % of the height. Thin curved cables or ribs converge overhead.
records.subject_scale: grows from ~40 % to ~75 % of frame height as the figure rises into frame
records.move: Corrects the measurement: the camera is essentially locked, since the two lamps hold the same screen position for the whole shot. The measured -17.8 % zoom, 38 % pan and -4° roll come from the out-of-focus figure rising and leaning into frame from the left edge toward the lens, accelerating as it comes.
records.light_colour: Two warm practical bulbs glowing through haze, behind and above. Cold blue-grey ambient light, only a faint rim on the face. Palette: slate, smoke grey, amber points.
records.purpose: Tension and isolation: a person alone under two lamps, with the empty side pressing in. This opens a staccato run of jump cuts (77-80), all anchored on the lamps.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 58 frames. L1: dark slate back wall with 5-6 thin curved rib lines converging toward the top (a dome seen from below), parallax 0. L2: haze sheet (white, 8 % opacity, slow drift). L3: the ANCHOR, two amber bulbs on thin stands at (620, 760) and (740, 735), r 20 px with a 140 px soft glow; they never move. L4: the figure as a soft-edged dark silhouette (6 px blur), hair or hood shape with a faint cool rim on the face, entering from the left edge: x -300 to +60 and scale 0.75 to 1.2 (head from ~40 % to ~75 % H), ease-in. Camera locked: don't reproduce the measured numbers, they are the figure's motion. Cut on the figure's motion into 78.

records.composition: A blurred near-black silhouette (shoulder, head, swinging braid) sweeps across the frame and eclipses the two lamps, which stay at the same screen spot as in 77.
records.subject_scale: the blurred body fills ~70 % of the frame by the end
records.move: Partly agrees: a short pan (~6 %), but most of the flow is the blurred foreground silhouette crossing the lens and covering the lamps, which works as an in-camera wipe.
records.light_colour: The same two warm bulbs in haze, now being blotted out by a black foreground. Cold grey ambient. Palette: charcoal, slate, amber.
records.purpose: Transition and tension: the silhouette swallows the light, a jolt that acts as a wipe in the staccato run.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 13 frames. Reuse L1-L3 from 77 with the lamps at exactly the same screen position. L4: a heavily blurred (24 px) near-black silhouette (shoulder and braid) sweeping left to right, x -600 to +700, ease-in-out, covering the lamps from frame 6. Camera: pan 6 % (65 px) following it. The near-black final frame is the cut point (wipe).

records.measured_move: slow push-in + tilt up / crane up + roll -6°
records.composition: An out-of-focus silhouette, head and shoulders from behind, fills the right half and turns away. The two lamps sit just left of the head, near the same screen spot again. The frame tips briefly off level.
records.subject_scale: ~85 % of frame height (silhouette)
records.move: Partly agrees: a quick lurch in half a second (tilt up ~9 %, roll -6°, push 3 %, ease-in-out). Part of it is the silhouette turning, and it reads as an unsteady handheld jolt.
records.light_colour: Warm bulbs in haze behind a black foreground figure, cold grey ambient. Palette: smoke, slate, amber.
records.purpose: Unease: the rolled, lurching frame shows the character's inner instability inside the staccato run.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 15 frames. Anchor lamps as in 77, shifted no more than 40 px. L4: silhouette head and shoulders on the right half (x 560-1080, top at y 500, ~85 % H), 10 px blur, rotating away. Camera lurch, ease-in-out: tilt up 90 px (8.6 % of width), roll to -6°, push 3 %. Cut while it is still rolled and release the roll in the next shot. Keep the roll at 6° or less.
records.measured: slow push-in + tilt up / crane up + roll -6°

records.composition: The two lamps sit near centre in empty hazy dark, with the silhouette's edge slipping out of the right side of the frame.
records.subject_scale: partial silhouette, ~60 % of frame height, on the right edge
records.move: Agrees: locked. The 2 % pan is the figure sliding out to the right while the lamps stay pinned.
records.light_colour: Two warm bulbs in grey haze, the figure gone dark. Palette: slate, smoke, amber.
records.purpose: Release and absence: the figure leaves and the lamps remain, which closes the stutter run.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 13 frames. Anchor lamps at the same position. L4: the silhouette's edge on the right (x 880-1080) slides out +200 px, ease-in. Camera locked; the last 5 frames show the lamps alone in haze. Whole 77-80 run: 99 frames (3.3 s), 4 hard jump cuts with one fixed screen anchor, so the eye never loses its place.

records.composition: Frame within frame: a near-black interior mass covers ~70 % of the frame, with a dark machine and a ring silhouette on the right. ONE arched opening at the upper left looks down a deep street canyon to a sun on the vanishing point. A glowing red dome sits at the bottom of the opening.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Agrees: locked off.
records.light_colour: Sunset at the vanishing point backlights the canyon, with sunlit facade edges on one side. Everything outside the opening is near-black. Palette: black, ember orange, rose, dusk violet.
records.purpose: Transition built on prospect and refuge: from the dark, a window onto the lit city at sunset. It reads as longing for a world out of reach and establishes the time of day.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 80 frames. L1: sky gradient from rose to orange, a white-gold sun disc (r 40 px) at the vanishing point (400, 1300) with bloom, parallax 0.2. L2: tall street-canyon facades converging to the VP, sunlit edges on the left wall, shadowed right wall with 2-3 lit windows, parallax 0.4. L3: a glowing red dome at the opening's lower edge (400, 1420), r 160 px, parallax 0.6. L4: near surround as a full-frame dark wall (dense hatching or a dark mid-tone so the page still reads) with ONE arched opening, x 140-660, y 600-1540 (~24 % of the frame, read inside y 600-1250), plus a dark ring-and-machine silhouette on the right half, parallax 1.0. Camera locked; for life, push only L1-L3 by 1.5 % so the world beyond breathes while the opening holds still. Captions in light ink on the dark wall above the arch (y 317-556).

records.composition: A big tree in the centre spreads its canopy like a roof. A broken colonnade frames the left, a stone urn sits in the right foreground cut by the edge, and a crowd of mourners in dark clothes gathers in a loose arc under the tree, mid-right.
records.subject_scale: ~12 % of frame height per mourner
records.move: Agrees: locked, with a near-invisible constant creep (0.6 % in, ~1 % drift) over 4.25 s.
records.light_colour: Cool blue dusk ambient from a pale sky behind, with tiny warm torch flames in the crowd as the only warm points. Palette: slate blue, teal, moss, small amber.
records.purpose: Establishes a solemn gathering (a funeral). The long locked hold lets the grief settle, and the tree shelters the mourners.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 128 frames. L1: dusk sky, flat slate blue with a paler band at y 317-600 behind the captions, parallax 0.1. L2: faint far ruins and buildings at y 900-1150, parallax 0.25. L3: a large tree, trunk at x 560 rising from y 1300, canopy across y 0-310 and out past both sides (a canopy roof cut by the top and sides), parallax 0.5. L4: broken colonnade cut by the top on the left (x 0-260), parallax 0.6. L5: 12-16 mourners in dark clothes, 200-240 px tall, in a loose arc under the tree at y 1200-1450, 2-3 torches with flickering amber flames, parallax 0.6. L6: stone urn cut by the bottom-right corner, parallax 1.2. Camera: linear creep, zoom +0.6 % and x -1 % over the whole shot. Animate only the torch flicker and a slight leaf sway.

records.composition: A god's-eye view of a cluttered den laid out like a map. A workbench with a warm lamp sits centre-left, a big round green glowing stained-glass disc lies lower right as the brightest shape, and a magenta neon glow fills the top corner. The edges fall into a dark vignette.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Agrees: locked off.
records.light_colour: Three motivated sources on a dark teal floor: green light through the round glass, a warm amber lamp pool, and a magenta neon accent. Palette: teal-black, mint green, amber, magenta.
records.purpose: A god's-eye establishing shot of a private lair. The overhead flattens the room into a map, so it feels isolated, intimate and slightly uncanny.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 80 frames, drawn flat top-down with no perspective. L1: dark teal-black floor with scattered clutter (papers, cables, crates) and an edge vignette. L2: workbench seen from above at x 200-760, y 650-1050, with a warm amber lamp pool (220 px glow) at its corner. L3: a round green stained-glass disc at (720, 1450), diameter 560 px, glowing mint and spilling green onto the floor. L4: magenta neon glow in the top-left corner, cut by the edges. Camera locked. Animate a slow lamp flicker (brightness ±4 %) and drifting dust motes. Captions over the plain dark floor at y 317-556.

records.composition: A strong diagonal: a tall, bright, window-shaped slab of light lies across the right third from the bottom up to the top-right. A small red-clad figure lies or kneels on the cracked tiles at the upper left, the large empty floor between them.
records.subject_scale: ~8 % of frame height
records.move: Agrees: a slow pull-out (~3 %) that speeds up toward the cut, as if the distance to the figure keeps growing.
records.light_colour: Warm cream daylight from the window-shaped slab, a cool grey-teal stone floor, and one red accent on the figure. Palette: stone grey, sage, warm cream, red.
records.purpose: Isolation and aftermath: a small figure alone on an empty floor beside a slab of light, with the camera drawing away. It reads as loneliness and consequence.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16, 88 frames. L1: top-down stone floor of large square tiles in ink, a few cracked and lifted, cool grey-teal, parallax 1.0. L2: a long bright window-shaped slab of light, cream (L* ~92) with a warm bloom, lying diagonally from (620, 1900) to (1080, 600), ~18 % of the frame. L3: a small figure in red, ~150 px (8 % H), lying or kneeling at (330, 700) among shards. L4: loose debris fragments, parallax 1.06 to sell the height. Camera: pull-out 3 % with x drift +1 %, ease-in (accelerating toward the cut). Captions over the plain floor at y 317-556, clear of the slab.

records.composition: Horizon at about 55 % of the height. Twin chimney towers stand on the left-third vertical, and the bridge is a leading line toward a vanishing point right of centre. A foreground building/statue cut by the right edge frames the shot. Sky fills the top half.
records.subject_scale: no figure (the twin towers are about 35 % of the frame height)
records.move: Agree: locked off. The 1.6 % drift and 0.9 % zoom come from cloud and smoke motion plus micro-drift, so it reads as a held tableau of the city.
records.light_colour: Overcast daylight with a soft sun from the right. Palette: grey-blue sky, white clouds, crimson smoke, sandstone.
records.purpose: Establishing at scale: the whole city at a glance, with the red smoke along the bridge as the one sign that something is wrong.
records.recipe_2d: K6-style locked city wide, 2.5 s (75 f). Planes from back to front: (1) a flat pale sky with 2 cloud planes (depth 0 and 0.05, drifting 6-10 px/s), keeping a flat field in y 317-556 for captions; (2) the far skyline, fill-only, at a horizon around y 1050 (0.55 H); (3) twin chimney towers as the vertical anchor, x 380-560, rising from y 1050 to y 420; (4) the bridge as a band receding to a vanishing point at x 0.62 W, y 1080; (5) a crimson smoke band of 2 flat blobs, at most 10 % of the frame, drifting 4-6 px/s along the deck; (6) a foreground building/statue cut by the right edge, x 900-1080, depth -0.3, anchor-dark. Camera locked with handheld 1 px and no zoom.

records.composition: Centred symmetry: one tall dark tower bisects the frame against the light, with its glowing crown in the upper third.
records.subject_scale: no figure (the tower is about 95 % of the frame height)
records.move: Agree: a slow dolly back from the tower crown that creeps, then speeds up in the last tenth (peak at 92 %), and is cut while still moving. The slight drift is +3.8 % x and +2.5 % y. The blue rings spin on their own (subject motion); the tower stays centred.
records.light_colour: A backlit, churning red-orange cloud sky against the cold cyan arcane glow at the crown, a complementary warm/cold clash. Palette: crimson, burnt orange, cyan, black.
records.purpose: Awe and omen: a symbol of power (arcane energy atop a spire) against a burning sky. The pull-out isolates it.
records.recipe_2d: A tall subject suits 9:16. Tower ink layer centred (x 470-610), shaft cut by the bottom edge, crown and ring at y 600-900 (below the caption block). Sky flat red-orange with 3 cloud planes (depth 0, 0.1 and 0.2) drifting in opposite directions at 4-10 px/s, the nearest one a value step darker. The ring is 3 cyan stroked ellipses rotating 60-120 deg/s with a Glow halo (the cold pop), plus a thin cyan beam down the shaft. Camera: pull-out 1.074 to 1.0 anchored on the crown, ease-in (creep, then accelerate over the last ~10 %), cut while moving. Drift +41 px x and 27 px up. Compress the source's 7.9 s to 3.5-4 s (105-120 f); edge speed stays under 4 px/frame.

records.composition: The pair sits on the left third (seated man in a high-backed chair, girl kneeling with her head against him), with a candle-lit table cut by the left edge. About 60 % of the frame to the right is empty darkness.
records.subject_scale: seated man about 55 % of the frame height, kneeling girl about 40 %
records.move: Agree: a near-imperceptible slow pull-out with about 1 deg of roll, peaking mid-shot. The figures hold still; the only life is candle flicker.
records.light_colour: Warm candle practicals from frame left as the only key, deep surrounding shadow, faint violet veins on the back wall. Palette: near-black, amber, magenta, teal accent.
records.purpose: Intimacy inside isolation: a tender father-daughter moment swallowed by darkness. Pulling back leaves them alone with each other.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16: seated adult in a high-backed chair (3/4 back, 0.5 H) and a kneeling child resting her head on his knee (0.4 H), both in y 900-1750 at x 300-700. A table with 3 candles is cut by the left edge (depth -0.2, parallax 1.2) and gives the only light: a flat warm pool (ring #F2D49B, core #F0E2BF) on the table and their faces, with a 1-2 px flame loop. The rest of the room is one big flat cool mid (#545F6D to #8A9AA8 per PALETTE, not black), with faint violet vein lines on the back wall (depth 0.7). The empty upper half holds the captions. Camera: pull-out 1.038 to 1.0 over 4-6 s (120-180 f), CAM.slow ease-in-out with the peak mid-shot, optional 0 to 1 deg roll. Only candles and breath move.

records.composition: A symmetrical columned facade fills the centre. A row of street lamps forms a horizontal leading line across the lower third. A dark iron girder/bridge leg at the left edge frames the shot.
records.subject_scale: no figure (at most a speck of about 2 % on the steps)
records.move: Agree: a slow push-in, front-loaded (peak at 30 %, then settling). The rain carries the motion.
records.light_colour: Yellow-green street lamps against a cold blue-green rain haze, wet reflections. Palette: teal-black, sodium green, wet grey.
records.purpose: Establishing mood and place at night: a quiet, rain-soaked pause before the scene, a breath between beats.
records.recipe_2d: Facade flat in Dusk at depth 0.85, columns and arched doors in line art, x 200-1080, y 700-1300. A row of 5-6 lamp posts with yellow-green Glow heads along y 1150-1250, wet ground drawn as short vertical reflection streaks. The foreground girder is cut by the left and top edges (depth -0.3, anchor-dark, about 20 % of the width). Rain is 2 streak planes (near: 60-90 px streaks at 30-40 px/frame; far: 20 px at 15 px/frame; 25-40 % opacity), with a haze plane between the girder and the facade. Camera push 1.0 to 1.029 in 3.5 s (104 f), front-loaded ease-out (peak at about 30 %), drift -15 px x. Flat dark sky above for captions.

records.composition: Radial centred symmetry seen from about 55 deg above: a round council table ringed by empty chairs. Diagonal light shafts act as leading lines, and gothic arch spandrels in both top corners frame the shot.
records.subject_scale: no figure (empty chairs; the table ring is about 35 % of the frame height)
records.move: Agree: a slow pull-out at perfectly constant speed. It feels architectural, calm and impersonal.
records.light_colour: Cool god-ray shafts from high windows onto the table, warm amber on the arches, silver highlights on the chairs. Palette: slate blue, silver, amber.
records.purpose: Establishing the institution: the camera looks down on the seat of power. The empty chairs and constant motion make it feel cold and ordered.
records.recipe_2d: K10, high angle on the institution. Camera about 55 deg down. The round table is a ring ellipse (0.75 W x 0.28 H) centred near y 1150, with 7 empty chairs as small blocky ink silhouettes carrying cold highlights. 3-4 diagonal LightShafts (flat cream at 12-20 % opacity, 0.10-0.14 W wide) fall from the top-left onto the table; the floor is a flat mid. Two gothic arch spandrels are cut by the top corners (depth -0.3, warm amber edge), with a flat field between them for captions. Camera: pull-out 1.028 to 1.0, linear, over 4 s (120 f). Scale the arch layer 1.4x the camera so it peels outward.

records.composition: It opens on an empty red void with dark diagonal lines at the top-left. A bearded man enters from the bottom edge and ends head-to-waist, right of centre, with red negative space above him.
records.subject_scale: from 0 (off frame) to about 55 % of the frame height (head-to-waist)
records.move: Mostly agree: a push-in plus tilt down with a 2.5 deg roll, accelerating. But the reveal is mainly subject motion: the man rises or advances out of the red haze from below the frame, growing about 2x, while the camera tilts down to meet him.
records.light_colour: Monochrome red ambient haze with drifting embers and a soft rim on the figure. Palette: crimson, black, ember orange.
records.purpose: Emotional reveal, memory-like: a loved figure emerging from a burning void. The accelerating move pulls us toward him.
records.recipe_2d: Background flat crimson in 2 value bands (no gradient), with 2-3 dark diagonal beams/ropes from the top-left corner (depth 0.2) and embers on 2 planes (near: 6-10 px rising 30-40 px/s; far: 2-4 px at 10 px/s). The figure layer (3/4 front) starts fully below the bottom edge and rises/advances: scale 0.5 to 1.0, ending head-to-waist with his head at about y 800 (0.42 H, below the caption block), figure 0.55 H, x 450-850. Camera: push 1.0 to 1.08, tilt down about 130 px (6.1 % W is 66 px at the same angle; doubled for the taller frame), roll 0 to 2.5 deg, ease-in (accelerating), 3.9 s (116 f), cut while still moving.

records.composition: A small light source left of centre in a dark field, with its smoke column rising as a vertical. A walkway railing runs diagonally across the lower left. A green glow sits at the right edge. Mostly negative space.
records.subject_scale: tiny figure/flare source about 4 % of the frame height; smoke column about 40 %
records.move: Agree: a push-in, front-loaded (peak at 23 %), drifting slightly down and to the side. The rising, billowing smoke is the real motion.
records.light_colour: A cyan flare as the single source in navy fog, with an emerald secondary glow at the right. Palette: navy, cyan, emerald.
records.purpose: Beacon and tension: a signal sent across the dark. A tiny act makes a big gesture in a vast, hostile space.
records.recipe_2d: K6/K8 hybrid, high angle onto a walkway. The railing is an ink line running diagonally from (x 0, y 1500) to (x 1080, y 1200). The flare source sits at x 0.45 W, y 0.62 H, with a tiny fill-only figure (0.04 H, about 75 px). The smoke column is 5-6 stacked flat cyan puffs rising 20-30 px/s, widening 2x and fading out near y 0.3 H, with a Glow on the source. One green window/lamp glow at the right edge is the secondary accent. Everything else is 3 navy/Dusk mid planes with fog bands between them. Camera push 1.0 to 1.048 in 2.3 s (69 f), front-loaded (peak at about 23 %), drift -22 px x and 25 px down.

records.composition: Tall dark vertical window mullions frame a blown-out golden opening. A small round-headed figure, back to camera, sits low and centred behind a balcony rail.
records.subject_scale: back-view figure about 30 % of the frame height
records.move: Agree: an accelerating push-in, 6.8 % in 0.83 s, with the light blooming as we approach. It is part 1 of three chained, accelerating push-ins (92, 93, 94). The 92/93 cut may be a bloom-flash cut or the detector splitting one move.
records.light_colour: Hard golden backlight through the window, with the interior and figure in silhouette. Palette: gold, amber, umber-black, cream.
records.purpose: Build-up and transition: leaving the interior for what lies outside. The acceleration builds anticipation for the reveal.
records.recipe_2d: Chain part 1 of 3 (K9 push-through, then K3 rise). Interior: 4-5 tall mullions (anchor-dark, 40-80 px wide) at depth -0.5, cut by the top and bottom edges. Behind them, a gold opening (L* >= 90) with a back-view figure (0.3 H) at lower centre behind a rail line. Camera push 1.0 to 1.068 in 0.83 s (25 f), ease-in (accelerating), drift -27 px x and 39 px down. The mullions run at parallax 1.4 so they spread outward (peak about 4 px/frame). Lighten the opening one value step across the shot as a bloom. Cut on the motion into 93, or bridge with a 3-4 frame cream bloom (a single soft rise, no flashing).

records.composition: The back-view figure sits at lower centre against a bright city vista. An ornate balcony railing runs across the bottom, with mullions only at the side edges. The opening now fills about 70 % of the frame.
records.subject_scale: back-view figure about 28 % of the frame height
records.move: Agree: a fast accelerating push-in, 9.4 % in 0.83 s, with mild parallax (bottom moves 0.85x the top) as the mullions slide past. It pushes through the window over the figure's head, and the speed carries straight into 94.
records.light_colour: Golden backlight blooming into hazy cream, the figure rim-lit purple-grey. Palette: gold, cream, lavender-grey, umber.
records.purpose: Build-up: crossing the threshold from refuge to the world. The over-the-back framing makes the vista the figure's point of view.
records.recipe_2d: Chain part 2, a closer setup on the same axis. Back-view figure at lower centre (0.28 H, x 0.38-0.62 W), cut by an ornate gold railing band in line art (y 1350-1700, kept near the subject plane, parallax about 0.9-1.0). Mullions only at the side edges (depth -0.5, parallax 1.3). The gold haze city is 2 flat planes in the opening (depth 0.3 and 0.1), with the flat sky across y 317-556 for captions. Push 1.0 to 1.094 in 0.83 s (25 f), ease-in (accelerating), drift -37 px x. The incoming camera of 94 must already be moving at this speed.

records.composition: The railing band slides out the bottom while the skyline rises to fill the frame. Towers are cut by the side edges, airships hang in the upper sky, and the horizon ends up at about 40 % of the height. Deep layered depth.
records.subject_scale: no figure (the near towers are about 55 % of the frame height)
records.move: Agree: a continued push-in with a big crane up (10.4 % of width, about 18 % of the frame height) that eases out and lands. True parallax (bottom 1.26x the top): the railing drops away faster than the city. This is the landing of the 92-94 chain.
records.light_colour: Low golden sun from the upper left, warm haze, clear blue sky, rim-lit tower edges. Palette: gold, cream, copper, teal.
records.purpose: Payoff reveal: awe at the scale of the gleaming city, after the build-up through the window.
records.recipe_2d: Chain part 3: a K3 rise-over with a K5 landing. Start with the railing band filling the bottom 30-40 % (depth -0.3) under a hazy, bright city. Crane y up about 350 px with push 1.0 to 1.042 over 4.9 s (146 f), CAM.reveal ease-out landing over the last 35 %. The railing slides out the bottom at 1.26x the city (peak about 6 px/frame, within the 15 cap). City planes: near towers (0.55, cut by the edges), mid city (0.3), far sea and horizon at about 0.45 H (0.1), and sky (0), flat across y 317-556. 2-3 airships drift 5-10 px/s. Each tower gets one warm rim-lit side and one Dusk side. Hold 1 s after landing, with a 1 px drift.

records.composition: A white-hot point of light slightly above centre, with curved organic lattice ribs as leading lines converging on it. A thin vertical light streak runs down from it, inside a dark vignette.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Agree: locked off. The light pulses and the embers drift; the 0.8 % zoom is glow breathing.
records.light_colour: A single hot point source backlights a translucent cellular membrane, with embers. Palette: black, oxblood, ember orange, white-hot.
records.purpose: Symbolic insert: a power awakening or growing inside something organic. Mystery and dread, with no character needed.
records.recipe_2d: Locked insert, 3.1 s (94 f). The organic cell lattice is 2 layers: fill-only dark curved ribs in the foreground, cut by the left and bottom edges (depth -0.3), and a mid lattice in line art with translucent oxblood cells. Hot point light at x 0.48 W, y 0.40 H: Glow with a white core of 20 px, an amber halo of 120 px and a coral outer halo of 400 px at low opacity, plus a thin vertical streak down 0.25 H. Embers rise 10-20 px/s on 2 planes. The glow pulses slowly, scale 0.92-1.0 over 1.5 s (never flashing). Camera locked, micro push 1.0 to 1.008.

records.composition: Two tiny figures stand centred near the horizon line in shallow dark water. A heavy storm-cloud mass fills the top half, with a moonlight break at the right over a distant city silhouette. Vast negative space.
records.subject_scale: two figures about 8 % of the frame height
records.move: Agree: locked off. The 0.46 s length is the compilation's cut; in the show it is a held breath shot.
records.light_colour: Cold moonlight through a cloud break at the right, a pale reflection on the water, everything else deep navy. Palette: navy, slate, pale blue.
records.purpose: Smallness and loneliness: two people alone in a vast night, a quiet emotional breath.
records.recipe_2d: K6, extreme, at night. Horizon at 0.52 H. The storm-cloud mass is 3 flat navy planes over the top 50 % (drifting 3-6 px/s), with one pale-blue break at the right as the light source. A tiny distant city silhouette, fill-only, sits at x 0.70-0.90 W on the horizon. Two fill-only figures of 0.06-0.08 H (115-155 px) stand at x 0.45-0.55 W in water, with a short pale reflection streak under them. The water is a flat dark plane with 1-2 lighter ripple lines. Map the navy onto the Dusk ladder. Locked, handheld <= 1 px; hold 1.5-2.5 s (45-75 f) as a breath beat.

records.composition: Low horizon band at ~55% height. Two tiny silhouettes walk just right of centre on a wet plain lit by mist. Over half the frame is black storm sky, broken by one cold moonlit rift in the clouds above the horizon, with a distant spire/rock silhouette at the right edge. Heavy negative space.
records.subject_scale: ~6% of frame height (two walking figures)
records.move: Locked off, as measured (the 0.3% residual is noise). Only the mist and clouds move.
records.light_colour: Moonlight rift behind the horizon (back/top light), everything else near-black. Cold only, no warm. Palette: ink black, navy, steel blue, pale moon-cyan.
records.purpose: Scale and isolation: tiny travellers under an enormous night sky. A 1.5 s breathing/establishing beat between action shots.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 sky gradient #05070c to #0d1626 over the top 60%. L2 ink cloud masses with a thin cyan-white rift at ~55% height (drifts +4 px over the shot). L3 distant spire/rock silhouette at the right edge, ~8% of frame height. L4 ground plane with a soft blue mist-reflection strip under the figures. L5 two flat-dark silhouette figures, 110-120 px tall, at x 55% / y 62%, with a 1 px cool rim. Camera static (scale 1.00, no shake) for 1.54 s. Only the mist strip breathes (opacity 0.6 to 0.75). Use it as a cold pause before a warm action burst.

records.composition: A packed brawl fills the frame edge to edge with no empty space. A central pink-haired figure is locked in a clinch, a big figure with a mechanical gauntlet holds the right third, and small blue-haired figures sit low centre. Fans of god-rays fall from the top through smoke. The overlapping bodies are stacked flat.
records.subject_scale: group fills the frame; central figures ~60-80% of frame height, cropped at waist/knees
records.move: Slow pull-out of ~6% (it reads as slow motion), drifting slightly left (4.7%) and tilting up a little, with -1.2 deg roll. It accelerates: the camera eases back as the melee builds. Agrees with the measurement.
records.light_colour: Top/back light: warm orange god-rays from high windows through smoke. Figures are rim-lit, faces mostly in shadow. Palette: burnt orange, rust, umber, small teal accents.
records.purpose: Action chaos in slow motion: everyone tangled together. The pull-back lets the viewer take in the whole tangle.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 smoky umber backdrop with 5 additive orange light-shaft polygons (opacity 0.25-0.4, slow flicker +/-0.05). L2 back row of 3-4 brawling silhouettes with warm rims. L3 main clinch pair centred, ~60% of frame height, cropped at the waist. L4 foreground heavy figure cut by the right frame edge (shoulder/arm only, ~40% of width), moving 1.3x for parallax. Camera: scale 1.06 to 1.00 over 6.67 s, easeIn (cubic); camera moves left ~50 px (content slides right), tilts up ~25 px, roll 0 to -1.2 deg. Animate the figures at half speed (drawings held on 4s) to sell slow-mo, and add floating dust motes in the shafts.

records.composition: A curved, ornate iron railing makes a diagonal leading line from lower-left to upper-right. Two figures (one white-haired, one red-haired) stand on the walkway left of centre. Overhanging leaves frame the top and left edges (frame within frame). A hot white pool of light spills across the middle of the walkway, and a red-framed arched door at upper right is the destination.
records.subject_scale: ~20-25% of frame height
records.move: Locked off. The 2.3% vertical reading comes from drifting leaves and glowing particles, not the camera. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Warm daylight shaft from upper right pools white-gold on the walkway, with green dappled shade from the foliage. Palette: moss green, gold, warm white, rust-red accent.
records.purpose: Establishing a hidden refuge: a lush sanctuary reveal, calm after chaos, green life after orange fire.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 high angle: L0 foreground leaf clusters across the top 18% and down the left edge (dark green, sway +/-6 px on a 2 s period). L1 walkway as an S-curve rising from bottom-left to top-right, with railing line art. L2 two figures ~400 px tall at x 35-45%, y 55%. L3 light pool: soft-edged warm-white ellipse on the walkway (screen blend 0.6). L4 background foliage with a small red arched door at top right as the goal. Camera static for 4.67 s while green fireflies drift up ~40 px. Use it as the 'safe place' establishing shot.

records.composition: A massive dark structure (bridge underside/girder) slashes diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, dotted with purple and cyan neon. Mid-shot, an orange fireball erupts dead centre behind and under it, and the structure's silhouette cuts across the blast.
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Camera locked off. The late motion peak (86%) is the fireball expanding, not a camera move. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Cold violet-blue night with magenta/cyan neon accents, then a warm orange explosion at centre takes over as key light. Warm-cold clash. Palette: navy, violet, magenta, fire orange.
records.purpose: Impact punctuation: a calm neon night broken by an explosion.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 dark navy void. L2 explosion layer centred at y 55%: orange-yellow flame sprite plus additive glow, scales 0 to 1.0 with easeOut over 0.75 s starting at 1.25 s, then billows a further +8% to the end. L3 diagonal structure silhouette in front of the blast (ink black, ~35 deg angle, purple neon dots blinking); at blast onset its edges gain an orange rim. L4 sparks/debris particles. Camera locked at scale 1.0, with a 0.25 s decaying shake (+/-8 px) at blast onset. Total 3.08 s.

records.composition: Four or five figures stand in a staggered row as pure black silhouettes against a wall of fire. A crouched figure sits lower right in front of the flames. Fire fills the middle and right; a dark wall/pillar mass on the left grows as the camera pulls back.
records.subject_scale: ~50% of frame height
records.move: Pull-out of ~17% while drifting left (8.8%) and tilting up a little. Fastest mid-shot (55%), it reveals the dark room around the fire. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Fire backlight behind the figures, so everything in front reads as silhouette in deep shadow. Palette: fire orange, amber, black, smoky brown.
records.purpose: Aftermath and defiance: the group as one united silhouette, and the pull-back shows how big the fire around them is.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 fire wall: orange-to-yellow gradient with 6-8 flame sprites flickering (drawings held on 2s), smoke rising. L2 figure silhouettes (flat #120806 fill, 2 px warm rim on shoulders) in a staggered row, 900-1000 px tall, plus one crouched figure lower right. L3 foreground dark pillar/beams on the left, moving 1.2x. Camera: scale 1.20 to 1.00 over 4.0 s, easeInOut (sine, peak speed at 55%); camera moves left ~95 px (content slides right) and tilts up ~60 px. Start tight on the silhouettes and end with fire surrounding them.

records.composition: It opens on grey-violet fog with a faint figure silhouette inside, which clears into a ruined dark interior. Frame within frame: a lone figure stands in a jagged gap among broken roof beams, silhouetted against a teal-blue cityscape outside. Big windows on the right show the same city. About 70% of the frame is near-black foreground debris.
records.subject_scale: ~15-18% of frame height
records.move: Slow ~3% pull-out drifting left (3.7%), with +1.8 deg roll, settling. The opening fog dissolve works as a smoke transition. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Cool teal daylight from outside (backlight); the interior is unlit. Palette: black-green, teal, slate blue, grey-violet fog.
records.purpose: Transition plus solitude: a fog dissolve into a lone figure looking out at the other world. Longing and resolve.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L0 full-frame grey-violet fog with a faint large silhouette inside, opacity 1 to 0 over the first 1.25 s (the dissolve bridge from the previous shot). L1 soft, low-contrast teal cityscape. L2 black interior mask with an irregular hole centred at y 40% and broken-beam silhouettes. L3 lone figure ~320 px tall standing in the gap, flat dark fill with a cool rim. L4 foreground debris/beams over the bottom 25%, moving 1.3x. Camera: scale 1.03 to 1.00 over 4.96 s, easeOut; camera moves left ~40 px, roll 0 to +1.8 deg.

records.composition: A huge broken gothic ruin (arches, spires) fills the upper two-thirds as a dark silhouette. A single small cyan-blue glow sits on the rubble in the lower-left third, with one tiny figure near it. The rest is deep blue darkness over a rubble foreground.
records.subject_scale: tiny figure ~5% of frame height; the glow is the subject
records.move: Slow ~5% push-in drifting right (-3.2%), fastest at 67%: the camera closes slowly on the glowing object. Agrees.
records.light_colour: A single cyan point source on the ground (practical glow) plus faint cold moonlight on the ruin's edges. Palette: navy, ink blue, slate, electric cyan.
records.purpose: Scale and mystery: a huge dead ruin and one living light. The push-in tells the viewer this small thing matters.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 night sky gradient. L2 full-width ruin silhouette (arches, broken spires) topping out at 15% height, with faint cool rim lines. L3 midground rubble field. L4 cyan glow at x 30%, y 72% (120 px additive radial gradient, pulsing +/-10% every 1.5 s) with a tiny figure (~95 px) beside it. L5 foreground rubble over the bottom 12%, 1.2x parallax. Camera: scale 1.00 to 1.054 over 5.04 s, easeInOut biased late (peak at 67%); camera moves right ~35 px toward the glow.

records.composition: A pink-haired figure's face and shoulder fill the frame right of centre, body on a diagonal. An armoured gauntlet with green lights sits at the right edge, magenta flames burst in the lower-left corner, and a gothic arch stands behind. Her head snaps back from a grimace to open-mouthed as the camera lunges.
records.subject_scale: head-and-shoulders; face ~35-45% of frame height
records.move: Fast, accelerating push-in (+20% in under 1 s) with pan right (-12.9%) and -1.1 deg roll. The strong parallax (1.88) means a physical dolly lunge with the hit, not a zoom. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Magenta underlight from the flames at bottom-left, cool violet ambient, green LED accents on the armour. Palette: magenta, violet, plum shadow, acid green.
records.purpose: Impact and pain: a 1-second jolt that throws the viewer into the hit. Climax energy.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 background arch and violet haze, moving 0.6x. L2 character head and shoulders, face at y 40% filling ~45% of height, body on a diagonal; 3 head drawings (grimace, strain, head thrown back) swap across the shot. L3 foreground magenta flame sprites bottom-left, additive, moving 1.9x. Camera: scale 1.00 to 1.20 over 0.96 s, easeIn (cubic); camera moves right ~140 px (content slides left); roll 0 to -1.1 deg. Cut hard while the move is still at peak speed, and add a 2-frame motion smear on the last frames.

records.composition: A blue-braided figure stands left of centre with one arm raised. A huge pale gothic arch window frames her from behind in lavender fog. Magenta flames fill the bottom foreground, and green smoke trails curl from her raised hand.
records.subject_scale: ~75% of frame height (cropped at the knees by the flames)
records.move: Slow 3.6% push-in drifting right (-5.1%) with a -3 deg roll, settling: a creeping dutch tilt as the menace grows. Parallax 1.48 (flames vs background). Agrees.
records.light_colour: Backlit by pale lavender fog through the arch (silhouette edges), magenta firelight from below, green accent trails. Palette: lavender grey, magenta, violet, acid green.
records.purpose: Villain/character reveal: a power pose that feels unstable; the roll tilts the world with her.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 pale, low-contrast lavender gothic arch centred behind the figure, top at 8%. L2 fog band. L3 figure ~1400 px tall at x 40%, arm raised, drawn from a low angle (slight foreshortening), with green smoke-trail sprites curling from the hand. L4 foreground magenta flames across the bottom 25%, additive, 1.5x parallax. Camera: scale 1.00 to 1.036 over 3.12 s, easeOut; camera moves right ~55 px; roll 0 to -3 deg, easeOut.

records.composition: Centred symmetry down a narrow alley canyon. Tall walls left and right converge on a hazy green background, and an overhead walkway crosses near the top. In the centre, a red-haired figure kneels with head bowed while a second figure stands beside her. A red-lit doorway glows on the left and a pink neon sign hangs upper right.
records.subject_scale: standing figure ~40% of frame height, kneeling figure ~25%
records.move: Locked off. The late motion peak (88%) is figure and haze movement, not the camera. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Red neon key from the left doorway, a pink neon sign on the right, toxic green haze backlighting the far end. Warm-red foreground against a cold-green background. Palette: blood red, magenta, bottle green, black.
records.purpose: An emotional low point seen from a respectful distance: one figure broken on her knees, the other standing over her, both small inside a hostile city.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 (the alley suits vertical): L1 green haze shaft, a gradient brightest at top centre. L2 overhead walkway silhouette across the frame at y 28%. L3 left and right walls as tall dark slabs converging on a vanishing point at x 50%, y 45%; red doorway glow on the left wall; pink neon sign sprite on the right (2-frame flicker every ~1.5 s). L4 two figures centred at y 70%: standing ~750 px, kneeling ~470 px. L5 thin floor reflection of the red light. Camera locked for 3.21 s; only the neon flicker and drifting haze move.

records.composition: The camera sits at floor level. A large out-of-focus round metal object (gauntlet/lens) dominates the lower-left foreground. Behind it, a standing figure cropped at the head looms on the left and a worried blue-haired girl stands in the right third. Lit crates and a window fill the middle.
records.subject_scale: girl ~70% of frame height; foreground prop ~40% of frame width
records.move: Slow ~3% pull-out with a slight drift left, fastest at the start (peak at 25%), then easing off. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Warm red-orange firelight from low left, dark ceiling. Palette: crimson, rust, amber, teal hair accent.
records.purpose: Tension carried by a story object: the foreground prop is the cause or the guilt, and we read the characters' reaction through it.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 wooden back wall with a lit crate window at centre (warm amber). L2 two figures: a standing figure cut by the left and top frame edges (torso only, looming), and the girl at x 70%, ~1300 px tall, looking toward the prop. L3 foreground prop: a big round metal gauntlet/lens at bottom-left, ~500 px wide, 6 px gaussian blur, 1.4x parallax, catching a hot rim highlight. Camera: scale 1.03 to 1.00 over 2.54 s, easeOut (fast start); camera moves left ~16 px.

records.composition: A low sun sits on the horizon at centre under a dramatic orange-gold cloud bank that fills the top two-thirds. A silhouetted rooftop parapet runs across the bottom ~20%, with small seated figures on it. The frame reads as horizontal bands.
records.subject_scale: ~6-8% of frame height (silhouettes on the parapet)
records.move: Slow ~2% pull-out with a slight drift left, settling. Agrees.
records.light_colour: Low sun backlighting from the horizon, so everything in front is silhouette. Warm only. Palette: tangerine, gold, rose, deep brown.
records.purpose: Nostalgia and hope: a quiet golden memory, an end-of-day breath. Good as an outro or section closer.
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 stack: L1 sky gradient, deep rose at top through tangerine to gold at the horizon. L2 2-3 cloud-bank stripes with warm-lit undersides, drifting +6 px. L3 sun disc at x 50%, y 68%, with bloom. L4 distant city/sea silhouette strip at the horizon. L5 parapet silhouette across the bottom 22% with 2-3 small seated figure silhouettes (~130 px), 1.15x parallax. Camera: scale 1.021 to 1.00 over 2.08 s, easeOut; camera moves left ~14 px; the sun bloom pulses gently. Use it as an outro breath.

records.composition: centred symmetry; frame within frame (a tall vertical slot of light behind the speaker); silhouette against light; the cap of a huge glowing orb fills the bottom as a base, with the small figure above it
