records.subject_scale: speaker+podium silhouette ~50% of frame height early (figure ~30%); by the end the orb is the subject, ~55% of height
records.move: Agree: a slow pull-back that speeds up, with a leftward pan and roll (measured -10°). The orb slides right and rises fully into view while the light slot dims out. It reads as a pull-back from the orator to the orb, ending with the orb as the new subject (probably a dissolve inside the shot). The measured parallax ratio of 0.57 shows the orb plane and the slot plane separating.
records.light_colour: cold ice-blue backlight through the tall slot behind the figure, violet-blue glow rising from the orb below, nothing warm; palette: ink black, ice blue, violet, magenta rim
records.purpose: symbolic transition: the orator (the public promise) hands the frame to the glowing orb (the power behind it); idea becomes object
records.recipe_2d: Layers: L0 near-black wall (#0b0a12). L1 vertical light slot 300px wide, centred, from the top edge down to y=1250, pale ice-blue with a soft 40px bloom; inside it L2 a speaker silhouette at a podium, one arm raised, 520px tall (head at y≈380), flat dark ink. L3 glowing orb: a circle 1400px across, centred at x=540, top edge at y=1350 (only the cap shows), violet-to-blue gradient interior with a slow 15° texture rotation, 30px additive white-violet rim plus a horizontal lens streak. Camera over 4.3 s (cubic ease-in, accelerating into the cut): scale 1.27→1.0; orb layer slides right 200px, slot layer 120px (planes move at ~0.6 of each other, as measured); roll 0→-6° (capped from the measured -10° because roll reads stronger in 9:16). Last 1.5 s: slot opacity 1→0 while the orb rises 150px, so the orb takes over the frame and can match-cut into the next beat.

records.composition: low angle with the subject right of centre; her raised arm makes a strong vertical/diagonal to the top edge; a foreground energy streak crosses her face at the start
records.subject_scale: head and shoulders ~75% of frame height, raised arm running out of the top
records.move: Agree, essentially static: a small handheld-feeling roll of +3° and ~2% drift over 12 frames. The motion comes from a cyan energy streak whipping across the foreground and from floating sparks, not from the camera.
records.light_colour: cool blue key from above (the energy in her raised hand), teal-black ambient, all cold; palette: teal black, cyan, electric blue, pale skin
records.purpose: action, step 1 of a stepped pull-back (three axial cuts, each wider): the defiant face at the moment of firing, close and quick
records.recipe_2d: 12 frames at 24 fps (0.5 s). Layers: L0 dark teal night with blurred building silhouettes (8px blur, 30% contrast). L1 the character's bust seen from below, chin up, eyes to the sky, raised arm running off the top edge; head at y≈520, body filling the lower 75%. L2 blue spark particles (20-30 small hand-drawn ticks, additive, drifting up 40px/s). L3 a single cyan energy brush-streak 300px wide sweeping diagonally from bottom-right to top-left across the face during frames 0-4 (opacity 1→0), working as a wipe out of the previous shot. Camera: roll -1.5°→+1.5° ease-in-out, drift up 25px. Cool rim light on the top of the face, everything else teal-black.

records.composition: subject centre-right; the arm runs diagonally to the top-right corner as a leading line and the sparks continue it; dark negative space on the left
records.subject_scale: waist-up ~80% of frame height
records.move: Agree: a quick 7% pull-back with a slight upward drift, peaking early (38%). Together with the cut, it is the second step of the staircase pull-back.
records.light_colour: cold blue light from the sparks and the hand, teal-black city behind; palette: slate teal, cyan sparks, black, pale skin
records.purpose: step 2 of the stepped pull-back: shows the whole gesture (arm and sparks) and raises the energy
records.recipe_2d: 10 frames (0.42 s). Same character art as 110, re-staged one size wider: waist-up, head at y≈600, raised arm reaching to the top-right corner. Sparks now jet from the hand along the arm diagonal toward the top-right (12-16 streak particles, 600px/s, additive). BG dark tower silhouettes at 0.7x parallax. Camera: scale 1.074→1.0 with an early peak (mostly done by frame 4), drift up 40px. Hard cut at frame 10, no transition.

records.composition: subject in the lower-right third; the flare's trail rises to the top edge; skyline negative space upper-left
records.subject_scale: ~55% of frame height (head to hips), flare above her
records.move: Agree: a near-static 2% pull-back. This is the third and shortest step (8 frames): the flare leaves her hand and climbs out of the top of the frame.
records.light_colour: cold blue from sparks and flare, the flare's purple-pink tip as the only warm-ish accent; palette: slate teal, cyan sparks, magenta tip, black
records.purpose: step 3: shows the flare leaving. The cuts speed up (0.50 / 0.42 / 0.33 s) to build momentum into the long wide that follows
records.recipe_2d: 8 frames (0.33 s). Re-stage wider again: head at y≈900, figure ~55% of frame height in the lower right, skyline silhouettes visible on the left above her shoulder. The flare (a bright projectile with a purple-pink tip and a cyan trail) leaves her hand and climbs past y=0 within the 8 frames. Camera: scale 1.023→1.0, ease-in. Rhythm rule to reuse: three cuts of 0.50 / 0.42 / 0.33 s, each ~1.5x wider than the last, make a 1.25 s staircase that hands off to a long wide (113).

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll -8°
records.composition: a tiny centred silhouette against the brightest area (the clock tower glow); a foreground iron railing frames the bottom; the bridge beam and a curved neon pipe act as leading lines; deep layering into a vertical city canyon
records.subject_scale: figure ~8-10% of frame height
records.move: Agree in kind: a long 8.5 s crane-up and pull-back with a leftward pan, slowing to a settle. It starts on dark sky with a blue flare rising from a tiny figure on a bridge, then opens onto the lit undercity canyon behind and below (the brightening reads as either a cross-dissolve or the city lighting up during the move). The -8° roll is probably partly fitted from the foreground railing's parallax: treat it as a gentle level-out, not a dutch angle.
records.light_colour: backlight from the glowing city below and behind, figure and foreground railing in silhouette; cold, dark foreground against a luminous green distance; palette: green-black, acid green, cyan neon, magenta signs
records.purpose: awe/scale payoff and release: after the fast close cuts, a long slow wide shows how small she is against the city; isolation, a signal sent into a huge world
records.recipe_2d: 8.5 s scale reveal; the tall frame suits a canyon. Layers, back to front, with parallax: L0 haze gradient, dark teal at the top to glowing acid-green at y≈1100 (0.15x); L1 band of distant tower silhouettes (0.3x); L2 city canyon midground: tiers of lit windows, magenta and cyan neon signs, a green-ringed clock tower centred at y≈850 (0.5x); L3 a horizontal bridge beam across the frame at y≈1250, figure 160px tall (≈8%) centred, pure silhouette against L2 (1.0x); L4 foreground ornate iron railing filling y 1400-1920 plus a cyan neon pipe arcing in from the left edge, darkest values (1.6x). Camera: start at scale 1.35 on the figure and the dark sky above, with city layers at 30% brightness and a blue additive flare trail rising from the figure during 0-1.5 s. Then ease to scale 1.0 over the full 8.5 s (cubic ease-out, most travel in the first 3 s), crane up 300px (each layer moves by its parallax factor), slide 170px, and roll from -5° back to 0 by the end. City brightness ramps 30%→100% between 1.0 and 3.5 s (lit by the flare). Hold the last ~2 s nearly still.
records.measured: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll -8°

records.composition: rule of thirds: figure on the left third with her back to camera; frame within frame (a big painted canvas); the figure overlaps the canvas edge
records.subject_scale: full-length figure ~85% of frame height, left third
records.move: Agree: effectively locked; a 1.4% creep-out with 2% drift, too small to notice. A held tableau.
records.light_colour: warm red room ambient, warm key raking across the canvas from the right; all warm with dark edges; palette: crimson, ochre yellow, rust, umber
records.purpose: contemplation: a figure seen from behind, facing a big defaced image, so the viewer reads her feeling through the canvas; a pause in the rhythm
records.recipe_2d: 3.3 s held tableau. Layers: L0 deep red room wall (#3a0f0c) with a dark vignette; L1 large painted canvas, 900x1150px, filling the upper 60% of the frame (y 250-1400): our own painting (ships and a harbour in muted rust and slate) slashed by 4-5 thick ochre-yellow brush swipes with drips; L2 full-length figure from behind, 1350px tall, feet at y≈1820, standing on the left third (x≈330), her red coat the only saturated block; L3 dark vertical pillar edges at both sides of the frame (60px wide, 1.1x parallax). Warm key from the right edge of the canvas, warm red bounce off the floor. Camera: scale 1.014→1.0 linear with a 25px drift right; essentially still, because the stillness is the point.

records.composition: centred symmetry, frontal; the throne's spikes radiate behind her like a crown or wings; foreground armrest claws frame the lower corners
records.subject_scale: seated figure ~95% of frame height (head to knees); throne wider than the frame
records.move: Agree: a slow 9% pull-out with slight drift, gathering speed late (peak at 73%); it reveals more of the throne's spiky wings.
records.light_colour: warm amber key from low right (a lantern), violet rim on the throne spikes, black surround; warm figure against cold accents; palette: amber, black, violet, teal
records.purpose: character portrait / power: a frontal throne pose, an ominous queen of her own world; the pull-out reveals the throne
records.recipe_2d: 3.4 s portrait. Layers: L0 black with a faint violet haze (0.8x); L1 throne back: a symmetric fan of spiky branch/claw shapes radiating behind her, 1300px wide (wider than the frame), violet rim light on the tips (0.9x); L2 seated figure, frontal and centred, legs apart, arms on the armrests, head at y≈260, cropped at the knees (1.0x); L3 foreground armrest claws in both lower corners plus an amber lantern glow sprite at lower right (1.2x). Camera: scale 1.087→1.0, slow start and late acceleration (ease-in-out peaking at ~70%), drift 45px right and 25px down.

records.composition: a foreground silhouette (the hand) against a tiny light in a large negative space; orb in the upper third; skyline horizon low
records.subject_scale: hand ~55% of frame height; orb ~12%
records.move: Agree: a slow 6% pull-back with a symmetric ease-in-out. The action is the foreground hand rising into frame, spreading toward the orb and starting to close.
records.light_colour: a single cold point source (the orb) high in the sky; hand silhouetted with a faint blue rim; palette: navy, cobalt, black
records.purpose: longing: a hand reaching for a distant light, a symbol of wanting something out of reach (setup for 117)
records.recipe_2d: 3.4 s, the reach. Layers: L0 navy night-sky gradient (#0d1630 at the top to #1a2a4a at the horizon); L1 jagged spires/ruin skyline silhouette across y 1300-1920, flat dark ink (0.6x); L2 glowing blue rune-orb, 220px, at x≈620, y≈420: cobalt core, ring pattern rotating 30°/s, 120px additive halo (0.8x); L3 foreground hand silhouette, 1000px tall, slightly blurred (4px), entering from the bottom-left: rises 400px over 0-1.4 s with fingers spread toward the orb, then begins to close from 2.6 s (1.0x, faint blue rim on the fingertips). Camera: scale 1.056→1.0 ease-in-out, drift 35px. Keep ~60% of the frame as empty dark sky so the small light reads.

records.composition: a silhouetted fist fills centre-right with negative space on the left; it hides the light source
records.subject_scale: fist ~70% of frame height
records.move: Agree: locked off; the fist moves slightly and swallows the glow.
records.light_colour: the orb glow is swallowed by the fist, leaving only navy ambient; palette: navy, black, faint cobalt
records.purpose: symbolic payoff of 116: the hand closes and the light is caught or snuffed out; a full stop
records.recipe_2d: 1.0 s locked insert, cut in tighter. Fist silhouette 1350px tall at centre-right, covering where the orb was; the orb glow peeks above the knuckles and dies 100%→0 over the first 8 frames, and a thin cobalt rim on the knuckles fades with it. Background: the same navy sky and skyline at 0.5 opacity. No camera move at all, so the gesture lands. Pair rule: reach (3.4 s, slow move) → grasp (1.0 s, locked, tighter) = a two-shot symbol.

records.composition: two figures stacked by height (the older sister left of centre, the younger lower right and half behind her); haze fills the bottom; heads in the upper half
records.subject_scale: older child ~95% of frame height (head to waist crop), younger ~55%
records.move: Agree: a 20% pull-back with a 14% leftward pan and +7° roll, peaking mid-shot. A drifting, unsteady camera; the girls stay in frame while the red haze slides across.
records.light_colour: red fire glow from behind and lower left through smoke, red rim on hair and shoulders; all warm; palette: blood red, crimson, near-black, ember orange
records.purpose: grief/shock, an emotional memory: children in the aftermath of a disaster; the unsteady drift mirrors their disorientation
records.recipe_2d: 4.2 s. Layers: L0 dark crimson gradient (#2a0505 to #7a1010) (0.3x); L1 two drifting smoke sheets (40% opacity, moving 15px/s right) and a hot radial glow at lower left (#ff3a20, additive, 500px) (0.5x); L2 older sister waist-up, left of centre, head at y≈300, wide shocked eyes looking up and past camera (1.0x); L3 younger sister lower right, head at y≈1050, half hidden behind her, holding on (1.0x); L4 foreground smoke band over y 1600-1920 plus 30 ember particles rising 60px/s (1.4x). Faces lit only by red bounce, red rim on the hair. Camera: scale 1.2→1.0, content slides right 150px, roll 0→+5° (capped from +7°), ease-in-out peaking mid-shot so it feels like an unsteady drift, not a dolly.

records.composition: a low-contrast hooded silhouette in fog, centre-left, with a tall curved shape at the right; lots of soft negative space
records.subject_scale: hooded figure ~80% of frame height, soft and barely readable
records.move: Agree: locked off; the only motion is fog drift and the figure slowly emerging (eye glints appear late).
records.light_colour: no key: diffuse cold fog light, flat and low-contrast; palette: powder blue, slate grey, white
records.purpose: tension/menace: a barely visible threat in fog, the quiet before the burst in 120
records.recipe_2d: 2.9 s hold. Layers: L0 flat pale blue-grey fill (#9fb0c6); L1 hooded figure silhouette, 1500px tall, centre-left, drawn only 20-25% darker than the fill and blurred 6px, with a tall curved shape (a pipe or blade) rising at the right edge; L2 three fog sheets crossing at 10/20/40 px/s at 40-60% opacity, the nearest blurred most; L3 two small white eye glints that fade in over the last 0.8 s. Camera locked (a 1% creep at most). The low contrast is the point: it sets up the burst in 120.

records.composition: a diagonal burst from the lower left; lightning lines radiate to the edges; the flash flattens all depth
records.subject_scale: figure ~80% of frame height; gauntlet and lightning fill ~60% of frame width
records.move: Agree: an 11-frame jolt (12.5% pull-back, 14% lateral throw and +9° roll) on the lightning discharge. It works as an impact shake, and the flash dominates.
records.light_colour: blue-white lightning burst from the gauntlet, blooming through the fog; a cold flash; palette: electric blue, white, slate
records.purpose: action/impact: an energy release, with the camera jolt and flash selling the force; doubles as a white-flash transition after the stillness of 119
records.recipe_2d: 0.46 s (11 frames at 24 fps) impact, on the same fog plate as 119. Frames 0-3: a mechanical gauntlet fist rises in from the lower left. Frame 4: discharge, with 3-4 hand-drawn jagged lightning strokes running from the gauntlet to the frame edges, redrawn every 2 frames; a full-frame additive blue-white flash goes 0→0.75 opacity on frame 4 and decays to 0.3 by frame 10; a horizontal lens streak through the gauntlet. Camera: scale 1.125→1.0 ease-in-out, lateral throw 150px, roll 0→+6°, plus a 2-frame ±15px shake on the impact frame. Cut out on a bright frame so it can serve as a flash transition. Contrast rule: 2.9 s locked stillness (119) → 0.46 s violent move (120).

records.composition: Foreground mass on the left: a big mechanical hand/gauntlet, fingers up, cut by the left and bottom edges, filling ~55% of the frame. A small white-hot electric spark sits between the fingertips just left of centre. A fogged figure silhouette stands behind on the right, two value steps lighter (haze). Negative space in the upper right.
records.subject_scale: no figure in focus (hand fills ~65% of frame height; a fogged silhouette behind ~80%, low contrast)
records.move: Effectively locked off: a 1% creep in that settles, with a tiny drift (~1% of width). Parallax 0.25 tells us the foreground hand barely separates from the fog plane. Read it as a held insert where only the spark moves.
records.light_colour: Key is the cold electric spark at the fingertips plus blue fog backlight; no warm counterpoint. Palette: ultramarine, violet haze, white-hot core, navy ink.
records.purpose: Symbolic insert or tension beat: power about to be released, a held breath before the action. It points the eye at one tiny bright spot.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 1.5-1.8 s. L0: fog as 3 flat blue bands, darker toward the bottom (no gradient). L1: silhouette figure, 1500 px tall, x 620-1000, fill only, one value step lighter than L0. L2: mechanical hand in ink + flat steel-blue, anchored bottom-left, cut by the left and bottom edges, fingertips up to y ~800, covering ~55% of the frame. L3: spark at x 470, y 760: 110 px white core, one flat pale-blue ring, 6-8 jagged ink arcs redrawn every 2 frames (boil), plus a 1-frame brighter flash at 0.6 s. Camera: scale 1.00 to 1.01, ease-out; L1 parallax 0.25 vs L2 1.0. Keep captions (y 317-556) in the flat fog area above the fingertips.

records.composition: About 90% negative space: near-black frame with one small caged dome lamp, top-centre, glowing orange. Strict centred symmetry. The lamp is the only readable shape (~12% of frame height), so the eye locks on it at once.
records.subject_scale: no figure (lamp ~12% of frame height)
records.move: A slow 1.7% pull-out, front-loaded (most of it in the first ~0.3 s, then near-still), with ~1% drift. It reads as a held POV looking up at a ceiling lamp, slowly getting further away.
records.light_colour: One practical: a warm orange caged ceiling lamp, top-centre; everything else falls to black. No cold fill. Palette: ember orange, rust, near-black brown.
records.purpose: Isolation and mood. Read as a lying character's POV of the ceiling, it sets up the reveal in the next shot (the person under the lamp), and it gives a quiet breather between beats.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 2.0 s. L0: flat anchor-dark field (no gradient), with a faint ceiling-beam line drawing one value step up so the frame isn't empty. L1: caged dome lamp, 190 px wide, centred x 540, y 170-300 (the top-edge object zone y 0-290), ink cage bars + flat orange glass + 2 flat halo rings (peach outer, cream core, each wider by ~1.6x). Camera: scale 1.017 to 1.000; 80% of the change in the first 0.35 s (fast ease-out), then hold. Optional 1-2 frame lamp dip at 1.4 s. Captions can sit in the dark below at y 317-556 (light text on dark). Cut on a hold straight into the overhead reveal (shot 123).

records.composition: The first ~0.5 s still holds the dark lamp frame (an undetected dark cut or dissolve). Then a top-down view of a young woman lying on her back, head upper-centre-right, body running diagonally down-left and cut at the hips by the bottom edge. The round rim of an armchair/cushion behind her head and shoulders frames her like a halo. A desk/drawer corner cuts the top-left corner (frame within frame). Riveted metal floor plates give diagonal lines.
records.subject_scale: ~100% of frame height (head to hips, cropped by the bottom edge)
records.move: A slow 2.3% pull-out over 5.3 s that speeds up gently, with a matched -0.9° roll, so the world slowly turns and drifts away from her. Combined with the lamp POV before it, this is a POV-to-reverse: up at the lamp, then straight down on the person staring at it.
records.light_colour: Dim warm top light from the lamp falls on the face and shoulders. Cool blue-violet shadow covers the floor and edges, with a teal hair accent. Palette: maroon floor, teal, pink, warm skin, slate.
records.purpose: Intimacy and loneliness. It reveals who was looking at the lamp, and the long, slow hold lets a heavy line or thought land.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 0.5 s lamp hold (reuse shot 122) then a hard cut to the overhead for ~4.5 s. 9:16 suits a lying figure: lay her lengthwise and rotate the whole world plate 18° so the body runs from head at x 640, y 640 down-left to the hips cut by the bottom edge at x 300. Keep the head below the caption block (y 317-556). L0: floor plate (flat plates + rivet dots, diagonal seams). L1: round armchair rim, 900 px circle behind head/shoulders (the soft enclosure). L2: figure, ink + flat colour, a flat warm light ellipse (0.5 W) on face and chest. L3: desk/drawer corner cutting the top-left, parallax 1.1 (nearer the camera). Camera: scale 1.023 to 1.000 with a slow ease-in, roll 0 to -0.9° in sync. Loops: breath (chest scale 1.0-1.01, 3 s period), one blink at ~2.5 s, hair strands sway 2-3 px.

records.composition: The face sits in the upper-centre-left, tilted, eyes looking up past the lens. A large out-of-focus hand (pale, blue nails) reaches up toward the camera from the bottom-right and covers ~35-45% of the frame, growing over the shot. The diagonal from hand to face gives depth. The round chair back fills the top as a soft border.
records.subject_scale: face ~50% of frame height; foreground hand ~60% of frame height
records.move: A 5.6% push-in that speeds up, with ~3% lateral drift (the face slides slightly across the frame). Meanwhile the foreground hand lifts toward the lens, so the subject's own action does most of the depth work (parallax ~1.04, nearly flat camera).
records.light_colour: Warm lamp key from above on the face and the reaching hand; cool violet shadow on the far cheek and background. Palette: warm skin, teal hair, plum shadows, pale highlights.
records.purpose: Intimacy and longing: she reaches up for the light, which pays off the lamp POV. The close, wide framing makes the gesture feel personal.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 2.5-2.8 s. L0: chair back + floor, flat, one value step down. L1: face, ink + flat colour, head 950 px tall centred x 470, y 1050 (eyes ~y 900, below the captions), tilted 12°. L2: foreground hand, 1300 px, entering from the bottom-right, drawn larger with thicker ink (wide-lens exaggeration), soft = no inner lines, one value lighter; it rises 140 px and scales 1.0 to 1.12 over the shot. Camera: scale 1.000 to 1.056, ease-in, x drift -32 px; parallax L2 1.15 vs L1 1.0. Flat warm light ellipse on the face and fingertips. Mouth opens on the last 0.5 s (a breath or line).

records.composition: Centred symmetry. A huge blood-red sun disc fills ~75% of frame height. Two small figures stand close together, as silhouettes against the disc, on a bridge deck with a railing running across the lower third. A broken, jagged city skyline sits in silhouette on both sides. A thin cyan streak drops vertically from the top edge, straight above the figures: the one cold accent.
records.subject_scale: two figures ~22% of frame height
records.move: Locked off: no zoom, with only ~1.7% vertical drift. The image holds still while haze and the falling streak supply the motion. Telephoto compression keeps the sun enormous behind small people.
records.light_colour: Strong backlight from the red sun turns everything in front into silhouette, with a single cold cyan streak. Palette: crimson, scarlet, black-maroon, one cyan line.
records.purpose: Awe and fate, a symbolic tableau: two people bound together, dwarfed by an ominous sky, with a warning sign falling toward them. The scale and silhouette moment of the sequence.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 3.0 s hold. L0: sky in 3 flat red bands. L1: sun disc 780 px diameter, centre x 540, y 1000 (spans y 610-1390, kept below the caption block), flat crimson with 2 thin darker cloud strips crossing it that drift 15 px left over the shot. L2: jagged skyline silhouette, y 1150-1480, dark maroon, cut by both side edges. L3: bridge deck + railing at y 1420-1520, plus two figures 420 px tall (22%) centred x 540, feet y 1440, solid anchor-dark silhouettes with heads inside the disc. L4: two foreground rail posts cut by the bottom, darkest value. Accent: a 6 px cyan line that grows down from y 0 to y 560 over 3 s, ease-in. Camera: locked, with an optional 30 px upward drift (ease-in-out). Parallax for any drift: L2 0.4, L3 0.8, L4 1.2. Captions go in the red sky at y 317-556 with dark text.

records.composition: Leading lines: a long wooden walkway/bridge seen from above, its railings converging to a centre vanishing point. A small knot of brawling figures sits in the middle distance near the centre. Sparse warm lamp dots punctuate the darkness. The surrounding void and underside structures are near-black teal.
records.subject_scale: figures ~10% of frame height
records.move: A fast push-in (14.5% in 1.5 s), speeding up, plus a lateral pan of ~7% of width and a slight tilt, with roll +1.8°. Strong parallax (1.86: the near rails slide much faster than the far deck) sells a real dolly toward the fight. It ends at speed and cuts on the motion.
records.light_colour: Dim cool teal ambient light with a few warm amber practicals along the bridge; no single strong key. Palette: deep teal, slate, black, amber points.
records.purpose: Establishes the fight's geography, then accelerates the viewer into it. Tension rising, the wind-up before the action.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 1.5 s. Vertical suits a receding bridge: VP at x 560, y 760. L0: flat dark-teal void with faint far structures. L1: far deck + 3-4 amber lamp dots (pop colour, <3% of the frame). L2: fight cluster of 5-6 figures, 170-200 px tall, at y 980-1180. L3: near deck planks + railings from the bottom corners, cut by the frame. Camera: scale 1.000 to 1.145 with a strong ease-in (cubic), centre moving 75 px toward the fight, roll 0 to +1.8°. Parallax: L3 1.9x, L2 1.0, L1 0.6, L0 0.3. Cut on the fastest frame into the next shot (no ease-out). Keep the y 317-556 caption area over the dark void.

records.composition: Closer on the same bridge: the hero (pink hair) stands centre-bottom with her back to camera, facing a group of thugs in the middle distance. Railings frame both sides. A warm lamp sits top-right. A frame-within-frame of rails, with the hero as a dark mass against slightly lighter planks.
records.subject_scale: hero ~35% of frame height (cut by the bottom edge); thugs ~25%
records.move: Locked off for 0.33 s (8 frames): a held beat. It is almost the exact first frame of shot 128, so it works as a brief still before the camera launches.
records.light_colour: Cool teal ambient light with a warm lamp top-right and a soft rim on the hero's hair. Palette: teal, slate, pink accent, amber dot.
records.purpose: A rhythmic punctuation, the moment of stillness before violence. It sets up who is fighting whom, from the hero's side.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 10 frames (0.33 s). The same world as shot 126, with the camera placed closer: L0 void, L1 far bridge + lamp dot at x 880, y 520, L2 thug group of 4, 480 px tall, at y 900-1380, L3 hero from behind, 670 px tall, centred x 540, cut by the bottom edge, L4 near rails left and right. Hard lock, no motion except 1-2 px hair sway. It must match shot 128's first frame exactly so the rush starts from it.

records.measured_move: push-in + pan right + tilt down + roll +5°
records.composition: It starts as the high wide of shot 127 and ends as a tight medium/medium close-up: the hero, low in the bottom-right, ducks and drives a punch while a thug is knocked up and across the frame top-left. Heavy motion blur and a blue streak. Bodies fill and break the frame edges, with diagonal action lines.
records.subject_scale: hero ~35% at start, ~90% at end (MCU)
records.move: A large rushing camera move: ~23% zoom plus a lateral sweep of ~43% of frame width, tilting down, rolling +5°, speeding up all the way. 83% off-plane means a real 3D dolly/crane into the brawl: the fighters grow far more than the background. The camera literally dives into the fight and arrives on the impact.
records.light_colour: Cool teal ambient light with a cold blue-white streak on the impact. Warm lamps drop out of frame as the camera enters. Palette: teal, steel blue, pink accent, white streak.
records.purpose: Action and kinetic energy: it carries the viewer from observer to participant and lands on the hit.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 2.0 s, starting on shot 127's exact frame. 2D dolly-in through parallax: world container scale 1.00 to 1.23 and translate x -460 px, y -160 px, roll 0 to +5°, all on one cubic ease-in. Inside it, the fighter layer (L2+L3) also scales 1.0 to 2.2 around the punch point (x 640, y 1250), because the camera moves through space, while the far bridge layer gets parallax 0.3 and the near rails 1.6 (they whip out of frame by 60%). Last 0.4 s: swap to 3 smear drawings of the punch (stretched fist, speed lines, a 2-frame blue-white streak). Cut at peak velocity into shot 129. Our ONE big move per video could take this shape (dive into the subject).
records.measured: push-in + pan right + tilt down + roll +5°

records.measured_move: pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -17°
records.composition: A two-shot in the thick of the brawl: a headband-wearing thug in the left foreground, wide-eyed, and the hero (pink hair) right, mid-swing and shouting. A crowd of onlookers sits small in the background between them. Faces sit on the thirds. The horizon tilts strongly as the camera rolls. (The 50%/90% thumbnails show the owner's YouTube player UI over the frame; ignore it.)
records.subject_scale: ~70% of frame height (two heads and shoulders)
records.move: A swinging move: a pan of ~20% of width plus a crane/tilt up of ~14%, and a big -17° roll that settles at the end (ease-out). Parallax 0.34 (the background crowd lags) suggests a handheld orbit around the fighters, starting fast and decelerating into the tilted frame.
records.light_colour: Cool, dim teal ambient light with a soft cold rim on faces and a warm skin midtone; no clear key. Palette: teal, grey-green, pink, desaturated skin.
records.purpose: Chaos and disorientation inside the fight. The dutch swing makes the brawl feel unstable, and it keeps both opponents readable.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 3.0 s. Stack the two-shot vertically for 9:16: L2 thug head + shoulders in the lower-left (head ~y 1250, 650 px tall, cut by the left edge). L1 hero in the upper-right (head ~y 800, 600 px), mid-shout; keep the captions at y 317-556 clear by putting her head below y 600. L0 crowd plane, 120-200 px figures, dimmer value. Camera on the world container: translate x -210 px, y +260 px, roll 0 to -17°, all ease-out (fast start, long settle). Parallax: L0 0.34, L1 0.8, L2 1.0. Add 2 px handheld jitter that decays with the ease. Arrive on the tilted frame and hold for the last 0.6 s.
records.measured: pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -17°

records.composition: Two images in 0.38 s (a missed cut). First ~4 frames: a full-frame impact, with the hero's fist and face smeared in motion toward camera, a warm-red tint and streaks, filling the frame edge to edge. Then a hard cut to the blue energy blast wide (the same framing as shots 131/132).
records.subject_scale: ~100% of frame height (smeared fist/face)
records.move: No camera move; the motion is all in the drawing (smears). It works as an impact flash cut: punch, then a cut on the impact to a different, huge event.
records.light_colour: The impact frames are warm red-magenta, smeared; the cut flips to cold electric blue-white. A deliberate warm-to-cold hard switch.
records.purpose: Transition by impact: the punch's energy cuts straight into the explosion, linking two storylines through momentum. It punctuates the climax.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, ~11 frames. Frames 1-4: one smear drawing of a fist driving at the lens, 1300 px, cut by all edges, stretched along a diagonal with 10-14 ink speed lines and a flat warm red wash. Frame 5: a 1-frame full white-blue flash (#E8F0FF). Frames 6-11: hard cut into the blue scale wide (shot 131 recipe). Sound: hit + whoomp on frame 5. Reuse this impact flash cut for 'the moment it hit' beats: move from a close action to a big consequence.

records.composition: Centred symmetry. A colossal hexagonal ring of lightning hovers overhead like a ceiling, seen in perspective, spanning and cut by the full frame width; concentric light rings sit inside it. Far below, in the bottom centre, a tiny silhouette figure. Scattered glowing runes/debris float at mid-height. Large empty haze between the figure and the ring.
records.subject_scale: ~10% of frame height
records.move: Locked off. All motion comes from the energy: the rings pulse, lightning flickers. The 0.42 s length most likely comes from a lightning flash splitting one continuous locked shot (131 + 132), not an edit.
records.light_colour: Overhead cold electric blue light from the ring, the figure in backlit silhouette; near-monochrome. Palette: electric blue, cyan-white, navy haze, black silhouette.
records.purpose: Reveals the scale of the event: awe and climax. The tiny person against an enormous force.
records.recipe_2d: See shot 132 (same set-up). As an opener: the first 0.4 s after the flash, with the ring at scale 0.94 and a brighter flat value, settling to normal in 6 frames.

records.composition: The same set-up as shot 131: a huge perspective hexagon of lightning fills the upper two-thirds and is cut by both sides. Lightning strands drop from it to a point held up by the tiny figure, who raises an arm/tool, at the bottom centre. A row of floating glowing rune glyphs sits at waist height around the figure. Strong central axis, scale ratio well over 10:1.
records.subject_scale: ~12% of frame height
records.move: Locked off (parallax 0.08: the frame is essentially flat). The ring grows and turns slightly, and lightning arcs connect it to the figure's raised hand. It holds for 1 s so the scale can register.
records.light_colour: Cold blue top light from the giant ring, white-hot where the lightning meets the raised hand; the figure in silhouette. Palette: electric blue, cyan, white core, navy.
records.purpose: Awe and scale, the climax image: one person summoning or holding back a force far bigger than themselves. Agency inside the scale moment.
records.recipe_2d: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 1.0-1.5 s hold (with 131, ~1.5-2 s in total; within our 1.5-4 s scale-moment budget). L0: 4 flat navy-blue haze planes, darker toward the bottom. L1: hexagon ring drawn as a flattened perspective hexagon 1300 px wide (cut by both edges) x 380 px tall at y 600-980 (just below the caption block), with 2-3 inner concentric ellipses. Ink in pale cyan on a flat blue glow band; rotate 0 to 3° and scale 1.00 to 1.05 over the shot, ease-out. L2: 25-35 floating rune glyphs (40-70 px) in a band at y 1350-1500, each bobbing 4-8 px, desynced. L3: tiny figure, 230 px tall (12%), centred x 540, feet y 1720, solid silhouette, arm raised to a 40 px white point at y 1500. Lightning: 3-5 jagged ink strands from the ring to the point, redrawn every 2 frames, plus 1-frame white flashes on the music beats. Camera locked. Follow it within ~5 s with an agency beat (a face).

records.composition: centred radial burst in negative space: a white-out core shrinking into a thin horizontal energy ring and forked lightning that branches out from frame centre
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Locked off. The 0.5 % drift is noise. All the motion is inside the frame: the white flash decays and the lightning forks crawl outward.
records.light_colour: hard white flash at the centre that cools to electric blue: white, cyan, cobalt. Self-lit energy, no other source.
records.purpose: Impact punctuation and transition. A flash frame whites out the eye between two action beats, so the next shot lands harder.
records.recipe_2d: 13 frames @30 fps. L0 cobalt bg fill. L1 haze: 3 flat concentric ellipses, each lighter toward the centre (540, 900). L2 3-5 hand-inked lightning forks plus one thin ellipse ring 700 px wide, redrawn every 2 frames (boil). L3 full-frame cream/white fill at opacity 1.0 on frames 0-3, falling to 0 by frame 10 with E.outCubic. Camera locked. Use it as the cut between two beats, e.g. a white-out on an impact.

records.composition: tiny silhouette dead centre in a huge field of glowing blue haze (negative space). The cut detector missed a smash-cut: in the last ~10 % the frame is a close-up of the crystalline gauntlet against green.
records.subject_scale: ~5 % of frame height (a tiny figure engulfed in energy), then a smash-cut to a gauntlet filling ~70 %
records.move: Nearly static: a 2 % pull-out that barely reads. The real move is the smash-cut from a tiny figure to the huge weapon close-up, a scale jump of about 1:14 across the cut.
records.light_colour: diffuse luminous blue haze that glows from everywhere, with specks of light dust: cobalt, periwinkle, pale cyan. After the cut, acid green behind the blue crystal.
records.purpose: Scale contrast across a cut. The person is swallowed by the power, then we smash into the weapon that holds it.
records.recipe_2d: 28 frames. L0 cobalt fill. L1-L2 two flat haze planes (one value step lighter toward the centre). L3 a ring of 40 light specks drifting outward at 15 px/s. L4 ink silhouette 90-110 px tall at (540, 960). Camera zoom 1.02 -> 1.00 over frames 0-24 with CAM.slow. Hard cut at frame ~25 to the FG-object close-up (shot 135 recipe). Keep the tiny-to-huge ratio >= 1:10, as COZY_AND_SCALE asks.

records.composition: FG object dominates: a big crystalline blue gauntlet fills the left half, cut by the left and bottom edges. A dark figure with acid-green glowing tech sits in the right third behind it, framed past the fist.
records.subject_scale: gauntlet ~70 % of frame height; background figure ~60 %
records.move: Push-in of 6 %. The camera drifts right and slightly down while rolling +3° clockwise, then settles. The measured parallax of 1.9 (bottom vs top) shows the fist is close to the lens and slides about twice as fast as the background. In the last third, blue electric arcs crackle around the knuckles as it charges.
records.light_colour: emissive cold-blue light from the crystal facets (key) against acid-green practical tubes behind, with magenta crystal accents: navy, ice blue, acid green, magenta.
records.purpose: Threat and power-up. The weapon charges before the blow, a tension beat that promises impact.
records.recipe_2d: 41 frames. L0 dark wall with 2 glowing green tube strokes (flat glow ring). L1 dark figure silhouette with green accents, right third, x 650-1080. L2 FG object drawing 1,150 px tall at x 0-620, cut by the left and bottom edges, parallax 1.9x. Camera zoom 1.00 -> 1.063, x +52 px (content slides left), y +43 px down, roll 0 -> +3°, CAM.settle (E.outCubic). From frame 26: boil 4-6 blue lightning strokes around the object every 2 frames and raise its glow fill one step.

records.composition: mirror symmetry, silhouettes against light: two fighters at the left and right thirds are blown apart in mid-air, leaning away from a blinding white burst at frame centre. Debris specks and yellow spark zigzags fill the gap between them.
records.subject_scale: each figure ~55-60 % of frame height
records.move: Slow-motion push-in of 9.6 %. The camera drifts right and down, then decelerates into a settle. The figures barely move (slow-mo), so the camera is what keeps the moment alive.
records.light_colour: hard white backlight burst from the centre that silhouettes both figures, warm amber sparks, cool grey smoke: slate, white, charcoal, amber.
records.purpose: Action climax as a frozen instant. Slow motion holds the impact so it can be read.
records.recipe_2d: 38 frames. Re-stack for 9:16 as a diagonal: figure A top-left (y 350-1050), figure B bottom-right (y 900-1650), the blast core between them at (540, 960). L0 grey haze with 3 flat rings lighter toward the core. L1 60 dark debris specks drifting outward at 20 px/s. L2 the two ink silhouettes (anchor-colour fill), drifting apart 30 px over the shot. L3 5 amber zigzag spark strokes, boiling. Camera zoom 1.00 -> 1.096, x +46 px, y +48 px, E.outCubic.

records.composition: a near-black frame: faint silhouettes fade out, a single orange ember spark sits at bottom centre, then the light returns on the next three-figure tableau
records.subject_scale: figures barely visible (~50 % height, nearly black)
records.move: Effectively static (1 % creep). This is a dip to black within the sequence, a lights-out beat, not a camera move.
records.light_colour: almost total darkness, one amber ember at the bottom, then cold grey haze fades back up: black, ember orange, slate.
records.purpose: Transition and breath. The blackout resets the exposure between two blasts, so the next reveal hits harder.
records.recipe_2d: 20 frames. Scene master opacity 1 -> 0.05 over frames 0-7 (E.inCubic). Hold black for frames 8-11 with one amber spark sprite (12 px, flickering) at (540, 1700). Fade the next scene up over frames 12-20. Camera zoom 1.000 -> 1.011. Reusable as our 'lights out' cut between two loud beats.

records.composition: triangular, radial tableau of silhouettes against light: two fighters thrown outward low at left and right, a third rising high at centre on a hoverboard seen from below (green thruster lights), with debris floating everywhere
records.subject_scale: side figures ~55 % of frame height; centre figure ~50 %
records.move: Short push-in of 5 % with a slight drift right and a symmetric ease. Slow-motion figures, so the camera supplies the energy.
records.light_colour: cold white haze backlight rising from below centre, everyone in silhouette, acid-green pinpoints and a beam under the board: charcoal, steel grey, white, acid green.
records.purpose: Action tableau. A three-way clash frozen as one graphic, so the conflict reads at a glance.
records.recipe_2d: 23 frames. The triangle fits 9:16: centre figure top-centre (y 350-900), side figures low left and right (y 950-1700), each cut by its side edge. L0 grey haze with a radial light core at (540, 1300). L1 debris specks. L2 3 ink silhouettes drifting outward 15-25 px. L3 green glow sprite (3 dots plus a 200 px vertical beam) under the centre figure. Camera zoom 1.00 -> 1.052, x +28 px, CAM.ease (inOutCubic).

records.composition: frame within frame, centred: a man in a white suit raises a fist in triumph, flanked by tall crimson banners on both edges, with backlit stained-glass windows (gold emblems, teal panes) behind him like a halo. The verticals lean in from the low wide lens.
records.subject_scale: ~70 % of frame height (thigh-up), arm raised to the top quarter
records.move: Tilt up of 6.5 % of width with a -1.9° roll, peaking mid-shot. Parallax 1.01 means a flat move, so it is a tilt, not a crane. It lifts toward the windows as he holds the pose, then lowers his arm.
records.light_colour: warm amber/gold backlight through the stained glass, crimson banners, cool teal glass panes, soft warm front fill on the figure: crimson, gold, teal, ivory.
records.purpose: Triumph and status. The low angle plus the upward tilt make the man look big; a pride beat before a fall.
records.recipe_2d: 74 frames, a natural vertical. L0 stained-glass wall 2,400 px tall (flat gold/teal panes, ink leading, an emblem roundel above the head). L1 lectern or desk cut by the bottom-left. L2 figure 1,350 px tall, centred, arm-up pose. L3 FG banners 200-260 px wide at both edges, cut top and bottom, parallax 1.15x. Camera y -70 px (tilt up) with CAM.reveal, roll 0 -> -1.9°, zoom 1.004. Pose: arm held up for 1.3 s, lowered over 0.6 s near the end.

records.composition: rule of thirds: a dim figure left of centre with one arm raised overhead, a shower of falling blue spark streaks around her, and wide dark negative space at right
records.subject_scale: ~65 % of frame height (waist-up)
records.move: An accelerating, woozy push-in of 10 %. The camera drifts right and tilts up while rolling -4° counter-clockwise and is still speeding up at the cut. Parallax 0.63 means the FG spark layer and the BG separate noticeably.
records.light_colour: cold cobalt ambient with no key; the blue spark points are the only light and the figure is underexposed: navy, cobalt, slate, electric blue.
records.purpose: Dread and instability. A lone character in a cold, unravelling moment; the ease-in builds momentum into the next beat.
records.recipe_2d: 43 frames. L0 navy haze (2 flat planes, one step apart). L1 figure ink drawing 1,250 px tall at x ~430, mid-dark fill, rim only in blue. L2 FG spark streaks: 40 vertical blue strokes 2-4 px wide x 30-80 px long, falling at 600 px/s, redrawn every 2 frames, parallax 1.4x. Camera zoom 1.00 -> 1.10, x +80 px, y -54 px (tilt up), roll 0 -> -4°, E.inCubic. Cut while still moving.

records.composition: the same setup as 140: the figure left of centre with arm raised, falling blue sparks, dark space at right
records.subject_scale: ~65 % of frame height
records.move: Pull-out of 5.4 % with a slight drift left and +1.8° roll, a symmetric ease. Part of a push / pull / slam pulse across 140-142 on the same setup. Parallax 0.55 again separates the FG sparks from the BG.
records.light_colour: cold cobalt darkness lit only by the blue sparks: navy, cobalt, slate, electric blue.
records.purpose: Rhythm. A counter-move between two pushes makes the camera breathe, so the moment feels unstable rather than linear.
records.recipe_2d: 24 frames, reusing the 140 layer stack. Camera zoom 1.054 -> 1.00, x -25 px, roll -1.8° -> 0, CAM.ease. Sparks keep falling and the figure's raised arm trembles 4-6 px. Cut 140 -> 141 -> 142 on motion to make a push / pull / slam pattern on one setup: cheap coverage that feels like three shots.

records.composition: same figure. Two bright white vertical light bars flash across left of centre on the first frames, then the frame crashes in on her
records.subject_scale: ~65 % of frame height, growing to ~80 % as the zoom crashes in
records.move: Crash zoom of 25 % in half a second. The camera whips right (13 % of width) with a -2.5° roll and is accelerating hard at the cut.
records.light_colour: cobalt darkness, hard white flash bars at the start, blue sparks: navy, white, electric blue.
records.purpose: Snap climax. An aggressive accelerating slam that ends the sequence and kicks into the next scene.
records.recipe_2d: 15 frames. Same stack as 140. Frames 0-3: two full-height white bars (40 px and 20 px wide) at x ~600-700, opacity 1 -> 0. Camera zoom 1.00 -> 1.25, x +145 px, roll 0 -> -2.5°, E.inQuart. On the last 3 frames add a 2-copy offset smear of the figure layer (opacity 0.3, 12 px apart along the move). Hard cut at peak speed.

records.composition: frame within frame: dark silhouetted ironwork and buildings on the left and right edges frame a giant art-nouveau mural of a woman's face (flowing hair, flowers, white doves) on a city wall. Teal neon tubes snake across the top, a round stained-glass window glows at upper right, and a tiny figure crouches on top of the painted hair.
records.subject_scale: mural face ~50 % of frame height; tiny perched figure ~4 % (scale contrast)
records.move: A slow lateral pan right of 6.6 % of width over 3.4 s, settling. Parallax 1.00 means a flat move: a pan across the painting, not a truck, and it reads as calm, like scanning an artwork.
records.light_colour: soft diffuse yellow-green glow over the mural, teal neon accents, emerald glass, deep umber silhouettes in front: olive gold, teal, rose, cream, umber.
records.purpose: Establishing and world-building. A calm breath after the action; the mural carries the theme (the face and doves read as memory or hope), with a tiny person against a giant image.
records.recipe_2d: 103 frames. L0 sky/haze. L1 wall and mural as one flat layer 1.4 W (1,510 px) x 1,920: face in flat colour, ink hair linework, 8 white dove shapes, round window top-right with flat teal glow ring, neon tube strokes with a flat outer glow. L2 tiny figure 70 px on the crown of the hair. L3 FG umber silhouettes: an ironwork balcony cut by the left edge (x 0-220), a building edge cut by the right (x 900-1080), parallax 1.1x for a hint of depth. Camera x +71 px, CAM.settle over the whole shot, zoom 1.005 -> 1.000. Optionally 2 real doves flap across for life. Keep the face clear of the caption block y 317-556.

records.composition: Mostly a screen-recording artefact: the YouTube player UI (pause/skip buttons, progress bar, 6:01 / 6:46) covers a dark frame. Underneath, a figure stands on a ledge in a dim cave beside a violet flare line, centred, seen from below. The last frame is a cut to a warm orange fire-lit hall.
records.subject_scale: ~45 % of frame height
records.move: Locked off. The only change is a hard cut from a cold dark frame to warm orange fire at the end. The player-UI overlay is the owner's recording, not the show's.
records.light_colour: near-dark blue-violet with a magenta/violet flare streak, then a cut to blazing orange fire: indigo, violet, black, then orange.
records.purpose: Not usable as cinematography (UI overlay). Underneath is a character-on-a-ledge beat and a cold-to-warm temperature cut.
records.recipe_2d: Treat as an artefact and do not model on it. The only takeaway is a cold-to-warm temperature cut: hold a dim low-angle full shot (figure 850 px tall on a ledge, indigo flat planes, one violet glow stroke) locked for 18 frames, then hard cut to a frame dominated by flat orange (#F2A541 family) fire planes. Use it to mark a turn from dread to danger.

records.composition: rule of thirds: lone figure centre-left, arms flung wide, gripping a tall vertical pole that splits the frame; burning wreckage fills the lower-left diagonal, black cavern mass on the right; a dark rail/barrel cuts the bottom-right corner (YouTube player overlay on the first frames: ignore)
records.subject_scale: ~65-70% of frame height (head near 20%, feet near 90%)
records.move: Agree: locked off. The only motion is in the frame: flames flicker, embers rise, and by 90% a shower of sparks bursts across the right half while the firelight dims.
records.light_colour: warm firelight from below-left rim-lighting the figure; cold near-black teal shadows; a small acid-green neon accent at left. Orange / ember yellow / black-teal / acid green
records.purpose: tension/threat: a defiant pose by the antagonist in her element, the calm-before-the-blast beat that sets up the energy burst that follows
records.recipe_2d: 4 layers, camera locked. BG: flat cavern wall #141A1F, cut by the top with a hanging chandelier silhouette in y 0-290. MG: burning wreckage lower-left (x 0-600, y 1100-1700), flat orange #F2852B flame shapes on a 3-frame boil, ember yellow #FFD36B cores. Figure: ink line + flat fill, head at y ~420, feet at y ~1650, standing on the pole/perch on the left third, warm 6 px rim on the fire side. FG: dark rail #0B0F12 cut by the bottom-right edge (x 650-1080, y 1650-1920). Particles: 30-40 embers rising 120-200 px/s with 1-2 px sideways drift; at 75% of the shot spawn a 60-particle spark burst on the right half. Hold 1.2-1.5 s (36-45 frames at 30 fps), not the compilation's 0.5 s.

records.composition: centred symmetry: a vertical white-hot slit of light just right of centre, blue chevron streaks radiating out from it toward the frame edges, black corners (the first ~10% is still the tail of shot 145)
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: The measured push/tilt/roll is mostly optical flow reading the radial streaks, not a real camera. Read it as an abstract energy insert: the streaks rush outward from the core, giving a strong forward-rush feel with a slight push and a small clockwise twist.
records.light_colour: self-lit white core, orange-red halo, electric-blue streaks against black. White / orange / red / electric blue / black
records.purpose: transition / power spike: smash-cut from the defiant pose into raw energy, a jolt that says something has been unleashed
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 suits the vertical slit. Frame 0: 1 frame of flat white. Core: nested flat vertical bands centred at x 560, full height: white #FFF8EC 60 px, cream #FFE2B0 140 px, orange #F2852B 360 px, deep red #7A1A12 700 px (flat bands, no gradient), black beyond. Streak layer: 20-30 electric-blue #3A6BFF chevron shards spawned at the core edge, flying outward at 1500-2500 px/s and scaling 1.0 to 1.6x as they go. Camera: scale 1.00 to 1.35 easeInOut over 12 frames plus roll 0 to +8°. Duration 12-15 frames.

records.composition: centred symmetry: the same vertical light slit; the halo swells sideways until by 90% the frame floods orange-red with a horizontal flare band through the middle
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Mostly agree: continued push (~17%) with a slight counter-roll, read through the streak tunnel; the real event is the halo blooming warm and filling the frame.
records.light_colour: core white, halo blooming from red into hot orange, blue streaks pushed to the edges. Hot orange / red / white / fading blue
records.purpose: escalation: sustain and heat up the energy, building pressure before the release
records.recipe_2d: Continue the 146 layers. Animate the orange band width 360 to 1080 px and the red band to past the frame edges over 14 frames (stepped, 4 key widths, no blur). Add a horizontal flare band: flat #FFC07A rectangle 80 px tall at y 960, width 0 to 1080 px from the core outward over 8 frames. Blue chevrons thin out (spawn rate down 70%) and are pushed past the edges. Camera scale 1.00 to 1.17 easeInOut, roll 0 to -3°. 15-18 frames.

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -74°
records.composition: centred symmetry: the orange flood recedes back into the vertical white core, blue streaks and chevrons re-emerge around it on the right, red halo at the edges
records.subject_scale: no figure
records.move: Correct the measurement: the -74° roll and 42% crane are flow artifacts from the swirling streaks. Read: a slight pull-back as the warm flood contracts and the cool streaks return, a pulse rather than a camera move.
records.light_colour: cooling pulse: orange-red flood contracts, electric blue returns, white core holds. Red / orange / electric blue / white
records.purpose: rhythm: the energy pulses (warm, then cool), keeping the transition alive and building tension
records.recipe_2d: Same layers. Halo contracts 1080 to 400 px (stepped), blue chevron spawn rate back to full with shards travelling outward and slightly clockwise (a 15° spiral offset per shard, which is what fooled our flow measure). Camera scale 1.13 to 1.00 with easeIn (accelerating) over 14-17 frames. No real roll: keep the frame upright.
records.measured: pull-out + pan right + tilt up / crane up + roll -74°

records.composition: starts as the centred light tunnel (blue right, orange left), then lands on a dark pillared hall: small figure just right of centre, a magenta energy ribbon whipping diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, a bright magenta burst behind the figure
records.subject_scale: abstract, then ~20% of frame height
records.move: Agree: near-still with a slight pull-back; the change is a flash/cut inside the shot from the abstract tunnel into the real location.
records.light_colour: from warm/cool tunnel into deep indigo darkness lit by a single magenta-violet source at the figure. Indigo / magenta / violet / black
records.purpose: transition landing / reveal: from abstract energy into the place and person releasing it
records.recipe_2d: Last 4 frames of the tunnel block: a 2-frame white flash, then cut to the hall. BG: vertical pillars #14122A cut by the top edge, 4-5 columns at x 80-1000. Figure: 380 px tall at (600, 1250), dark #0D0B1A with a 4 px magenta rim. Ribbon: flat magenta #C04BFF bezier stroke 60-120 px thick, animated with a trim path 0 to 100% over 6 frames from (100, 1500) to (1000, 700). Burst behind the figure: flat circle 220 px #E89BFF with a white 80 px core. Camera scale 1.03 to 1.00 easeInOut. 18-21 frames.

records.composition: centred: violet rays fan out radially from the figure at the centre of a dark hall, then the burst floods the frame to near white-out with the figure left as a faint pink outline
records.subject_scale: ~25% of frame height
records.move: Agree: a near-static frame with a tiny push and counter-roll; all motion is the radial rays growing and the frame overexposing.
records.light_colour: violet-magenta source at the figure blasting outward, deep indigo hall, rising to a white-out. Violet / magenta / indigo / white
records.purpose: climax: the power releases; overexposure as the emotional peak, also a natural white transition
records.recipe_2d: Rays layer: 10-14 flat wedge triangles from origin (540, 1150), lengths animated 0 to 2200 px over 8 frames, colour stepping #B266FF to #F3E6FF. White-out: flat white overlay, opacity 0 to 0.92 over the last 8 frames. Figure stays as a 2 px pink #E8A0E0 line drawing on top so it survives the white. Pink lightning squiggles (3-4 strokes) around the figure, 2-on/2-off flicker. Camera scale 1.00 to 1.02, roll 0 to -2°. 17-20 frames.

records.measured_move: push-in + pan right + tilt down + roll +6°
records.composition: centred radial burst: from the white-out, thick violet streaks shoot from a point just below centre to every edge, then a flat elliptical shockwave ring spreads along the floor horizon under a lavender dome of light
records.subject_scale: tiny, a faint figure at the burst point (~10%), then lost in the light
records.move: Correct the measurement: the 232% zoom and huge pan come from the radial FX and the white-out, not the camera. Read: the camera is essentially static (maybe a 1-2 frame shake) while the shockwave expands toward the lens.
records.light_colour: white-out turning into violet streaks, then a lavender dome over a dark floor. White / violet / lavender / near-black indigo
records.purpose: impact: the shockwave, the single loudest frame of the sequence
records.recipe_2d: 10 frames at 30 fps. Frames 0-2: flat white. Frames 2-6: 12-16 radial violet #7A3BD6 wedge streaks from (540, 1100) growing to the frame edges, with thin echo strokes beside each. Frames 5-10: a flat ellipse ring (stroke 40 px, #9B5BFF, height:width 0.18) at y 1150 scaling 200 to 2400 px wide; background flips to #120E22 at frame 6 except a flat lavender #D9C2FF dome (half-ellipse) behind the ring. Camera shake +-12 px for 2 frames at the ring's birth. In 9:16 the horizon ring is the only wide element; let it exit both side edges.
records.measured: push-in + pan right + tilt down + roll +6°

records.composition: centred figure in a dark hall (the first frame still shows the lavender horizon glow and a crackling spiky burst); violet shards and debris hang in the air, spreading to the right; jagged white-violet spikes fan out to the figure's right; large dark negative space
records.subject_scale: ~25% of frame height
records.move: Agree: locked off. Motion is only suspended debris drifting and the spike burst flickering.
records.light_colour: single violet glow point at the figure's hand, deep indigo-black darkness, violet rim on the debris. Indigo / violet / white-violet / black
records.purpose: aftermath: sudden stillness after the impact, showing what is left and who caused it
records.recipe_2d: Camera locked. BG: dark hall pillars #15112A plus a faint machine silhouette left (a wheel shape, #1E1838). Figure: dark #0D0B1A silhouette 450 px tall at (520, 1200) with a 4 px violet #8E5BE0 rim. Glow: flat 60 px circle #E9D5FF inside a 160 px ring #8E5BE0 at the hand. Debris: 60-90 flat quadrilateral shards (12-40 px), drifting outward 20-60 px/s, slow rotation 10-30°/s, lit edge violet. Spikes: 5-7 jagged white-violet #F0E4FF fin shapes to the figure's right, flicker 2 on / 2 off. 12-15 frames.

records.composition: figure at centre with the glowing violet point on the left side of her body, jagged lightning fins to the right; debris cloud running diagonally from upper right down toward her; dark machinery and pillars behind; big dark foreground shards drift past the lens
records.subject_scale: ~30% of frame height
records.move: Agree: a gentle 6% push. The measured parallax (0.30) shows foreground debris moving more than the figure, so it is a real dolly feel, not a flat zoom.
records.light_colour: violet point source at the figure, indigo surround, black foreground debris. Violet / indigo / white / black
records.purpose: linger on the aftermath: tension and unease, letting the viewer study the figure who did this
records.recipe_2d: Same layers as 152 plus FG: 6-10 large dark shards (80-160 px, #0B0918, unlit) crossing the frame. Camera push 1.00 to 1.06 easeInOut over 18 frames with parallax: FG 1.3x, figure and spikes 1.0x, BG pillars 0.7x. Glow pulse: scale 0.85 to 1.0 on a 6-frame period. Spikes slowly retract (length -20%). 18-20 frames.

records.composition: same centred figure, now dimmer and smaller in the frame's darkness; the debris thins and fades, the spikes are gone, a small violet glow point remains; large dark negative space all around
records.subject_scale: ~25% of frame height
records.move: Agree: an almost static frame with a slow 2° clockwise roll, a slight unease as the energy dies.
records.light_colour: fading violet glow, darkness creeping in from the edges. Dim violet / indigo / black
records.purpose: decay/settle: the energy dies out, handing off to darkness for the next cut
records.recipe_2d: Camera roll 0 to +2° over 22 frames easeInOut, no zoom. Global darkening: flat #0A0816 overlay, opacity 0 to 0.5. Shards opacity 1.0 to 0.4 and drift speed halved; glow shrinks to a 30 px dot. Ends near-black, ready for a dip to black. 20-23 frames.

records.composition: near-black frame with only a faint dark doorframe edge, then in the last frames a hard cut to a blazing white tall doorway with two silhouettes in the air (the opening of shot 156)
records.subject_scale: no figure in the black; two silhouettes appear only in the final frames
records.move: Agree: locked off. It is a black beat followed by a smash cut to white.
records.light_colour: darkness, then a pure white backlight. Near-black / dark grey / white
records.purpose: breath/blackout before the reveal: maximum contrast from dark to white so the next clash lands harder
records.recipe_2d: 8-10 frames of near-black #0B0D12 with faint door-jamb lines #1A1E28 at x 300 and x 780 (no motion, no sound or just a low rumble). Then a hard cut (no fade) to a 1-2 frame pure white field that becomes the doorway in shot 156. Use as our 'dip to black, smash to white' transition between beats.

records.composition: frame within frame and silhouette against light: two fighters airborne on opposing diagonals in front of a tall blazing doorway/window, black jambs on both sides with small cyan lights; foreshortened limbs reaching toward each other
records.subject_scale: ~85-90% of frame height (bodies span the doorway)
records.move: Agree: a slow 7% push with gentle easing while the figures drift through the air; the light shifts from overexposed white to electric blue with crackling lightning behind them.
records.light_colour: hard backlight from the doorway, white turning electric blue, black silhouettes, cyan accent lights on the frame. White / electric blue / cyan / black
records.purpose: action climax: two characters clash mid-air; silhouette makes the poses instantly readable
records.recipe_2d: 9:16 fits the tall doorway. Layers: FG dark jambs #0A0F1A, 180-260 px wide on each side, cut by top and bottom, with 5-6 cyan #6FE3FF 10 px dot lights; MG two solid #0A0F1A silhouettes 1100-1500 px long on opposing diagonals (one rising left-to-right, one falling right-to-left), drifting toward each other 30-60 px/s; BG doorway field 560-720 px wide, flat white #FFFFFF stepping to #CDEBFF then #6FB8FF over 10 frames, with 4-6 white zigzag lightning strokes flickering 2 on / 2 off. Camera push 1.00 to 1.07 easeInOut over 31 frames; parallax silhouettes 1.15x, doorway 1.0x, jambs 1.25x. 30-36 frames.

records.composition: Two-shot of a brawl in a cramped, ornate room. The fighters sit centre-right, the hero's glowing gauntlet fist is the brightest point near frame centre, and a dark patterned wall with heavy drapes fills the left third as texture. No sky and no exit: an enclosed, airless frame.
records.subject_scale: ~85% of frame height (two fighters, cut around the thighs)
records.move: Agrees: in effect a locked camera with a 2° roll drift and small handheld jitter. All the energy is in the figures (the punch), not the camera. This is the calm 'before' frame that the next shot's whip breaks.
records.light_colour: Warm crimson practical light from the room, upper left, with deep maroon shadows and a violet-blue glow on the gauntlet as the one cold accent. Palette: oxblood, maroon, violet glow, warm skin highlights.
records.purpose: Action beat: a fast, readable hit in a tight room that sets up the momentum the next shot carries across the cut.
records.recipe_2d: 0.7-1.0 s (21-30 frames at 30 fps). Layers: BG ornate wall + drapes (f 0.9; flat oxblood in 2 values, damask as 1.5 px ink, cut by the top and left edges; keep a flat lighter panel behind y 317-556 for captions); MID the two fighters (f 1, hero 0.55-0.65 H, head near y 620, gauntlet fist at x 540, y 800 as the pop: 2-ring Glow, <= 3% of frame); FG a dark door-jamb/drape sliver down the right edge (f 1.3, 8-12% W) for enclosure. Camera: locked, handheld 1-1.5 px, roll 0 -> -2° over the shot (ease-in-out, peak ~35%). On the contact frame add a 2-frame shake of 6-8 px and a 1-frame 1.5% scale bump; no flash brighter than one value step.

records.measured_move: slow push-in + pan left + tilt down + roll +33°
records.composition: The leaping fighter's body makes a hard diagonal that the camera roll follows, so figure and frame tilt together. The diagonal becomes the direction of a motion smear, and the last 2-3 frames are already a different place: a dark teal vertical shaft with a tiny figure.
records.subject_scale: ~80% H at the start (leaping fighter), then a ~10% H figure in the teal shaft after the hidden cut
records.move: Corrected: this is a whip-roll transition, not a slow push. The camera follows the leap, rolling ~+33° and tilting down about 30% of the frame width in ~0.5 s, with motion blur. The cut to the teal shaft is hidden inside the blur, so the measured numbers mix two shots.
records.light_colour: Warm crimson room light swaps to cold teal through the blur: a warm-to-cold flip that marks the change of place. Palette: oxblood -> teal-black, with violet glints.
records.purpose: Transition: carries the fighter's momentum across a change of location (tight red room -> vast cold machine shaft) and flips the colour temperature without a visible cut.
records.recipe_2d: Whip-roll cut, 0.8 s (24 frames). Frames 1-10: shot A follows the leaping figure, tilt down ~320 px + roll 0 -> +20°, ease-in (accelerating), with the figure's diagonal kept parallel to the roll. Frames 10-16: a full-frame smear wiper (3-4 flat tapered streaks in outgoing red and incoming teal, angled along the travel, f 1.5; WipePass / WipeCut). The cut happens under it, and only under it may speed pass the 15 px/frame cap. Frames 16-24: shot B arrives already rolled +12° and moving, then eases out to +6° and hands off to #159. Keep the visible roll at 20-25° max (our no-spin rule) and never pair it with a zoom bounce (safety).
records.measured: slow push-in + pan left + tilt down + roll +33°

records.composition: Worm's-eye view up a huge cylindrical machine hall. Ribbed walls and pipes converge toward a bright hazy opening at the top (leading lines), and a suspended spherical tank on a column anchors centre-right. The tiny leaping fighter sits in the upper-left third against the light haze (silhouette against light), with near pipes cut by the left and right edges.
records.subject_scale: ~12% of frame height (tiny leaping fighter); the tank column ~70% H
records.move: Agrees: a pull-back that starts slowly and speeds up, with a 14° roll. The last ~20% speeds into a pure motion-blur smear (frame 3 is only blur), so the shot exits by whipping out and cuts blur-to-blur into #160.
records.light_colour: Monochrome cold teal-cyan. Backlight falls from the top opening through haze, two small hard lamp flares sit behind the figure, and a cool glint catches the gauntlet. Palette: deep teal, cyan haze, steel grey, near-black.
records.purpose: Awe and scale: one fighter tiny inside a colossal machine, between two close action beats, so the jolt of smallness comes across a cut (close fight -> vast shaft -> close hit).
records.recipe_2d: Vertical K7 worm's-eye, 1.2-1.5 s (36-45 frames). Layers, back to front: light opening (f 0; flat pale-cyan disc in y 0-450 with 2 halo steps; holds captions at y 317-556); ribbed cylinder wall with pipes converging up toward it (f 0.2, one value step darker per plane downward); central column + suspended spherical tank (f 0.55, x 480-820, y 650-1400, cut by the bottom); near pipes cut by the left and right edges (f 1.3, 15-20% W each, darkest teal); hero (f 1, 120-180 px tall, about 0.07-0.09 H, >= 10:1 against the column, at x 250-420, y 600-780, a silhouette with one gauntlet glint). Camera: anchored pull-back, push 1.15 -> 1.0 (about -13%) + roll 0 -> +10°, ease-in (accelerating); the hero arcs ~120 px up-right. Last 5-6 frames: speed passes the cap only under a diagonal smear wiper that also opens #160.

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan left + tilt down + roll +83°
records.composition: A strong diagonal runs from upper left (raised gauntlet, kicking leg) to lower right (the opponent arched backward under the blow). Cyan energy arcs loop around the pair like a vortex (frame within frame), and small goggled henchmen silhouettes sit low right as a scale and depth cue.
records.subject_scale: ~90% H for the pair (attacker roughly 60-75% H)
records.move: Corrected in degree: the huge numbers come from the motion-blurred first ~0.4 s. The camera arrives rolling and travelling with the flying fighter (a whip-in, blur-to-blur from #159), then lands and nearly freezes on the impact for the last ~60% (frames 2 and 3 are almost the same). The 83° roll lives mostly inside the blur and does not read as a visible spin.
records.light_colour: Dark cold teal ambient with practical glows on the weapons (blue gauntlet, magenta sparks on the opponent's mechanical arm, acid-green blade) and a cyan rim from the energy arcs. Palette: teal-black, cyan, magenta, acid green.
records.purpose: Action payoff: the momentum built by two whips lands in one clear, readable hit, then the frame holds so the viewer can take in the impact.
records.recipe_2d: Whip-in to an impact hold, 1.2-1.4 s. Frames 1-8: arrive under a smear wiper with roll -20° -> 0, scale 1.3 -> 1.0 and a 200 px truck following the hero, ease-out (CAM.reveal landing), so the travel is all in the first ~40%. Frames 9-38: near-hold (1 px drift) on a vertical stack: attacker top (gauntlet glow at x 380, y 600; body y 600-1050), opponent arched below (head at x 760, y 1000; body to y 1350), the diagonal running top-left -> bottom-right. FG (f 1.3): 2-3 open cyan ellipse arcs (tapered 4-10 px strokes) circling the pair at ~30°/s, one cut by each edge. BG (f 0.3): dark teal room with 3 tiny henchmen silhouettes at x 600-800, y 1150-1240, each with a magenta goggle dot. Contact: 2-frame 8 px shake + a spark burst (magenta/green, <= 4% of frame), at most 1 flash. Keep captions on a flat dark field at y 317-556 above the fist.
records.measured: pull-out + pan left + tilt down + roll +83°

records.measured_move: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll -10°
records.composition: Cosmic setting: a glowing orb cupped in a giant hand, left of centre, is the only bright point. As the shot goes on, a dark, faceless hooded head looms above the palm at top centre. A diagonal nebula band runs across the upper left, with empty starfield as negative space on the right.
records.subject_scale: hand + orb ~45% H at start; hood-to-palm ~85% H at the end; orb ~10% H
records.move: Partly corrected: the hand itself turns and rises toward the lens, opening palm-up, while the camera cranes up and drifts back so the hood is revealed above the palm. The -30% 'pull-out' is partly the starfield and nebula flow. It speeds up toward the cut, which hands off to #162.
records.light_colour: The orb is the key light, lighting the palm from inside and below, with a cold blue rim on the hood. Palette: navy, cobalt, cyan glow, ochre nebula.
records.purpose: Mythic, symbolic reveal: a faceless giant holding a tiny world. It sets up the push into the object and makes an abstract stake feel cosmic.
records.recipe_2d: 1.2-1.5 s. Layers: starfield (f 0, 2-3 stars twinkling); nebula band (f 0.15, flat ochre + teal shapes running diagonally from top left); hooded giant (f 0.5, flat cobalt mass, faceless dark hood cut by the top edge at first); hand (f 1, palm-up, starting in profile at x 200-600, y 1000-1300); orb (120-160 px, self-lit cyan with 2 halo rings, lighting the palm from below); dust motes (f 1.4, 10-15 specks). Animation: the hand rotates ~25° and rises ~150 px toward the lens, the palm opening to camera. Camera: crane up 250 px (y keys) + pull back 1.12 -> 1.0 + roll 0 -> -6°, ease-in (accelerating), so the hood slides down into frame above the palm and lands at y 560-800. The orb stays the only bright mark; captions on the flat nebula at y 317-556.
records.measured: pull-out + pan left + tilt up / crane up + roll -10°

records.composition: Centred symmetry: the orb resolves into an Earth-like planet dead centre with a small moon. The foreshortened palm and fingers run from the bottom edge as leading lines into it, and glowing orbit rings frame it (frame within frame). The dark hood fades behind, with starfield and nebula at the edges.
records.subject_scale: orb/planet ~25% H at start -> ~70% H at the end (no human figure; the palm ~60% H)
records.move: Agrees: a push from the palm-and-hood framing into the held planet, with a slight pan right and a -9° counter-roll. The push speeds up late (peak at ~82%) as the rings flare, so the shot is cut while still moving.
records.light_colour: The planet is self-lit, with a cyan-white glow and bright orbit rings. The palm is cold blue, with violet nebula and white stars around. Palette: cobalt, cyan, white glow, Earth green-ochre.
records.purpose: Symbolic insert and scale shift: 'the whole world in one hand'. It turns an abstract stake into one object and pushes the viewer into it. This is a strong template for our explainers' topic-object moments.
records.recipe_2d: 1.8-2.2 s. Layers: starfield (f 0); hood (f 0.4, dark, top cut); palm (f 1.2, foreshortened from the bottom edge, fingers rising to y ~1150, its mass may run under the UI zone); topic object/planet (f 1, 320 px at x 540, y 880, growing to ~650 px); 2-3 thin cyan orbit-ring ellipses rotating 90-120°/s (one in front, one behind); a 40 px moon on an orbit. Camera: push 1.0 -> 1.2 anchored on the object (anchorDepth 1.0) + pan ~110 px right + roll 0 -> -6°. Custom easing: slow over 0-60%, peak speed at ~80%, cut while still moving, keeping the planet's edge <= 15 px/frame (the palm drops out the bottom at f 1.2). Hand off with a match cut on the round shape (globe, coin, clock face, chip die) or push straight through it into the next scene. Captions on the dark starfield need a caption plate, or keep them above the rings at y 317-556.

records.composition: Top-heavy: a luminous, billowing energy-cloud ceiling fills the top ~30% of the frame. The dark lower ~70% is cut by bright diagonal light streaks falling upper left -> lower right (leading lines), with a small dark falling shape mid-frame. Dark railing posts silhouetted at the left and right edges make a frame within a frame.
records.subject_scale: no figure (one small dark falling shape ~8% H)
records.move: Agrees: in effect a locked wide with a ~1% creep. All the motion is in the scene: falling streaks, the cloud's slow boil, a lightning flicker late in the shot.
records.light_colour: The cloud is the key light from above, cold cyan-white. The streaks are bright cyan and everything else is near-black navy, with silhouettes against light. Palette: cyan, ice white, navy-black, steel.
records.purpose: Awe and dread: the sky itself has become the threat. A held breath between action beats, in an aftermath/establishing role.
records.recipe_2d: Locked sky-threat wide (K6 with the threat overhead), 2-2.5 s. Layers: luminous cloud ceiling (f 0.1; flat pale-cyan billows in 3 value steps over y 0-650, lightest on the underside, slow boil by swapping 2-3 shape drawings on 4s); dark city/void band (f 0.3, flat near-black navy, y 650-1920); falling light streaks as screen-space FX (20-40 tapered strokes 2-6 px wide and 80-250 px long, along a 30° diagonal at 20-35 px/frame, staggered: they carry all the motion); one dark tumbling silhouette (60-120 px) at x 540, y 1000; FG railing posts at both edges (f 1.3, flat near-black, cut by the top and bottom). Camera: push 1.00 -> 1.015 (CAM.slow), handheld <= 1 px. Optional single lightning fork at ~75% (one flash; never > 3 per second). Captions sit on the bright cloud underside at y 317-556, the cleanest caption ground on this sheet.

records.composition: Two opposed figures on a diagonal. The airborne attacker, weapon raised overhead, sits in the upper-left third against bright haze. The gunner, cut by the bottom-right edge, extends an arm and pistol toward him, and that arm is the leading line across the empty space between them. The value splits in half: bright haze on the left, dark on the right. A bridge truss/railing runs low, with floating debris.
records.subject_scale: attacker ~70% H, gunner ~60% H cut by the bottom
records.move: Agrees: a gentle drift back and to the left that settles (ease-out) while the action plays in slow motion. The airborne attacker barely moves across 2.7 s (hang-time) and the debris hangs in the air.
records.light_colour: Hard white-grey backlight from the left through smoke, so both figures read as near-silhouettes with thin rims. A tiny cyan accent sits in the gunner's hair. Palette: smoke white, grey, charcoal, cyan accent.
records.purpose: Tension: the suspended moment before a strike. Slow motion and the pointing arm let the viewer read who threatens whom before the cut.
records.recipe_2d: Slow-motion standoff, 2.5-3 s. Value split: bright haze on the left half (3 flat bands, lightest at the left edge), dark on the right. Layers: haze BG (f 0); bridge truss/railing line art (f 0.3, y 1300+); far debris (f 0.6, 10-15 specks drifting ~1 px/frame); attacker airborne (f 1, near-silhouette with a thin rim on the lit side, 0.40-0.45 H, weapon overhead, x 200-560, y 560-1250); gunner (f 1.25, mass cut by the bottom-right edge and allowed under the UI, head at x 800, y ~1000, arm and pistol extended up-left to x 560, y 900, pointing at the attacker across the gap); near debris (f 1.4, 5-8 larger flecks). Animate on 3s with only ~40 px total rise of the attacker (hang-time) and some braid/coat sway. Camera: pull back 1.07 -> 1.0 + truck ~70 px (content drifts right) + roll 0 -> +3°, landing over the last 35% (CAM.reveal), then a 1 px drift. Captions on the bright haze at y 317-556, kept clear of the raised weapon.

records.composition: Centred, symmetrical standoff: two figures in profile face each other, with a red-magenta flare exactly between their hands as the focal point. Gothic arches fade into the misty hall behind them.
records.subject_scale: two figures ~70% H each (only 2-3 real frames)
records.move: Corrected: the measurement is unreliable. Only the first 2-3 frames are show footage; the rest is the compilation cutting to black and then the YouTube end screen, which the flow fit read as a crane/pull-out. Treat it as a static two-shot.
records.light_colour: The red-magenta flare is the key light between the figures, against cold lavender-grey haze from behind. Palette: magenta-red, lavender grey, slate.
records.purpose: A confrontation and end beat: two sides meet at one hot point, as a closing image (here it is the compilation's last frame).
records.recipe_2d: Centred standoff two-shot as an ending, 1.5-2 s in our cut (the 0.29 s here is the compilation's edit). Layers: misty hall BG (f 0.2, flat lavender-grey haze, gothic arch line art fading over 2 steps); floor plane (f 0.6); two figures in profile facing each other (f 1, 0.35-0.40 H each, at x 160-460 and x 620-920, y 700-1250); the flare between their hands (the pop colour, at x 540, y 950, a 60 px core + 2 halo rings, <= 3% of frame, pulsing one value step, never a strobe). Camera: push 1.00 -> 1.03 (CAM.slow). Cut hard to black on the flare's peak, or match-cut back to frame 0 for a loop. Captions on the flat haze at y 317-556.
